q: 以下哪些是处理长尾/罕见事件的数据策略?(多选)
q_en: Which of these are data strategies for handling long-tail / rare events? (multiple)
why: 长尾有四个数据侧策略:过采样、定向采集、尺度感知增强、子模选择,全都在改"模型见到什么数据";加深网络、调学习率是优化侧,救不了训练数据里罕见类几乎不出现这个根因。
why_en: The long-tail levers are oversampling, targeted collection, scale-aware augmentation, and submodular selection — all changing what data the model sees, unlike deeper nets which don't fix missing rare classes.
options: 过采样:训练时提高罕见类帧的采样率
定向车队采集:车载启发式触发时高清抓取异常场景
尺度感知增强:随机裁剪、尺度抖动、mosaic 保持真实尺寸
加深网络层数、调大学习率来"记住"罕见类
options_en: Oversampling: raise the sampling rate of rare-class frames during training.
Targeted fleet collection: onboard heuristics trigger high-res capture of unusual scenes.
Scale-aware augmentation: random crop, scale jitter, and mosaic that preserve realistic sizes.
Deepen the network and raise the learning rate to 'memorize' rare classes.
optionExplanations: 对;把 0.1% 的儿童行人帧上采到有意义的 batch 占比,让梯度真正看到罕见类。
对;不是被动记录,而是触发式主动采集——急刹、异形、低能见度时才高清抓拍,直击尾部。
对;用随机裁剪、尺度抖动、mosaic 造多尺度样本,但校准到真实距离尺寸,才不损精度。
错;加深网络、调大学习率属于优化侧,数据里没有的罕见类它们变不出来。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — up-weight 0.1% child-pedestrian frames to a meaningful batch fraction so the gradient actually sees rare classes.
Correct — not passive logging but trigger-based active capture on hard braking, odd shapes, or low visibility, hitting the tail directly.
Correct — random crop, scale jitter, and mosaic build multi-scale samples, calibrated to realistic distances so accuracy isn't hurt.
Wrong — deeper nets and higher learning rates are optimization-side and don't fix rare classes barely appearing in the data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时提高稀有类样本的抽取频率,让梯度更多受它影响。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Oversampling raises how often rare-class samples are drawn during training so the gradient reflects them more.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把多张图拼成一张训练样本,增加尺度与上下文多样性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Mosaic augmentation stitches several images into one training sample, adding scale and context diversity.

q: 过采样(oversampling)在长尾检测里具体怎么做,要注意什么代价?
q_en: How does oversampling work in long-tail detection, and what's the cost to watch?
why: 过采样在训练采样阶段提高罕见类频率——把 0.1% 的儿童行人帧上采到有意义的 batch 占比,否则梯度几乎学不到它。代价是过度重复少量样本可能过拟合,所以常配数据增强一起用。
why_en: Oversampling raises rare-class frequency at train time so 0.1% child-pedestrian frames reach a meaningful batch fraction, risking overfit to few samples, so it pairs with augmentation.
tradeoff: 过采样(让梯度看到罕见类) vs 过度重复少量样本(过拟合风险)
options: 训练时复制常规帧,让数据集整体变大以提升泛化
推理时对罕见类降低置信度阈值,提高召回
训练时把 0.1% 罕见帧上采到有意义的 batch 占比,代价是易过拟合
删除常规帧直到各类别样本数量完全相等以求均衡
options_en: Duplicate routine frames at train time to enlarge the dataset and improve generalization.
Lower the confidence threshold for rare classes at inference to raise recall.
At train time up-weight 0.1% child-pedestrian frames to a meaningful batch fraction, at the cost of possibly overfitting few samples.
Delete routine frames until every class has exactly equal counts.
optionExplanations: 复制常规帧只会让本已占主导的类更主导,和过采样罕见类的目标正好相反。
调阈值是推理侧后处理,改的是判定边界,不解决训练里罕见类看不到的问题。
对;过采样在训练采样阶段提罕见类频率,让梯度学到它;代价是少量样本被反复看易过拟合,需配增强。
把常规帧删到相等会丢掉大量真实分布信息,还可能欠拟合常见场景,不是过采样。
optionExplanations_en: Duplicating routine frames makes the already-dominant class more dominant, the opposite of oversampling rare classes.
Threshold tuning is inference-side post-processing; it shifts the decision boundary but not the unseen rare classes in training.
Correct — oversampling raises rare-class frequency at sampling time so the gradient learns it, risking overfit to few samples, hence pairing with augmentation.
Deleting routine frames to equal counts loses real distribution info and can underfit common scenes; that isn't oversampling.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型死记少量训练样本,泛化到新样本时反而变差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Overfitting is when a model memorizes a few training samples and generalizes worse to new ones.

scenario: 想在真实道路上多拿到"儿童冲出""异形障碍物"这类罕见帧,但不能无脑回传所有画面(带宽/存储爆炸)。
scenario_en: You want more rare frames like child-darting and odd obstacles from real roads, but can't blindly upload every frame (bandwidth/storage blow up).
q: 怎样高效地从车队采到更多罕见帧?
q_en: How do you efficiently collect more rare frames from the fleet?
why: 触发式采集把带宽花在刀刃上:平时不传,只有车载启发式命中异常(急刹、异形、低能见度)时才高清抓拍,直接放大尾部。全量回传成本爆炸,随机抽样又抽不到罕见类。
why_en: Trigger-based capture spends bandwidth only when onboard heuristics flag anomalies like hard braking or low visibility, directly amplifying the tail instead of logging everything.
tradeoff: 触发式采集(省带宽、命中尾部) vs 全量回传(覆盖全但成本爆炸)
options: 全车队 24 小时高清回传所有帧,事后再筛
触发式采集:车载启发式检测到异常(急刹、异形、低能见度)时才高清抓取上传
只在数据中心用随机采样从历史日志里抽帧
只靠合成数据,完全不从真实车队采集
options_en: Have the whole fleet upload every frame in high-res 24/7, then filter afterward.
Trigger-based capture: only grab and upload high-res when onboard heuristics detect anomalies (hard braking, odd shapes, low visibility).
Only random-sample frames from historical logs in the data center.
Rely on synthetic data alone and never collect from the real fleet.
whenOtherWins: 若某类罕见场景连车载启发式都无法在线识别(没有可靠触发信号),那就得靠离线主动学习或合成数据来补,而非触发式采集。
optionExplanations: 全量高清回传带宽和存储都撑不住,而且回来的还是 95% 常规帧,筛选成本极高。
对;触发式只在异常命中时抓拍,把有限带宽花在尾部帧上,是主动获取的正解。
随机抽历史日志抽到的仍按真实频率,几乎全是常规帧,救不了罕见类稀缺。
合成能补一部分,但完全不采真实数据会漏掉真实传感器特性和真实罕见分布。
optionExplanations_en: Full high-res upload overwhelms bandwidth and storage, and returns 95% routine frames anyway, making filtering hugely costly.
Correct — capturing only on anomaly triggers spends limited bandwidth on tail frames, the right active-acquisition move.
Random-sampling logs still follows real frequency, nearly all routine frames, and can't fix rare-class scarcity.
Synthetic fills some gaps, but never collecting real data misses real sensor characteristics and the real rare distribution.

termDefinitions.meaning: 车载启发式命中异常(急刹、异形、低能见度)时才高清抓拍上传,而非全量回传。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Trigger-based capture uploads high-res only when onboard heuristics flag anomalies like hard braking or low visibility, not everything.

termDefinitions.meaning: 有目的地去采集稀缺样本,而非被动等它自然出现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Active acquisition deliberately goes after scarce samples instead of passively waiting for them to appear.

q: 尺度感知增强(scale-aware augmentation)里的 mosaic、尺度抖动为什么要"校准",不能随便做?
q_en: Why must mosaic and scale jitter in scale-aware augmentation be 'calibrated' rather than arbitrary?
why: 尺度感知增强用随机裁剪、尺度抖动、mosaic 造多尺度样本,但要校准到真实距离尺寸——远处行人本就小、近处大;若尺度乱来,模型学到不真实的尺寸分布,反而在真实测距/检测上退化。
why_en: Scale-aware augmentation uses random crop, scale jitter, and mosaic for multi-scale samples, calibrated to realistic distances so the model detects both small far and large near pedestrians.
options: 保持物体在不同距离的真实尺寸,让模型能检测远处小行人和近处大行人
只是为了让图片更好看,校准与否不影响精度
校准是为了压缩图像体积、加快训练 IO
目的是把所有物体缩放到同一固定像素大小
options_en: To keep objects at realistic sizes for their distance, so the model detects both small far pedestrians and large near ones.
Just to make images look nicer; calibration doesn't affect accuracy.
Calibration is to shrink image size and speed up training IO.
The goal is to scale every object to one fixed pixel size.
optionExplanations: 对;校准保持真实的"远小近大"尺寸分布,模型才能同时学会检测远处小目标和近处大目标。
增强直接改变训练分布,校准与否直接影响精度,不是美观问题。
尺度增强目的是多尺度鲁棒性,不是压缩体积或加速 IO。
把所有物体缩到同一尺寸会抹掉尺度信息,和"检测各种距离目标"的目标相反。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — calibration preserves the real small-far/large-near size distribution so the model learns both far small and near large objects.
Augmentation directly changes the training distribution, so calibration affects accuracy; it's not about looks.
Scale augmentation aims at multi-scale robustness, not shrinking size or speeding IO.
Scaling everything to one size erases scale info, the opposite of detecting objects at various distances.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时随机缩放图像/目标,制造多尺度样本以提升尺度鲁棒性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scale jitter randomly rescales images or objects during training to create multi-scale samples for scale robustness.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把多张图拼成一张,增加一张样本里的尺度与上下文多样性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Mosaic augmentation stitches multiple images into one, adding scale and context diversity within a single sample.

scenario: 有海量未标注罕见帧,但标注预算很小,想选出信息量最大又不重复的一小批来标。
scenario_en: A huge pool of unlabeled rare frames but a tiny labeling budget; you want a small batch that's most informative and non-redundant.
q: 用什么方法在最小预算下选出"有信息量又多样"的罕见样本?
q_en: Which method picks 'informative and diverse' rare samples on a minimal budget?
why: 子模函数有"边际递减"性质:已选相似样本后,再选一个几乎相似的收益很小。子模互信息(SMI)据此挑子集,自动兼顾信息量和多样性,用最小预算覆盖罕见样本。
why_en: Submodularity has diminishing returns, so submodular mutual information picks a subset that maximizes information and diversity together, covering rare samples on a minimal budget.
tradeoff: 子模选择(信息量+多样性,省预算) vs 随机抽样(简单但重复且漏罕见)
options: 随机抽样:实现简单、无选择偏差,按真实频率取帧
只选模型置信度最高的帧,认为这样标注质量最有保证
按采集时间顺序,取最新的一批帧来标注
子模选择:用子模互信息(SMI)挑兼顾信息量与多样性的子集
options_en: Random sampling — simple, no selection bias, drawing frames at real frequency.
Pick only the model's highest-confidence frames, assuming that best ensures label quality.
Take the most recent batch of frames by capture time to label.
Submodular selection: SMI picks a subset balancing information and diversity.
whenOtherWins: 若预算充足或样本池本身已很多样,随机抽样更省事;子模选择的价值在预算紧、且要避免重复选到相似样本时才凸显。
optionExplanations: 随机抽样按真实频率走,罕见类几乎抽不到,还会重复选到相似样本,浪费预算。
只选高置信帧等于挑模型已会的样本,信息量最低,恰恰不该优先标。
取最新帧是时间偏好,和"信息量+多样性"无关,可能全是相似场景。
对;SMI 利用边际递减自动避开冗余,挑出既有信息量又多样的一小批,最省预算。
optionExplanations_en: Random sampling follows real frequency, barely hitting rare classes and repeatedly picking similar samples, wasting budget.
Only high-confidence frames are ones the model already knows, the least informative, exactly what not to label first.
Newest frames is a time preference unrelated to information/diversity and may be all similar scenes.
Correct — SMI uses diminishing returns to avoid redundancy, picking a small informative and diverse batch most budget-efficiently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 子模互信息:利用边际递减性质选样本子集,同时最大化信息量与多样性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SMI (Submodular Mutual Information) uses the diminishing-returns property to pick a sample subset maximizing information and diversity together.

termDefinitions.meaning: 已选相似样本后,再加一个高度相似的样本带来的额外收益迅速变小。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Diminishing returns means once similar samples are chosen, adding another highly similar one yields rapidly shrinking extra value.

scenario: 团队用无约束的仿射变换(平移、旋转、缩放)大量增强行人样本,验证集 mAP 看着不错。
scenario_en: The team heavily augments pedestrian samples with unconstrained affine transforms (translate, rotate, scale); validation mAP looks fine.
q: 无约束仿射增强的风险是什么,怎么缓解?
q_en: What's the risk of unconstrained affine augmentation, and how do you mitigate it?
why: 无约束仿射变换会把行人放到不可能的位置(悬在路面上方、穿墙),模型学到不真实分布,真实场景反而退化。缓解:约束变换范围,校验增强帧物理可信(行人应在地面、尺寸随距离合理)。
why_en: Unconstrained affine transforms can float a pedestrian above the road, teaching an unreal distribution that hurts robustness, so you validate that augmented frames are physically plausible.
tradeoff: 多增强(样本更多) vs 物理不可信样本(损害真实场景鲁棒性)
options: 没有风险,增强越多越好,直接全量上
风险是训练变慢,缓解办法是减少增强数量
会生成物理不可能的样本(行人悬空),损害鲁棒性;要校验增强帧物理可信
风险是标签丢失,缓解办法是重新人工标注每张增强图
options_en: No risk; more augmentation is always better, so apply it all.
The risk is slower training; mitigate by reducing the amount of augmentation.
It can generate physically impossible samples (a pedestrian floating above the road), hurting robustness; validate that augmented frames are physically plausible.
The risk is lost labels; mitigate by re-annotating every augmented image by hand.
optionExplanations: 验证集 mAP 好只是假象:不可信样本让模型学偏,真实路况会掉,不能"越多越好"。
训练慢不是核心风险,核心是分布被污染;单纯减量不解决物理不可信的问题。
对;悬空/穿墙这类样本教给模型错误先验,得靠约束变换+物理可信性校验挡住。
仿射变换会同步搬运标签,通常不丢标签;重标每张图既不必要也不解决物理不可信。
optionExplanations_en: Good validation mAP is an illusion: implausible samples mislead the model and it drops on real roads, so 'more is better' fails.
Slower training isn't the core risk; the core is a polluted distribution, and just reducing amount doesn't fix implausibility.
Correct — floating/through-wall samples teach a wrong prior, so you constrain transforms and validate physical plausibility.
Affine transforms move labels along, so labels usually aren't lost; re-annotating every image is needless and doesn't fix implausibility.

termDefinitions.meaning: 平移、旋转、缩放、错切等线性几何变换;无约束时可能造出不真实构图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An affine transform is a linear geometric operation (translate, rotate, scale, shear); unconstrained it can produce unrealistic compositions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检测常用指标:对各类别的平均精度再取均值,越高越好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mAP (mean Average Precision) is a standard detection metric averaging per-class average precision; higher is better.

q: 把长尾数据飞轮排成正确的循环顺序:
q_en: Order the long-tail data flywheel into its correct loop:
steps: 触发帧进入标注队列
标注后扩大尾部覆盖,重训模型
车载触发器捕获异常场景(急刹、异形、低能见度)
更强的模型部署回车队,更会识别新异常
why: 飞轮:车载触发采集→标注队列→扩大尾部覆盖重训→更强模型回车队→触发器更会识别新异常,循环往复。每转一圈尾部覆盖变宽、模型变强,是长尾持续改进的引擎。
why_en: The flywheel loops trigger-capture to annotation queue to a retrained model with wider tail coverage to a stronger fleet that flags new anomalies, each turn widening the tail.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  T["车载触发捕获异常"] --> Q["标注队列"]
  Q --> R["重训扩大尾部覆盖"]
  R --> M["更强模型回车队"]
  M --> T

termDefinitions.meaning: 触发采集→标注→重训→更强模型→触发更准的自我强化循环,越转尾部覆盖越宽。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A data flywheel is the self-reinforcing loop of trigger-capture to labeling to retraining to a stronger model, widening tail coverage each turn.

q: 为什么安全关键检测需要合成数据/仿真,而不能只靠真实采集?
q_en: Why does safety-critical detection need synthetic data/simulation, not just real capture?
why: 真实世界里你不能为了采数据去制造碰撞、让儿童冲出马路或等极端天气;合成/仿真能安全地生成这些不可采集的场景,还自带完美 ground truth。它是补不可采集尾部的手段,不是省钱噱头。
why_en: You can't ethically stage real collisions, child-darting, or extreme weather, so simulation safely generates these uncollectable scenes with perfect ground truth.
options: 有些场景不能在真实世界伦理地制造——真实碰撞、儿童冲出、极端天气——只能在仿真里生成
因为真实数据永远比合成数据便宜,合成只是省钱手段
因为合成数据没有域差(domain gap),可直接替代真实数据
因为真实相机分辨率不够,只有仿真能生成高清图
options_en: Some scenes can't be ethically staged in the real world — real collisions, child-darting, extreme weather — so they can only be generated in simulation.
Because real data is always cheaper than synthetic, so synthetic is just a cost-saving trick.
Because synthetic data has no domain gap and can directly replace real data.
Because real cameras lack resolution and only simulation can produce high-res images.
optionExplanations: 对;不可伦理制造的碰撞/儿童冲出/极端天气正是合成的独特价值,补的是采不到的尾部。
省钱不是主因,而且真实数据未必更贵;合成的核心价值在生成不可采集场景。
恰恰相反:域差是合成的头号风险,所以它是补充而非直接替代真实数据。
真实相机分辨率通常够;问题不在清晰度,而在某些场景不能真实制造。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — collisions, child-darting, and extreme weather that can't be ethically staged are synthetic's unique value, filling the uncollectable tail.
Cost isn't the main reason and real data isn't necessarily pricier; synthetic's core value is generating uncollectable scenes.
The opposite — the domain gap is synthetic's top risk, so it complements rather than directly replaces real data.
Real cameras usually have enough resolution; the issue isn't sharpness but that some scenes can't be staged for real.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被当作正确答案的标注;仿真里每个物体位置已知,真值天然免费且完美。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ground truth is the annotation treated as correct; in simulation every object's position is known, so it's free and perfect.

termDefinitions.meaning: 合成数据与真实数据的分布差异,导致纯合成训练的模型在真实数据上掉点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The domain gap is the distribution difference between synthetic and real data that makes purely synthetic-trained models drop on real data.

q: CARLA、NVIDIA DRIVE Sim 这类仿真器的核心优势是什么?
q_en: What's the core advantage of simulators like CARLA and NVIDIA DRIVE Sim?
why: 仿真器逐帧渲染都知道每个物体的精确位置,所以 ground truth 免费、边际标注成本为零;更关键的是能系统性扫参——把时间、天气、行人行为、遮挡当旋钮遍历,快速造出真实里罕见的组合。
why_en: Simulators render every object with a known position, so ground truth is free at zero marginal cost, and you can systematically sweep time, weather, behavior, and occlusion.
options: 生成的图像与真实传感器完全一致,没有任何域差
逼真场景+完美真值,零边际标注成本,还能系统性扫参(时间/天气/行为/遮挡)
能直接替代所有真实数据,把训练成本降到零
只能生成晴天白天的简单场景,不支持天气变化
options_en: The images exactly match real sensors, with no domain gap at all.
Photorealistic scenes with perfect ground truth at zero marginal labeling cost, plus a systematic parameter sweep (time/weather/behavior/occlusion).
It can directly replace all real data and drop training cost to zero.
It can only render simple sunny daytime scenes and doesn't support weather changes.
optionExplanations: 不成立:合成与真实仍有域差,这正是它不能直接替代真实数据的原因。
对;免费完美真值+系统性扫参是仿真的两大杀手锏,能快速覆盖真实里罕见的组合。
夸大了:域差在,合成只能补充(safety-critical 约 10-30%),不能全替代。
反了:CARLA/DRIVE Sim 恰恰擅长遍历天气、时间、行为等参数。
optionExplanations_en: Not true — synthetic still differs from real, which is exactly why it can't directly replace real data.
Correct — free perfect ground truth plus systematic parameter sweep are the two killer features, quickly covering combos rare in reality.
Overstated — the domain gap remains, so synthetic only supplements (about 10-30% for safety-critical), not full replacement.
Backwards — CARLA/DRIVE Sim are precisely built to sweep weather, time, and behavior.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开源自动驾驶仿真器,生成逼真带真值的驾驶场景用于训练/测试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CARLA (Car Learning to Act) is an open-source driving simulator that generates photorealistic scenes with ground truth for training and testing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 英伟达的自动驾驶仿真平台,可批量生成带完美标注的合成传感器数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NVIDIA DRIVE Sim is a driving simulation platform that mass-produces synthetic sensor data with perfect labels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把时间、天气、行为、遮挡等当旋钮系统性遍历,快速造出各种场景组合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A parameter sweep systematically varies knobs like time, weather, behavior, and occlusion to generate many scene combinations fast.

scenario: 用纯合成数据训练的检测器在仿真验证集上 mAP 很高,一上真实路测就掉。
scenario_en: A detector trained on purely synthetic data has high mAP on the synthetic validation set but drops on real road tests.
q: 这个现象叫什么,根因是什么?
q_en: What is this phenomenon called, and what's its root cause?
why: 这是域差:合成图像的纹理、光照、噪声分布和真实传感器不同,模型可能学到渲染伪影而非真实特征,一换到真实分布就掉点。它是合成数据的头号风险,必须靠域随机化/域自适应缩小。
why_en: This is the domain gap: synthetic rendering differs from real sensor statistics, so the model latches onto rendering artifacts and drops on real data.
diagram:
flowchart LR S["纯合成训练"] --> V["合成验证 mAP 高"] S --> RT["真实路测 mAP 掉"] RT --> G["域差
特征分布不匹配"]
options: 过拟合导致,只要增大合成数据量即可解决
标签噪声导致,重新标注合成数据即可修复
域差:合成渲染与真实传感器特征分布不匹配,模型学到渲染伪影
欠拟合导致,把网络加深加宽就能修
options_en: Overfitting, fixable by increasing the amount of synthetic data.
Label noise, fixable by re-annotating the synthetic data.
The domain gap: a feature-distribution mismatch between synthetic rendering and real sensors, so the model learned rendering artifacts.
Underfitting, fixable by deepening the network.
optionExplanations: 不是过拟合:模型在合成验证上也好,问题是合成与真实分布不同,加更多合成数据只会强化错误特征。
合成数据真值是完美的,不存在标签噪声;掉点来自分布差异不是标错。
对;域差=合成渲染与真实传感器特征分布不匹配,模型学了渲染伪影,换真实分布就掉。
不是欠拟合:合成验证 mAP 很高说明拟合充分,问题在跨域泛化。
optionExplanations_en: Not overfitting — the model is good on synthetic val too; the issue is synthetic vs real distributions, and more synthetic just reinforces wrong features.
Synthetic ground truth is perfect, so there's no label noise; the drop comes from distribution mismatch, not mislabels.
Correct — the domain gap is a feature-distribution mismatch between synthetic rendering and real sensors, so the model learned artifacts and drops on real.
Not underfitting — high synthetic-val mAP shows it fits fine; the issue is cross-domain generalization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 合成与真实数据的分布差异;纯合成训练在真实数据上掉点的根因。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The domain gap is the distribution difference between synthetic and real data, the reason purely synthetic training drops on real data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检测精度指标:各类别平均精度再取均值,越高越好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mAP (mean Average Precision) averages per-class average precision as a detection accuracy metric; higher is better.

q: 缩小域差的域随机化 vs 域自适应怎么分工?
q_en: How do domain randomization and domain adaptation divide the work of closing the domain gap?
why: 域随机化在合成端猛加视觉变化(纹理、光照、相机噪声),逼模型学变化无关的不变特征;域自适应反过来用风格迁移让合成帧看起来像真实传感器数据。一个"加噪变宽"、一个"贴近真实",互补使用。
why_en: Domain randomization widens synthetic visual variation so the model learns invariant features, while domain adaptation uses style transfer to make synthetic look real — complementary approaches.
tradeoff: 域随机化(加大变化学不变特征) vs 域自适应(把合成分布贴近真实)
options: 两者都是加大合成数据量的别名,本质相同
域随机化靠人工重标,域自适应靠增大模型
域自适应随机化纹理光照;域随机化做风格迁移
域随机化随机化视觉参数学不变特征;域自适应用风格迁移贴近真实,互补
options_en: Both are aliases for adding more synthetic data and are essentially the same.
Domain randomization relies on human re-labeling; domain adaptation on a bigger model.
Domain adaptation randomizes textures and lighting; domain randomization does style transfer.
Domain randomization randomizes visual params so the model learns invariant features; domain adaptation uses style transfer to make synthetic look real — complementary.
optionExplanations: 两者是缩域差的不同机制,不是"加数据量"的别名,混为一谈会错过它们的互补性。
都不涉及人工重标或单纯加大模型;它们改的是数据分布,不是靠人力或容量。
说反了:随机纹理光照是域随机化;风格迁移是域自适应。
对;一个在合成端加大变化学不变特征,一个把合成风格拉近真实,常一起用。
optionExplanations_en: They're different gap-closing mechanisms, not aliases for 'more data', and conflating them misses their complementarity.
Neither involves human re-labeling or just a bigger model; they change the data distribution, not via headcount or capacity.
Backwards — randomizing textures/lighting is domain randomization; style transfer is domain adaptation.
Correct — one widens synthetic variation for invariant features, the other pulls synthetic style toward real, often used together.

termDefinitions.meaning: 随机化纹理、光照、相机噪声等视觉参数,逼模型学与渲染无关的不变特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain randomization randomizes visual params like textures, lighting, and camera noise so the model learns rendering-invariant features.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用风格迁移等手段让合成帧在特征上贴近真实传感器数据,从另一端缩小域差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain adaptation uses techniques like style transfer to make synthetic frames resemble real sensor data, closing the gap from the other side.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保留内容、换上目标域外观的技术,这里把合成帧改造得像真实传感器画面。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Style transfer keeps content but restyles appearance to a target domain, here making synthetic frames look like real sensor images.

scenario: 要决定安全关键类别的训练数据里,合成数据该占多大比例。
scenario_en: You must decide what fraction of training data for safety-critical classes should be synthetic.
q: 行业上合成数据在安全关键类别里的典型占比与定位是什么?
q_en: What's the typical synthetic share and role for safety-critical classes in industry?
why: 行业用合成补充安全关键类别训练的约 10-30%,真实数据仍是主干。这不是公式而是经验区间,定位是"补充不可采集的尾部",不是替代——比例越高越放大域差,所以保守起步、在真实验证集上测尾部类 mAP。
why_en: Industry supplements about 10-30% of safety-critical training with synthetic while real data stays the backbone; it's an empirical range framing synthetic as a complement, not a replacement.
options: 80-90%,合成便宜,应尽量多用、真实数据只留少量点缀
50/50 固定对半,是所有任务的最优比例
约 10-30% 用于补充安全关键类别,真实数据仍是主干,合成是补充不是替代
0%,合成数据有域差,永远不该用于安全关键类别
options_en: 80-90% — synthetic is cheap, so use as much as possible with only a sprinkle of real data.
A fixed 50/50 split, the optimal ratio for all tasks.
About 10-30% to supplement safety-critical classes, with real data as the backbone — synthetic complements, not replaces.
0% — synthetic has a domain gap and should never be used for safety-critical classes.

termDefinitions.term: synthetic supplement ratio 合成补充比例
termDefinitions.meaning: 合成数据占训练数据的比例;安全关键类别经验区间约 10-30%,真实数据为主干。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The synthetic supplement ratio is synthetic's share of training data; for safety-critical classes it's empirically about 10-30% with real data as the backbone.

scenario: 有人主张把安全关键类别的合成数据占比拉到 50% 以上,好"快速补齐罕见类"。
scenario_en: Someone argues pushing synthetic above 50% for safety-critical classes to 'quickly fill rare classes'.
q: 把合成占比拉高到 >30% 有什么风险,该怎么做?
q_en: What's the risk of pushing synthetic above 30%, and what should you do?
why: 占比 >30% 会放大域差:合成越多,模型越可能拟合渲染伪影,除非配合激进的域随机化/自适应。做法是保守起步,并在真实验证集上测尾部类 mAP,用真实指标决定能否加比例。
why_en: Above 30% amplifies the domain gap unless paired with aggressive randomization/adaptation, so start conservative and measure tail-class mAP on real validation.
tradeoff: 高合成占比(快速补罕见类) vs 放大域差(真实上掉点,除非激进域适配)
options: 没风险,合成占比越高越好,能最快补齐罕见类
唯一风险是训练变慢,和域差、真实精度无关
会放大域差,除非配激进域随机化/自适应;应保守起步,在真实验证集测尾部类 mAP
风险是合成数据太贵,应改回纯真实数据、彻底放弃合成
options_en: No risk; the higher the synthetic share the better, filling rare classes fastest.
The only risk is slower training, unrelated to the domain gap or real accuracy.
It amplifies the domain gap unless you use aggressive randomization/adaptation; start conservative and measure tail-class mAP on real validation.
The risk is synthetic being too expensive, so revert to pure real data and drop synthetic entirely.
optionExplanations: 占比越高越放大域差,真实上会掉点,不是"越高越好"。
训练速度不是核心;核心风险是域差被放大、真实精度下降。
对;>30% 放大域差,必须配激进域适配,并以真实验证集尾部类 mAP 为准绳保守加比例。
合成通常更便宜,不是成本问题;彻底放弃合成又丢了补不可采集尾部的能力。
optionExplanations_en: A higher share amplifies the domain gap and drops real accuracy, so 'higher is better' is wrong.
Training speed isn't the core; the core risk is an amplified domain gap and falling real accuracy.
Correct — above 30% amplifies the gap, so pair with aggressive adaptation and gate increases on real-validation tail-class mAP.
Synthetic is usually cheaper, so it's not a cost issue, and dropping it entirely loses the ability to fill the uncollectable tail.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只在罕见/安全关键类别上算的 mAP,是检验合成是否真帮到长尾的指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tail-class mAP is mAP computed only on rare/safety-critical classes, the metric that checks whether synthetic actually helps the long tail.

scenario: 3D 点云标注约 5-10 美元/帧,面对数百万帧,全标预算爆炸,但又要保住安全关键类的 mAP。
scenario_en: 3D point-cloud labeling costs ~$5-10/frame across millions of frames; labeling all blows the budget, but you must keep safety-critical mAP.
q: 怎么在有限预算下决定优先标哪些帧?
q_en: How do you decide which frames to label first under a limited budget?
why: 3D 点云每帧 5-10 美元 × 数百万帧,全标不现实,所以只标最有信息量的帧。主动学习用 acquisition function 从大池子里挑出模型最不确定或最不同的帧优先标,用最小标注量换最大精度提升。
why_en: At $5-10/frame across millions, labeling all is infeasible, so active learning uses an acquisition function to pick the most informative frames, buying the most accuracy per label.
tradeoff: 主动学习(只标最有信息量帧,省 30-50%) vs 全标/随机标(覆盖全但预算爆炸)
options: 把预算平均摊到所有帧,随机抽一部分来标
主动学习:让采集函数(acquisition)按信息量给帧打分,优先标高分帧
只标模型已经很确定的帧,保证标注质量高
干脆不标 3D 点云,只用免费的 2D 框凑合
options_en: Spread the budget evenly and randomly sample a subset of frames to label.
Active learning: let an acquisition function score frames by informativeness and label the top ones first.
Only label frames the model is already confident on, to keep label quality high.
Skip 3D point clouds entirely and make do with free 2D boxes.
whenOtherWins: 若未标注池本身就小、或标注很便宜,随机全标更简单;主动学习的价值在预算紧、单帧标注贵(如 3D 点云)时才凸显。
optionExplanations: 随机抽按真实频率走,大多是模型已会的常规帧,信息量低、浪费昂贵的 3D 标注预算。
对;采集函数按信息量给帧打分,把有限预算投到最能提升精度的样本上。
标已确定的帧信息增益几乎为零——模型本来就会,等于花钱买没用的标注。
放弃 3D 点云就丢了融合测距/轨迹能力,安全关键类的 mAP 保不住。
optionExplanations_en: Random sampling follows real frequency, mostly frames the model already knows, low-information and wasting costly 3D budget.
Correct — the acquisition function picks the most uncertain/different frames, spending limited budget where accuracy gains are largest.
Labeling confident frames yields near-zero information gain — the model already knows them, so you pay for useless labels.
Dropping 3D point clouds loses fusion distance/trajectory, and safety-critical mAP can't be held.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让模型挑出最有信息量的样本优先标注,以最小标注量换最大精度提升。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Active learning lets the model pick the most informative samples to label first, buying the most accuracy per label.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给每个未标注样本打分、决定优先标谁的准则,如不确定性或多样性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An acquisition function scores each unlabeled sample to decide labeling priority, e.g., by uncertainty or diversity.

q: 把主动学习循环排成正确顺序:
q_en: Order the active-learning loop correctly:
steps: 在大规模未标注池上推理
acquisition function 选出最有信息量的帧
在种子集(seed set)上训练模型
人工标注选中的帧,并入训练集重训
why: 主动学习循环:先用种子集训练→在未标注池上推理→acquisition function 选最有信息量的帧→人工标注并入重训,再回到推理。每转一圈只标最该标的帧,预算利用率最高。
why_en: The loop trains on a seed set, infers on the unlabeled pool, has the acquisition function pick the most informative frames, then labels and retrains, maximizing budget efficiency each turn.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["种子集训练"] --> B["未标注池推理"]
  B --> C["acquisition 选信息量最大帧"]
  C --> D["人工标注并重训"]
  D --> B

termDefinitions.meaning: 主动学习起步用的一小批已标注数据,用来训练首个模型再去挑样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A seed set is the small initial labeled batch used to train the first model before it selects samples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给未标注样本打分、决定优先标谁的准则(不确定性/多样性/混合)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An acquisition function scores unlabeled samples to decide labeling priority (uncertainty, diversity, or hybrid).

q: 主动学习里的不确定性采样(uncertainty sampling)选哪些帧?
q_en: Which frames does uncertainty sampling pick in active learning?
why: 不确定性采样挑模型置信度最低的帧——比如"行人"只给 0.52 的帧比给 0.99 的更该标。低置信往往意味着模型没见过或拿不准,标了信息增益最大。
why_en: Uncertainty sampling picks the lowest-confidence frames — a 0.52 'pedestrian' beats a 0.99 one — because low confidence means high information gain if labeled.
options: 模型置信度最低的帧(0.52 比 0.99 更该标),信息增益最大
模型置信度最高的帧,确保标注不出错
与训练集差异最大的帧,覆盖没见过的条件
随机抽取的帧,认为这样能避免任何选择偏差
options_en: The lowest-confidence frames (a 0.52 'pedestrian' over a 0.99 one) because information gain is highest.
The highest-confidence frames to make sure labeling has no errors.
The frames most different from the training set to cover unseen conditions.
Randomly sampled frames to avoid any selection bias.
optionExplanations: 对;低置信帧是模型拿不准的,标了信息增益最大,0.52 比 0.99 更值得优先标。
高置信帧模型本来就会,信息增益接近零,标它是浪费预算。
那是多样性采样的判据(与训练集最不同),不是不确定性采样。
随机抽不看模型状态,信息量偏低,正是主动学习要超越的基线。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — low-confidence frames are ones the model is unsure about, giving the highest information gain, so 0.52 beats 0.99.
High-confidence frames are ones the model already knows, near-zero information gain, so labeling them wastes budget.
That's the diversity-sampling criterion (most different from the training set), not uncertainty sampling.
Random sampling ignores model state, giving lower information, the baseline active learning aims to beat.

termDefinitions.term: uncertainty sampling 不确定性采样
termDefinitions.meaning: 优先标注模型置信度最低的样本,因为它们信息增益最大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Uncertainty sampling prioritizes labeling the model's lowest-confidence samples because they carry the most information gain.

q: 多样性采样(diversity sampling)按什么标准选帧,解决什么问题?
q_en: By what criterion does diversity sampling pick frames, and what problem does it solve?
why: 多样性采样挑与训练集最不相似的帧,覆盖欠代表的条件——雾天、眩光、奇怪视角。它防止只盯着一类难例,把标注预算摊到没见过的场景上,补的是覆盖面。
why_en: Diversity sampling picks frames most dissimilar to the training set to cover underrepresented conditions like fog, glare, and odd angles, spreading budget across unseen scenes.
options: 选置信度最低的帧,专攻模型最拿不准的样本
选与训练集最不相似的帧,覆盖欠代表条件(雾天、眩光、奇怪视角)
选置信度最高的帧,巩固模型已学会的场景
按拍摄时间顺序选最新的帧
options_en: Pick the lowest-confidence frames to focus on what the model is most unsure about.
Pick frames most dissimilar to the training set to cover underrepresented conditions (fog, glare, odd angles).
Pick the highest-confidence frames to reinforce scenes the model already knows.
Pick the newest frames in capture-time order.
optionExplanations: 那是不确定性采样的判据(最低置信),不是多样性采样看的"与训练集差异"。
对;多样性采样按与训练集的差异挑帧,专门补雾天/眩光/奇角这类欠代表条件。
选高置信帧巩固已学会的,和多样性"补没见过的"目标相反。
按时间选是时间偏好,和覆盖多样条件无关,可能全是相似场景。
optionExplanations_en: That's the uncertainty-sampling criterion (lowest confidence), not diversity's 'difference from the training set'.
Correct — diversity sampling picks by dissimilarity to the training set, specifically covering underrepresented conditions like fog, glare, odd angles.
Picking high-confidence frames reinforces the known, opposite to diversity's goal of covering the unseen.
Time-order selection is a time preference unrelated to covering diverse conditions and may be all similar scenes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 优先标注与训练集最不相似的样本,补齐欠代表的条件和场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Diversity sampling prioritizes samples most unlike the training set, filling underrepresented conditions and scenes.

scenario: 只用不确定性采样时,模型反复挑到一堆彼此相似的难例(同一种雾天场景),预算被重复样本吃掉。
scenario_en: With uncertainty sampling alone, the model repeatedly picks a cluster of similar hard cases (the same foggy scene), and budget is eaten by redundancy.
q: 混合采集(hybrid)相比单用不确定性采样好在哪?
q_en: How is hybrid acquisition better than uncertainty sampling alone?
why: 单用不确定性会反复挑到相似难例,冗余浪费预算;混合把不确定性和多样性结合,既挑模型拿不准的,又保证彼此不相似,得到"有信息量又不冗余"的一批。
why_en: Uncertainty alone repeatedly picks similar hard cases and wastes budget on redundancy; hybrid combines uncertainty with diversity for informative and non-redundant samples.
tradeoff: 混合(信息量+多样性,不冗余) vs 纯不确定性(信息量高但可能扎堆相似难例)
options: 混合更快,因为它跳过推理直接选帧
混合只用多样性,彻底放弃不确定性
混合无需 acquisition function,随机选即可
混合结合不确定性+多样性,既挑拿不准的又保证不相似,避免反复选相似难例
options_en: Hybrid is faster because it skips inference and picks frames directly.
Hybrid uses only diversity and drops uncertainty entirely.
Hybrid needs no acquisition function; random selection is enough.
Hybrid combines uncertainty + diversity, picking uncertain yet dissimilar frames, avoiding repeatedly selecting similar hard cases.
optionExplanations: 混合仍要在池上推理拿置信度,并不跳过推理,也不以"更快"取胜。
只用多样性会丢掉"挑模型拿不准"的价值;混合是两者结合,不是二选一。
混合恰恰需要 acquisition function 同时算不确定性和多样性,不是随机。
对;混合兼顾信息量和多样性,专治不确定性单用时扎堆相似难例的冗余问题。
optionExplanations_en: Hybrid still infers on the pool to get confidences, so it doesn't skip inference or win on 'faster'.
Diversity-only loses the value of picking the model's uncertain cases; hybrid combines both, not either-or.
Hybrid specifically needs an acquisition function computing both uncertainty and diversity, not random selection.
Correct — hybrid balances information and diversity, fixing the redundancy of uncertainty-only clustering on similar hard cases.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时用不确定性和多样性挑样本,兼顾信息量与非冗余。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hybrid acquisition uses both uncertainty and diversity to select samples, balancing information gain and non-redundancy.

q: 为什么主动学习能在没有专门触发工程的情况下"顺手"挖出长尾样本?
q_en: Why does active learning surface long-tail samples 'for free' without dedicated trigger engineering?
why: 模型不确定的检测往往正是罕见/新奇物体——因为训练里没见过所以拿不准。所以不确定性采样天然把这些尾部样本浮上来,不必像触发式采集那样专门写启发式规则。
why_en: Uncertain detections are often rare or novel objects the model hasn't seen, so uncertainty sampling naturally surfaces tail samples without hand-written triggers.
options: 因为主动学习会随机遍历所有帧,总会碰到罕见样本
因为它只挑高置信帧,而罕见物体恰好置信度高
因为模型不确定的检测往往就是罕见/新奇物体,不确定性采样自然把尾部浮出来
因为它需要人工先写好触发规则,才知道罕见样本在哪
options_en: Because active learning randomly scans all frames and always stumbles on rare samples.
Because it only picks high-confidence frames, and rare objects happen to be high-confidence.
Because uncertain detections are often rare or novel objects, so uncertainty sampling naturally surfaces the tail.
Because it first needs hand-written trigger rules to know where rare samples are.
optionExplanations: 主动学习不是随机遍历,而是按信息量选;随机反而抽不到罕见类。
反了:罕见物体模型没见过、置信度低,不是高置信。
对;没见过的物体让模型犯难,低置信即信号,不确定性采样顺手把尾部捞出来,省了触发工程。
恰相反:主动学习不用手写触发规则,靠模型不确定性自动发现罕见样本。
optionExplanations_en: Active learning isn't a random scan but an information-driven pick; random would miss rare classes.
Backwards — rare objects the model hasn't seen are low-confidence, not high.
Correct — unseen objects stump the model, low confidence is the signal, and uncertainty sampling scoops the tail for free.
The opposite — active learning needs no hand-written triggers; model uncertainty discovers rare samples automatically.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A novel object is one outside the training distribution the model hasn't seen, usually showing up as a low-confidence detection.

q: 主动学习带来的成本收益该怎么量化表达?
q_en: How should you quantify the cost benefit of active learning?
why: 主动学习把标注成本削 30-50%,同时维持甚至提升安全关键类的 mAP。量化时要挂到具体标注类型:"把 3D 点云标注量减少约 40%",这样收益既有数字又能对上最贵的那档预算(5-10 美元/帧)。
why_en: Active learning cuts labeling cost 30-50% while maintaining or improving safety-critical mAP; quantify it against a specific annotation type, like 'reduces 3D point-cloud volume ~40%'.

说"节省成本"但不绑定具体标注类型,越笼统越安全

削 30-50% 标注成本、维持安全关键类 mAP,如"3D 点云量减 40%"

Promise over 90% savings, since active learning is always cheaper than labeling everything.
Cut labeling cost 30-50% while maintaining/improving safety-critical mAP, tied to a type: 'reduces 3D point-cloud volume ~40%'.

scenario: 标注预算有限,各安全关键类别的当前 mAP 不一样:行人 0.82、轮椅使用者 0.61、路面碎片 0.55。
scenario_en: Labeling budget is limited and safety-critical classes have different current mAP: pedestrian 0.82, wheelchair user 0.61, road debris 0.55.
q: Staff+ 会怎么在这些类之间分配标注预算?
q_en: How would a Staff+ engineer allocate labeling budget across these classes?
why: Staff+ 把标注预算按"最低尾部类 mAP"倾斜:哪个安全关键类最弱(路面碎片 0.55),就优先给它加标注/主动采集。这样预算跟着最大安全短板走,而不是平均撒或投给已经很好的类。
why_en: Staff+ allocates budget proportional to the lowest tail-class mAP, pouring labels into the weakest safety-critical class first rather than spreading evenly.
tradeoff: 按最低尾部类 mAP 倾斜(补最大安全短板) vs 平均分配(短板依旧漏检)
options: 平均分给三类,保证公平,每类都加一样多
优先投给 mAP 最高的行人(0.82),巩固已有优势
优先投给 mAP 最低的路面碎片(0.55),预算按最低尾部类倾斜补安全短板
只投给样本量最大的类,数据多才好训
options_en: Split evenly across the three classes for fairness, adding the same to each.
Prioritize the highest-mAP pedestrian (0.82) to consolidate the existing strength.
Prioritize the lowest-mAP road debris (0.55), skewing budget to the weakest tail class to fix the biggest safety gap.
Invest only in the class with the most samples, since more data trains better.
whenOtherWins: 若某个低 mAP 类的瓶颈不是数据量而是标注定义或标签噪声,那先修标注规范比继续砸预算更有效。
optionExplanations: 平均分配让最弱的碎片类依旧漏检,安全短板没补上,不是按风险分配。
行人已 0.82,边际收益小;把钱花在已经好的类上,最危险的短板反而没管。
对;预算跟着最低尾部类 mAP 走,先补路面碎片这个最大安全短板,风险下降最快。
样本最多的类往往已经够好;按样本量分配和"补最弱安全类"的目标不一致。
optionExplanations_en: Even splitting leaves the weakest debris class still missed, the safety gap unfilled — not risk-based allocation.
Pedestrian is already 0.82 with small marginal gains; spending on the strong class leaves the most dangerous gap unaddressed.
Correct — budget follows the lowest tail-class mAP, fixing road debris first as the biggest safety gap where risk drops fastest.
The class with most samples is often already good; sample-count allocation conflicts with fixing the weakest safety class.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把有限标注预算按最低尾部类 mAP 倾斜,优先补最大的安全短板。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Budget allocation skews limited labeling budget toward the lowest tail-class mAP, fixing the biggest safety gap first.

scenario: 自动驾驶车(AV)每 100ms 要出一次决策，目标检测器跑在车载 Jetson 边缘硬件上，行人和骑车人是安全攸关目标。
scenario_en: An autonomous vehicle (AV) must decide every 100ms, its object detector runs on an on-board Jetson edge box, and pedestrians and cyclists are safety-critical targets.
q: 边缘目标检测的核心权衡轴是什么？
q_en: What is the central tradeoff axis for edge object detection?
why: 核心轴是准确率(mAP) vs 边缘硬件上的推理延迟：一个 COCO 榜单第一但在 Jetson 上只有 2 FPS 的模型来不及刹车，一个超快但漏检小孩的模型会出人命。两头都不能要，要在这条轴上找够快又不漏关键目标的点。
why_en: The axis is accuracy (mAP) versus inference latency on edge hardware: a SOTA-mAP model at 2 FPS on a Jetson brakes too late, and an ultra-fast model that misses a child kills someone, so you tune for fast-enough-without-missing.
diagram:
flowchart TB A["高 mAP 但 2 FPS on Jetson
决策太慢"] --> C{"边缘权衡
准确率 vs 延迟"} B["超快但漏检行人
安全事故"] --> C C --> G["可用检测器
够快 + 不漏关键目标"]
options: 只看 COCO 榜单 mAP，越高越安全，延迟不是检测器选型该操心的事
准确率(mAP) vs 边缘硬件推理延迟的权衡：既要够快出决策，又不能漏检安全攸关目标
只看 FPS，速度越快越好，准确率可以为吞吐让路，速度是唯一硬约束
只需在云端 GPU 上把吞吐做满，车载边缘硬件的算力不影响架构选择
options_en: Only look at COCO mAP — higher is safer, and latency is not something detector selection should worry about.
Accuracy (mAP) versus edge inference latency: fast enough to decide in time, yet never missing a safety-critical object.
Only look at FPS — faster is always better, and accuracy can yield to throughput since speed is the sole hard constraint.
Just maximize throughput on cloud GPUs; the on-board edge box's compute does not affect architecture choice.
optionExplanations: 只追 mAP 会选出在 Jetson 上跑不动的模型，2 FPS = 每帧 500ms，AV 的 100ms 预算直接爆掉。
对；两个失败方向(太慢、漏检)都致命，所以设计从一开始就是这条准确率-延迟轴上的约束优化。
只追速度会漏检行人，一次漏检就是一条人命，速度不能是唯一约束。
检测器跑在车上，云端吞吐救不了车载延迟，边缘硬件的算力和访存正是约束来源。
optionExplanations_en: Chasing only mAP picks a model that can't run on Jetson — 2 FPS means 500ms per frame, blowing the AV's 100ms budget.
Correct — both failure directions (too slow, missed detection) are fatal, so the design is a constrained optimization on this accuracy-latency axis from the start.
Chasing only speed misses pedestrians, and one miss is a life, so speed cannot be the only constraint.
The detector runs on the car; cloud throughput can't fix on-board latency, and the edge hardware's compute and memory are the constraint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 目标检测的主指标：对所有类别、多个 IoU 阈值求平均精度，衡量检测又准又全的程度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mAP (mean Average Precision) is the main detection metric, averaging precision across classes and IoU thresholds to measure how accurately and completely a model detects objects.

termDefinitions.meaning: 自动驾驶车辆，检测器在车载算力上实时运行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AV (Autonomous Vehicle) is a self-driving car whose detector must run in real time on on-board compute.

termDefinitions.meaning: NVIDIA 的边缘 GPU 模块，常用作车载/嵌入式 AI 推理硬件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Jetson is NVIDIA's edge GPU module, commonly used as on-board or embedded AI inference hardware.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒处理的帧数，2 FPS 即每帧耗时 500ms。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FPS (Frames Per Second) is how many frames are processed per second; 2 FPS means 500ms per frame.

q: 把边缘目标检测优化拆成四大支柱，哪个选项完整列全了？
q_en: Which option lists all four pillars of optimizing edge object detection?
why: 四大支柱是:架构族选型、压缩(剪枝+量化)、硬件感知 NAS、置信度校准。它们分别管:选哪种模型、怎么把模型压小压快、让搜索算法替你挑架构、以及让置信度可信到能支撑 fail-safe。
why_en: The four pillars are architecture families, compression (pruning plus quantization), hardware-aware NAS, and confidence calibration — covering which model, how to shrink and speed it, letting search pick the architecture, and making confidence trustworthy enough for fail-safe.
options: 架构族选型、压缩(剪枝+量化)、硬件感知 NAS、置信度校准
数据增强、迁移学习、超参搜索、L2 正则化
架构族选型、压缩、分布式训练调度、云端 A/B 测试
换更大的 backbone、提高输入分辨率、增加 anchor、加深 FPN
options_en: Architecture families, compression (pruning + quantization), hardware-aware NAS, confidence calibration.
Data augmentation, transfer learning, hyperparameter search, L2 regularization.
Architecture families, compression, distributed training orchestration, cloud A/B testing.
Swap in a bigger backbone, raise input resolution, add more anchors, deepen the FPN.
optionExplanations: 对;这四条正好覆盖选型、压缩、自动搜索、可信度,是本课组织边缘优化的主线。
这些是通用训练技巧,不针对'边缘延迟 vs 准确率'这条主轴,漏了压缩、NAS、校准。
分布式训练和云端 A/B 是训练/上线基建,不是把模型塞进车载边缘的手段,替换掉了 NAS 和校准。
这些做法只会把模型做得更大更慢,和边缘约束背道而驰,不是优化支柱。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — these four cover selection, compression, automated search, and trustworthiness, the backbone of edge optimization here.
These are generic training tricks, not aimed at the edge latency-vs-accuracy axis, and they drop compression, NAS, and calibration.
Distributed training and cloud A/B are training/rollout infra, not ways to fit a model onto an on-board box, replacing NAS and calibration.
These only make the model bigger and slower, opposite to the edge constraint, so they are not optimization pillars.

termDefinitions.meaning: 神经架构搜索:用搜索算法自动找网络结构,而不是人手工设计。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NAS (Neural Architecture Search) uses a search algorithm to automatically find network architectures instead of hand-designing them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检测器的主干特征提取网络,通常是一个 CNN。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The backbone is the detector's main feature-extraction network, usually a CNN.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征金字塔网络:融合不同尺度特征以检测大小不一的目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FPN (Feature Pyramid Network) fuses features at multiple scales to detect objects of varying sizes.

scenario: 某检测器在 Jetson 上跑 2 FPS,而这辆 AV 要求每 100ms 出一次感知决策。
scenario_en: A detector runs at 2 FPS on Jetson, while the AV requires a perception decision every 100ms.
q: 2 FPS 对 100ms 决策预算意味着什么设计含义？
q_en: What design implication does 2 FPS carry for a 100ms decision budget?
why: FPS = Frames Per Second,2 FPS 即每帧 1000/2 = 500ms。100ms 是给定的 SLO 目标(不是公式推出来的),500ms 比它慢 5 倍,车看到行人时已经开过去了。含义:这个模型直接出局,必须靠压缩/换架构/NAS 把每帧压到 100ms 内。
why_en: FPS is frames per second, so 2 FPS is 1000/2 = 500ms per frame; against the given 100ms SLO that's 5x too slow, so this model is out and you must compress, swap architecture, or NAS it under 100ms per frame.
options: 500ms/帧,正好卡在 100ms 预算边缘,微调一下超参就能达标
2 FPS 说明吞吐足够,瓶颈只在准确率,延迟不用管
每帧 500ms,是 100ms 预算的 5 倍,模型直接出局,得靠压缩/换架构把每帧压进 100ms
FPS 越低反而延迟越低,2 FPS 其实比 30 FPS 更适合实时决策
options_en: 500ms per frame sits right at the 100ms budget, so a bit of hyperparameter tuning meets it.
2 FPS means throughput is plenty and the only bottleneck is accuracy, so latency can be ignored.
500ms per frame is 5x the 100ms budget, so the model is out and must be compressed or swapped to fit each frame under 100ms.
Lower FPS means lower latency, so 2 FPS is actually better for real-time decisions than 30 FPS.

q: YOLO 系列是怎么做到边缘上超低延迟的？
q_en: How does the YOLO family achieve ultra-low latency on the edge?
why: YOLO = You Only Look Once,单阶段检测:整张图一次 CNN 前向就同时出框和类别,没有两阶段的区域提议环节。YOLOv5/v8 用 anchor-free 头,边缘 GPU 上可到 sub-10ms;代价是对小目标和被遮挡目标较弱。
why_en: YOLO (You Only Look Once) is single-stage: one CNN forward pass over the whole image predicts boxes and classes at once, with no separate region-proposal stage, and v5/v8 use anchor-free heads to hit sub-10ms on edge GPUs at the cost of weaker small or occluded objects.
options: 两阶段:先跑区域提议网络选候选框,再逐框分类,所以精度高但延迟低
把图切成很多小块,每块单独跑一个大模型,再投票聚合结果
单阶段:整张图一次 CNN 前向同时出框和类别,anchor-free 头,边缘上 sub-10ms
纯 Transformer 注意力全局建模,天生适合边缘的低延迟场景
options_en: Two-stage: run a region-proposal network for candidate boxes, then classify each box, giving high accuracy and low latency.
Split the image into many patches, run a large model on each patch, then vote to aggregate.
Single-stage: one CNN forward pass over the whole image predicts boxes and classes at once with anchor-free heads, hitting sub-10ms on the edge.
Pure Transformer attention with global modeling, naturally suited to low-latency edge scenarios.
optionExplanations: 两阶段(如 Faster R-CNN)恰恰因为多一步区域提议而更慢,YOLO 的卖点正是省掉它。
分块跑大模型会成倍增加计算,和 YOLO 的单次前向低延迟相反。
对;一次前向 = 一次算完,anchor-free 又省掉 anchor 匹配,这是它 sub-10ms 的根源。
纯 Transformer(DETR)延迟高、访存大,是边缘上最不适合的一类,不是 YOLO。
optionExplanations_en: Two-stage detectors like Faster R-CNN are slower precisely because of the extra proposal step, which YOLO's whole pitch is to drop.
Running a large model per patch multiplies compute, the opposite of YOLO's single low-latency forward pass.
Correct — one forward pass computes everything, and anchor-free removes anchor matching, which is the root of its sub-10ms.
Pure Transformers (DETR) have high latency and memory and are the worst fit for the edge, not YOLO.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单阶段检测器,整张图一次前向同时预测框和类别。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: YOLO (You Only Look Once) is a single-stage detector that predicts boxes and classes in one forward pass over the whole image.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不预设一堆候选框(anchor),直接回归目标框,省掉锚框匹配这步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Anchor-free heads regress boxes directly instead of matching against a preset grid of anchor boxes, removing the anchor-matching step.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次前向就出最终检测,不做单独的区域提议阶段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Single-stage means the final detections come from one forward pass, with no separate region-proposal stage.

q: EfficientDet 靠什么在中等延迟下拿到更强的小目标检测？
q_en: What lets EfficientDet get stronger small-object detection at moderate latency?
why: 两件东西:BiFPN(双向特征金字塔)做多尺度双向特征融合,让高层语义和低层细节互相流动,利于小目标;compound scaling 联合调节输入分辨率、深度、宽度。D0/D1 边缘可用,小目标比 YOLO 强,代价是延迟略高。
why_en: Two things: a BiFPN (bidirectional feature pyramid) fuses multi-scale features both ways so semantics and fine detail flow together, helping small objects, and compound scaling jointly tunes resolution, depth, and width; D0/D1 are edge-viable and beat YOLO on small objects at slightly higher latency.
options: 靠把 anchor 数量翻十倍来覆盖更多小框,所以小目标更准
靠纯注意力去掉 NMS,让重叠小目标不再互相压制
靠只保留最高分辨率一层特征图,牺牲大目标换小目标
靠 BiFPN 双向多尺度融合 + compound scaling 联合调分辨率/深度/宽度
options_en: By multiplying the number of anchors tenfold to cover more small boxes, so small objects get more accurate.
By using pure attention to drop NMS so overlapping small objects no longer suppress each other.
By keeping only the single highest-resolution feature map, trading big objects for small ones.
By a BiFPN for bidirectional multi-scale fusion plus compound scaling that jointly tunes resolution, depth, and width.
optionExplanations: 堆 anchor 只增计算不解决多尺度融合,EfficientDet 的小目标优势来自特征融合而非 anchor 数量。
去 NMS+纯注意力是 DETR 的做法,不是 EfficientDet。
只留一层反而丢掉多尺度信息,和 BiFPN 融合多尺度的思路正相反。
对;双向金字塔让细节与语义互相补,compound scaling 保证放大时三个维度协调,兼顾小目标与延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Piling on anchors only adds compute without solving multi-scale fusion; EfficientDet's small-object edge comes from feature fusion, not anchor count.
Dropping NMS with pure attention is DETR's approach, not EfficientDet's.
Keeping one layer throws away multi-scale information, the opposite of BiFPN's multi-scale fusion.
Correct — the bidirectional pyramid lets detail and semantics reinforce each other, and compound scaling keeps all three dimensions coordinated when scaling up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一族用 BiFPN 和 compound scaling 的高效检测器,D0-D7 由小到大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: EfficientDet is a family of efficient detectors using BiFPN and compound scaling, from small D0 to large D7.

termDefinitions.meaning: 双向特征金字塔:特征在自顶向下和自底向上两个方向融合,兼顾语义与细节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BiFPN (Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network) fuses features in both top-down and bottom-up directions to combine semantics and detail.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时按一组系数放大输入分辨率、网络深度和宽度,而不是只加深或只加宽。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Compound scaling jointly scales input resolution, depth, and width by a coordinated set of coefficients rather than one dimension alone.

q: 补全 EfficientDet 的两个核心组件：
q_en: Fill in EfficientDet's two core components:
text: EfficientDet 用 {{BiFPN}}(双向特征金字塔)做多尺度特征融合,再配合 {{compound scaling}} 联合调节输入分辨率、网络深度和宽度。
text_en: EfficientDet uses a {{BiFPN}} (bidirectional feature pyramid) for multi-scale fusion, plus {{compound scaling}} to jointly tune input resolution, depth, and width.
why: BiFPN 负责'把不同尺度特征融好'(利于小目标),compound scaling 负责'放大时三个维度一起动'(不失衡)。两者合起来让 EfficientDet 在中等延迟拿到强小目标检测。
why_en: BiFPN handles fusing multi-scale features for small objects, while compound scaling grows resolution, depth, and width together so scaling stays balanced.

termDefinitions.meaning: 双向特征金字塔,自顶向下+自底向上融合多尺度特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BiFPN (Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network) fuses multi-scale features both top-down and bottom-up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按协调系数同时放大分辨率、深度、宽度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Compound scaling scales resolution, depth, and width together by coordinated coefficients.

q: DETR 相比 YOLO/EfficientDet 在设计上最大的不同是什么？
q_en: What is DETR's biggest design difference from YOLO or EfficientDet?
why: DETR = Detection Transformer,用注意力把检测当集合预测,直接去掉了手工设计的 anchor 和 NMS 后处理,擅长处理大量重叠目标。代价是延迟高(Jetson 上约 85ms)、访存大,没有重度蒸馏基本不适合边缘。
why_en: DETR (Detection Transformer) frames detection as set prediction via attention, removing hand-designed anchors and NMS post-processing and handling many overlapping objects, but at high latency (around 85ms on Jetson) and memory, so it's unfit for the edge without heavy distillation.
options: 它是最轻量的单阶段 CNN,专为 sub-5ms 边缘推理设计
用注意力做集合预测,去掉手工 anchor 和 NMS,但延迟高、访存大,边缘需重度蒸馏
它靠增加 anchor 密度来提升召回,后处理反而更重
它只在 CPU 上跑,不需要 GPU,所以适合低功耗边缘设备
options_en: It is the lightest single-stage CNN, purpose-built for sub-5ms edge inference.
It does set prediction with attention, dropping hand-designed anchors and NMS, but at high latency and memory, needing heavy distillation for the edge.
It boosts recall by increasing anchor density, making post-processing heavier instead.
It runs on CPU only with no GPU needed, making it ideal for low-power edge devices.
optionExplanations: DETR 恰恰是三者里最重的,Jetson 上约 85ms,和'最轻量 sub-5ms'相反。
对;去 anchor 去 NMS 是它的卖点,但 Transformer 的延迟与访存让它在边缘水土不服。
它是去掉 anchor,不是增加 anchor;后处理也因为无 NMS 而更简洁。
Transformer 注意力在 CPU 上更慢,DETR 并非 CPU 友好,更谈不上低功耗。
optionExplanations_en: DETR is actually the heaviest of the three at around 85ms on Jetson, opposite to 'lightest sub-5ms'.
Correct — dropping anchors and NMS is its selling point, but Transformer latency and memory make it a poor edge fit.
It removes anchors rather than adding them, and post-processing is simpler because there is no NMS.
Transformer attention is even slower on CPU; DETR is not CPU-friendly, let alone low-power.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 Transformer 注意力把目标检测当集合预测的模型,去掉 anchor 和 NMS。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DETR (Detection Transformer) uses Transformer attention to treat detection as set prediction, removing anchors and NMS.

termDefinitions.meaning: 非极大值抑制:检测后处理,去掉互相重叠、指向同一目标的冗余框。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NMS (Non-Maximum Suppression) is a post-processing step that removes redundant overlapping boxes pointing at the same object.

termDefinitions.meaning: 知识蒸馏:用大模型(teacher)指导小模型(student),把大模型能力压进小模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distillation trains a small student model to mimic a large teacher, compressing the teacher's ability into the smaller model.

q: 在 Jetson AGX 上,YOLOv8-S、EfficientDet-D1、DETR 该怎么按延迟/mAP 权衡看？
q_en: On Jetson AGX, how do YOLOv8-S, EfficientDet-D1, and DETR compare on latency versus mAP?
why: 这是 mAP vs ms/帧 的约束优化,不是'谁最强'。YOLOv8-S 约 8ms/44.9% 最快、边缘首选;EfficientDet-D1 约 15ms/40.5% 但多尺度融合、小目标更好;DETR 约 85ms/42% 无 anchor/NMS 但边缘延迟难以接受。
why_en: It's a mAP-versus-ms/frame constrained optimization, not 'who's strongest': YOLOv8-S at ~8ms/44.9% is fastest and the edge default, EfficientDet-D1 at ~15ms/40.5% has better small-object fusion, and DETR at ~85ms/42% drops anchors/NMS but is too slow for the edge.
tradeoff: YOLO 的极致速度 vs EfficientDet 的小目标融合 vs DETR 的无锚无 NMS 但高延迟
options: YOLOv8-S 约 8ms 最快,EfficientDet-D1 约 15ms 小目标更好,DETR 约 85ms 边缘太慢
三者延迟其实差不多,选谁只看 mAP,DETR 的 42% 虽非最高但无 NMS 所以边缘首选
DETR 参数最省、跑得最快,YOLOv8-S 反而最慢,EfficientDet-D1 参数最多最重
参数越多延迟越低,所以 DETR 的 41M 参数让它在 Jetson 上比 YOLO 更快出结果
options_en: YOLOv8-S at ~8ms is fastest, EfficientDet-D1 at ~15ms is better on small objects, DETR at ~85ms is too slow for the edge.
Their latencies are actually about the same, so pick by mAP alone, and DETR's 42% though not highest is NMS-free so it's the edge default.
DETR is the most parameter-frugal and fastest, YOLOv8-S is the slowest, and EfficientDet-D1 is the heaviest with the most parameters.
More parameters means lower latency, so DETR's 41M parameters make it faster on Jetson than YOLO.
optionExplanations: 对;三者延迟差一个数量级(8 vs 15 vs 85ms),边缘首先按延迟预算筛,再在够快的里看 mAP 和小目标。
延迟根本不一样,DETR 85ms 已爆边缘预算,mAP 再高也用不上。
说反了:DETR 最慢、参数最多(41M),YOLO 才是最快那个。
参数多通常延迟更高而非更低,DETR 41M 正对应它 85ms 的高延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the latencies differ by an order of magnitude (8 vs 15 vs 85ms), so the edge filters by latency budget first, then compares mAP and small-object skill among the fast enough.
Latencies are not the same; DETR's 85ms already blows the edge budget, so higher mAP is unusable.
Reversed: DETR is the slowest with the most parameters (41M), while YOLO is the fastest.
More parameters usually means higher, not lower, latency; DETR's 41M matches its 85ms.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用目标检测基准数据集,mAP 通常在它上面报。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: COCO (Common Objects in Context) is a standard object-detection benchmark dataset on which mAP is usually reported.

termDefinitions.meaning: NVIDIA Jetson 系列里较高端的边缘 GPU 模块,本课延迟数字的参照硬件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Jetson AGX is a higher-end edge GPU module in NVIDIA's Jetson line, the reference hardware for these latency numbers.

scenario: 硬约束是'Jetson AGX 上每帧 sub-15ms',场景是城市道路常规实时检测,类别以行人/车/自行车为主。
scenario_en: The hard constraint is 'sub-15ms per frame on Jetson AGX', for routine real-time urban detection of mostly pedestrians, cars, and bicycles.
q: 先摆约束再选架构,该选哪个？
q_en: Constraint first, then pick — which architecture?
why: 先钉死约束:sub-15ms on Jetson AGX。YOLOv8-S 约 8ms 稳稳落进预算,还留出后处理余量,mAP 也最高(44.9%),是常规实时检测的默认选择。EfficientDet-D1 约 15ms 卡边缘,DETR 85ms 直接出局。
why_en: Pin the constraint first — sub-15ms on Jetson AGX — and YOLOv8-S at ~8ms sits comfortably inside it with headroom for post-processing and the highest mAP (44.9%), making it the default for routine real-time detection.
tradeoff: YOLOv8-S 的速度余量+高 mAP vs EfficientDet-D1 的小目标优势但卡满预算
whenOtherWins: 若场景以远处小目标/密集遮挡为主,且能接受约 15ms 打满预算,EfficientDet-D1 的多尺度融合更值。
options: DETR:它无 anchor/NMS,处理重叠目标最优,延迟不是问题
EfficientDet-D1:小目标最强,15ms 正好等于预算所以最优
YOLOv8-S:约 8ms 稳落进 sub-15ms,mAP 最高,还留后处理余量
先不看延迟,谁 COCO mAP 高选谁,再回头优化速度
options_en: DETR — it drops anchors/NMS and handles overlaps best, and latency is not an issue.
EfficientDet-D1 — strongest on small objects, and 15ms exactly equals the budget so it's optimal.
YOLOv8-S — about 8ms sits inside sub-15ms, highest mAP, with headroom left for post-processing.
Ignore latency first, pick whoever has the highest COCO mAP, then optimize speed later.
optionExplanations: DETR 85ms 远超 15ms 预算,'延迟不是问题'在边缘上是错的。
15ms 正好等于预算意味着没有后处理/波动余量,风险大;而且常规类别下 YOLO 的 mAP 更高。
对;约束先行,8ms 有余量、mAP 最高,常规实时检测选它最稳。
边缘先过延迟门,再谈 mAP;先选高 mAP 的会选到跑不动的模型。
optionExplanations_en: DETR's 85ms far exceeds the 15ms budget; 'latency is not an issue' is simply wrong on the edge.
15ms exactly equaling the budget leaves no headroom for post-processing or jitter, and for these common classes YOLO's mAP is higher.
Correct — constraint first: 8ms has headroom and the highest mAP, the safe pick for routine real-time detection.
The edge passes the latency gate first, then talks mAP; picking highest mAP first selects a model that can't run.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每帧推理必须低于 15 毫秒,是这道题的给定延迟门槛。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sub-15ms means each frame's inference must stay under 15 milliseconds, the given latency gate here.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检测主指标,越高说明又准又全。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mAP (mean Average Precision) is the main detection metric; higher means more accurate and complete.

scenario: 路口场景要可靠检测远处的小目标(远处行人、路桩),延迟预算宽松到约 15ms 可接受,但对小目标漏检零容忍。
scenario_en: An intersection scenario must reliably detect distant small objects (far pedestrians, bollards), the latency budget is loose enough to allow ~15ms, but small-object misses are unacceptable.
q: 小目标优先、延迟预算宽松时选哪个架构？
q_en: When small objects matter most and latency is loose, which architecture?
why: 小目标是主约束、又有约 15ms 预算时,EfficientDet-D1 的 BiFPN 多尺度双向融合专门补小目标,比 YOLO 强,代价是约 15ms 略高延迟。既然预算容得下,就用这点延迟换小目标召回。
why_en: When small objects dominate and there's a ~15ms budget, EfficientDet-D1's BiFPN bidirectional multi-scale fusion targets small objects better than YOLO, and since the budget allows it you trade the extra latency for small-object recall.
tradeoff: EfficientDet-D1 的小目标召回 vs YOLO 更快但小目标更弱
whenOtherWins: 若延迟预算收紧到 sub-10ms,或场景以近处大目标为主,YOLOv8-S 的速度和更高整体 mAP 更划算。
options: YOLOv8-S:它最快,小目标弱一点也能靠调阈值补上
EfficientDet-D1:BiFPN 多尺度融合专补小目标,约 15ms 预算容得下
DETR:注意力全局建模,小目标一定最强,延迟先不管
随便选一个再把输入分辨率降一半来提速,小目标问题自然解决
options_en: YOLOv8-S — it's fastest, and weaker small objects can be patched by tuning the threshold.
EfficientDet-D1 — BiFPN multi-scale fusion targets small objects, and the ~15ms budget accommodates it.
DETR — global attention modeling is surely strongest on small objects, ignore latency for now.
Pick any model and halve the input resolution to speed it up; the small-object problem solves itself.
optionExplanations: 调阈值改变不了 YOLO 对小目标特征表达弱这个根,漏检问题仍在。
对;这正是 BiFPN 的强项,而且预算宽松,用略高延迟换小目标可靠性正合适。
DETR 85ms 违反边缘延迟,即便小目标强也用不上,'先不管延迟'在车上不成立。
降分辨率恰恰让小目标更难检,方向完全反了。
optionExplanations_en: Tuning thresholds doesn't fix YOLO's weak small-object feature representation, so misses persist.
Correct — this is exactly BiFPN's strength, and with a loose budget, trading a bit of latency for small-object reliability fits.
DETR's 85ms violates edge latency, so even strong small objects are unusable; 'ignore latency' fails on a car.
Lowering resolution makes small objects harder to detect, the exact opposite direction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 双向多尺度特征融合,擅长补小目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BiFPN (Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network) does bidirectional multi-scale fusion that helps small objects.

termDefinitions.meaning: 真实目标里被检出的比例,漏检直接压低召回。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall is the fraction of true objects that are detected; misses directly lower it.

scenario: 有人提议直接把 DETR 部署到车载 Jetson 上,理由是它无 anchor、无 NMS、处理重叠目标很强。
scenario_en: Someone proposes deploying DETR directly onto the on-board Jetson because it is anchor-free, NMS-free, and strong on overlapping objects.
q: 该不该直接上 DETR？为什么？
q_en: Should you deploy DETR as-is, and why?
why: 不该直接上:DETR 在 Jetson 约 85ms,远超 100ms 决策预算里留给检测的份额,访存也大,边缘水土不服。它的无 anchor/NMS 优点在延迟不敏感或重叠极密的场景才值,边缘要用得先做重度蒸馏或换 YOLO/EfficientDet。
why_en: No — DETR runs around 85ms on Jetson, far past the detection share of a 100ms budget, and it's memory-heavy, so it doesn't fit the edge; its anchor/NMS-free wins only pay off when latency is loose or overlaps are extreme, otherwise distill it heavily or use YOLO/EfficientDet.
tradeoff: DETR 无 anchor/NMS 的建模优雅 vs 边缘上 85ms 的高延迟高访存
whenOtherWins: 当延迟不敏感(离线/云端)或目标极度密集重叠、且能承受重度蒸馏时,DETR 的集合预测才反超。
options: 该上,它无 anchor/NMS 最先进,85ms 在车上完全够用
该上,先上线再说,延迟等真出问题了再优化
该上,把批大小调大就能把 85ms 摊薄到 sub-10ms
不该直接上:85ms 远超边缘预算、访存大,要先重度蒸馏或改用 YOLO/EfficientDet
options_en: Yes — it's the most advanced with no anchor/NMS, and 85ms is plenty on a car.
Yes — ship it first and optimize latency later only if it actually becomes a problem.
Yes — just raise the batch size to amortize 85ms down to sub-10ms.
No — 85ms far exceeds the edge budget and it's memory-heavy, so distill it heavily first or switch to YOLO/EfficientDet.
optionExplanations: 85ms 已经吃掉大半个 100ms 决策预算,'完全够用'在安全攸关的实时车载上站不住。
延迟问题在车上等于安全事故,'先上线'不是可接受的策略。
增大 batch 提高吞吐但不降单帧延迟,实时车载每帧都要及时出结果,摊薄逻辑不成立。
对;先认清 85ms 违反边缘约束,再谈蒸馏或换架构,这才是约束先行的判断。
optionExplanations_en: 85ms already eats most of a 100ms decision budget, so 'plenty' fails in a safety-critical real-time car.
A latency problem on a car equals a safety incident, so 'ship first' is not an acceptable strategy.
Bigger batches raise throughput but not per-frame latency, and real-time driving needs each frame on time, so amortization doesn't apply.
Correct — recognize 85ms violates the edge constraint first, then talk distillation or a swap; that's constraint-first reasoning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用大模型指导小模型,把能力压进能上边缘的小网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distillation trains a small edge-deployable model to mimic a large one, compressing its ability.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次前向同时处理的样本数,增大提吞吐但不降单帧延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Batch size is how many inputs a forward pass processes at once; larger improves throughput but not per-frame latency.

scenario: 同一张图,YOLOv8-S 在 Jetson AGX 约 8ms,DETR 约 85ms,预算是每帧 sub-15ms。
scenario_en: On the same image on Jetson AGX, YOLOv8-S runs ~8ms and DETR ~85ms, with a per-frame budget of sub-15ms.
q: 这组延迟数字为什么直接把 DETR 排除在边缘之外？
q_en: Why do these latency numbers rule DETR out of the edge outright?
why: 延迟就是决策门槛:8ms < 15ms 预算,YOLO 过关;85ms 是预算的近 6 倍,单帧就爆,后面留给规划/控制的时间全没了。数字的下游用途是当准入门:先过延迟门,再比 mAP,过不了门 mAP 再高也无意义。
why_en: Latency is the gate: 8ms is under the 15ms budget so YOLO passes, while 85ms is nearly 6x the budget and blows a single frame, leaving no time for planning or control, so the number acts as an admission gate — pass latency first, then compare mAP.
options: 85ms 是 sub-15ms 预算的近 6 倍,单帧就爆预算,过不了延迟门,mAP 再高也用不上
85ms 比 8ms 大,但两者都在 15ms 预算内,DETR 只是稍慢无妨
延迟数字只是参考,真正决定的是参数量,DETR 41M 参数才是问题
8ms 和 85ms 差距可以靠更强的 GPU 抹平,换硬件即可让 DETR 达标
options_en: 85ms is nearly 6x the sub-15ms budget and blows a single frame, failing the latency gate, so its mAP is unusable.
85ms is bigger than 8ms, but both fit within the 15ms budget, so DETR is just slightly slower with no harm.
The latency numbers are only a reference; parameter count is what decides, and DETR's 41M is the real problem.
The 8ms-vs-85ms gap can be erased with a stronger GPU, so swapping hardware makes DETR compliant.

termDefinitions.meaning: 边缘选型的第一道筛:延迟不达标直接淘汰,不再看别的指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A latency gate is the first edge filter: fail the latency target and the model is eliminated before other metrics matter.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检测准确率主指标,过了延迟门之后才比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mAP (mean Average Precision) is the main accuracy metric, compared only after the latency gate is passed.

scenario: 面试官问'你会用哪个目标检测架构',你要给出一个能站得住的回答方式。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks 'which object-detection architecture would you use', and you need a defensible way to answer.
q: 边缘检测选型,正确的作答框架是什么？
q_en: What is the right framing for answering edge-detection architecture selection?
why: 先摆约束再论证:一句话钉死'sub-15ms on Jetson AGX'这类硬约束,再针对约束说为什么某架构达标、别的为什么出局。直接报'YOLO 最好'或'DETR 最先进'都是脱离约束的空话,面试想听的是约束驱动的取舍。
why_en: State the constraint, then justify: pin a hard constraint like 'sub-15ms on Jetson AGX' in one line, then argue why an architecture meets it and why others are out, because naming 'YOLO is best' or 'DETR is SOTA' without the constraint is empty.
tradeoff: 约束先行的取舍论证 vs 脱离约束地报榜单第一
whenOtherWins: 只有当对方明确说'先不限延迟、就要最高精度'时,才可以先按纯 mAP 榜单推荐,再补延迟代价。
options: 直接报 COCO 榜单 mAP 最高的模型,先给结论再说别的
先一句话钉死硬约束(如 sub-15ms on Jetson),再针对约束论证某架构达标、别的出局
把 YOLO/EfficientDet/DETR 各夸一遍,不下结论,让面试官自己选
先谈训练技巧和数据增强,架构选型最后随便提一句
options_en: Just name the highest-COCO-mAP model, give the conclusion first and details later.
Pin the hard constraint first (e.g. sub-15ms on Jetson), then argue which architecture meets it and which is out.
Praise YOLO, EfficientDet, and DETR each in turn without a conclusion, and let the interviewer choose.
Talk training tricks and data augmentation first, and mention architecture selection only as an afterthought.
optionExplanations: 脱离硬件约束报 mAP 会推荐出在 Jetson 上跑不动的模型,面试官正等着追问延迟。
对;约束先行让你的取舍有锚点,每个架构的取用都能对着约束讲清楚。
不下结论等于没回答,系统设计要的是有理由的选择而非罗列。
本题问的是架构选型,把它放到最后是没抓住问题的主轴。
optionExplanations_en: Naming mAP without the hardware constraint recommends a model that can't run on Jetson, and the interviewer is waiting to probe latency.
Correct — constraint first anchors your tradeoffs so every architecture is argued against the same target.
No conclusion is no answer; system design wants a justified choice, not a list.
The question is about architecture selection, so leaving it for last misses the main axis.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在硬约束(延迟/内存)下最大化目标(mAP)的思路,而非孤立比'谁最强'。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Constrained optimization maximizes an objective (mAP) under hard constraints (latency, memory), rather than comparing who is strongest in isolation.

q: 压缩流水线里,剪枝和量化的先后顺序为什么重要？
q_en: Why does the order of pruning and quantization matter in the compression pipeline?
why: 顺序是先剪枝再量化,因为两者的加速是乘性叠加:先剪掉 30-50% 通道把维度做小,再把剩下的权重从 FP32 降到 INT8,收益相乘。反过来先量化再剪,量化的定点表示会让通道重要性评估失真,剪得不准。
why_en: The order is prune then quantize because their speedups compound multiplicatively: first cut 30-50% of channels to shrink dimensions, then drop the remaining weights from FP32 to INT8, and the gains multiply, whereas quantizing first distorts the channel-importance estimate used by pruning.
diagram:
flowchart LR P["结构化剪枝
删 30-50% 通道"] --> F["微调恢复精度"] F --> Q["量化 FP32→INT8"] Q --> R["目标硬件重新 profile"]
options: 先剪枝再量化:两者加速乘性叠加,先缩小维度再降精度收益相乘
先量化再剪枝:定点权重更好评估通道重要性,剪得更准
顺序无所谓:剪枝和量化互不影响,并行做即可
只做其一即可:剪枝和量化本质等价,做两次是浪费
options_en: Prune then quantize — their speedups compound multiplicatively, shrinking dimensions before lowering precision.
Quantize then prune — fixed-point weights better estimate channel importance, so pruning is more accurate.
Order doesn't matter — pruning and quantization are independent, so do them in parallel.
Do only one — pruning and quantization are essentially equivalent, so doing both wastes effort.
optionExplanations: 对;剪枝把维度做小、量化把每个权重做小,先剪再量让两份收益相乘,这是标准管线。
量化后权重变定点,反而让基于 L1 范数的通道重要性失真,剪得更差不是更准。
两者都改权重与算子,量化会影响剪枝的重要性评估,并非互不影响。
剪枝减维度、量化降位宽,机制不同、收益叠加,不能相互替代。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — pruning shrinks dimensions and quantization shrinks each weight, so prune-then-quantize multiplies both gains, the standard pipeline.
Quantized fixed-point weights actually distort L1-norm channel importance, making pruning worse, not more accurate.
Both modify weights and operators, and quantization affects pruning's importance estimate, so they're not independent.
Pruning cuts dimensions while quantization cuts bit-width; different mechanisms whose gains stack, so they don't substitute.

termDefinitions.meaning: 删掉不重要的权重或通道来减小模型,结构化剪枝按通道整块删。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pruning removes unimportant weights or channels to shrink a model; structured pruning removes whole channels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把权重和激活的数值精度从高位降到低位(如 FP32→INT8)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Quantization lowers the numeric precision of weights and activations, e.g. FP32 to INT8.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两步的加速比相乘而非相加,合起来收益更大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multiplicative means the two steps' speedup ratios multiply rather than add, giving a larger combined gain.

q: 把边缘检测模型的压缩流水线排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the edge-detection compression pipeline correctly:
steps: 量化 FP32→INT8(选 PTQ 或 QAT)
结构化剪枝:按 L1 范数删掉最不重要的通道
在目标硬件上重新 profile,实测 wall-clock 延迟
剪枝后在原始数据上微调,恢复掉的精度
置信度校准(温度缩放),再接入 fail-safe
why: 先剪枝缩维度→微调把剪掉的精度救回来→再量化降位宽(乘性叠加)→到目标硬件实测延迟(FLOP 降不等于 wall-clock 降)→最后校准置信度接 fail-safe。跳过微调会带着掉的精度往下走,跳过重新 profile 会误信理论加速。
why_en: Prune to shrink dimensions, fine-tune to recover the lost accuracy, then quantize to cut bit-width (compounding), re-profile on the target hardware since FLOP cuts aren't wall-clock cuts, and finally calibrate confidence for fail-safe; skipping fine-tune carries lost accuracy forward and skipping re-profile trusts theoretical speedup.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["剪枝"] --> B["微调"]
  B --> C["量化"]
  C --> D["重新 profile"]
  D --> E["校准"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 真实设备上跑一遍的实际耗时,区别于理论 FLOP 数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wall-clock latency is the actual time a run takes on real hardware, as opposed to a theoretical FLOP count.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浮点运算次数,理论计算量指标,不直接等于实测延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FLOP (Floating Point Operations) counts arithmetic operations, a theoretical compute measure that doesn't equal measured latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练后量化,用小校准集设定数值范围,快但可能伤尾类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PTQ (Post-Training Quantization) quantizes after training using a small calibration set, fast but can hurt rare classes.

q: 结构化剪枝具体删掉什么,又靠什么把精度救回来？
q_en: What does structured pruning remove, and how is accuracy recovered?
why: 结构化剪枝按 L1 范数(权重绝对值大小)找出最不重要的通道整块删掉,直接缩小层的维度。通常剪 30-50% 通道,删完精度会掉,再在原始数据上微调让剩余通道重新适应,把精度补回来。
why_en: Structured pruning uses L1-norm magnitude to find the least-important channels and removes them wholesale, shrinking layer dimensions, typically 30-50%; accuracy drops, so you fine-tune on the original data to let the remaining channels readapt and recover it.
options: 随机丢弃单个权重做稀疏化,靠更大的 batch 补回精度
删掉输出层的类别,靠减少类别数来提速
按 L1 范数删最不重要的整条通道(剪 30-50%),再在原始数据上微调恢复精度
删掉训练数据里的难样本,让模型只学简单样本来变快
options_en: Randomly drop individual weights for sparsity, and recover accuracy with a larger batch.
Delete classes from the output layer, speeding up by reducing the number of classes.
Remove the least-important whole channels by L1-norm (30-50%), then fine-tune on original data to recover.
Delete hard training samples so the model only learns easy ones and runs faster.
optionExplanations: 随机丢单权重是非结构化稀疏,不缩物理维度,边缘硬件难利用,也不是这里的做法。
删类别改变的是任务而非模型结构,不是剪枝。
对;整通道删才能真正缩层维、被硬件利用,微调是恢复精度的标准手段。
删难样本是改数据,和剪掉网络通道无关,还会伤泛化。
optionExplanations_en: Randomly dropping single weights is unstructured sparsity that doesn't shrink physical dimensions and is hard for edge hardware to exploit — not this.
Deleting classes changes the task, not the model structure, so it isn't pruning.
Correct — removing whole channels truly shrinks layer dimensions that hardware can exploit, and fine-tuning is the standard accuracy-recovery step.
Deleting hard samples changes the data, unrelated to removing network channels, and hurts generalization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按通道/滤波器整块删除,真正缩小层维度,便于硬件加速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Structured pruning removes whole channels or filters, genuinely shrinking layer dimensions so hardware can speed up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 权重绝对值之和,用作通道重要性的度量,越小越可删。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The L1-norm is the sum of absolute weight values, used as a channel-importance measure where smaller means more prunable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 剪枝后用原始数据继续训练几轮,让剩余通道适应、找回精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fine-tuning trains a few more epochs on the original data after pruning so the remaining channels readapt and recover accuracy.

scenario: 剪枝后理论 FLOP 降了 40%,团队据此宣称推理会快 40%。
scenario_en: After pruning, theoretical FLOPs dropped 40%, and the team claims inference will get 40% faster.
q: 为什么必须在目标硬件上重新 profile,而不能只信 FLOP？
q_en: Why must you re-profile on target hardware instead of trusting FLOPs alone?
why: 因为剪枝物理删掉了计算单元,实测加速取决于剩下的维度是否对齐设备的访存/并行结构。40% 的 FLOP 削减可能只换来 25% 的 wall-clock 加速——如果剪后的通道数没对齐硬件的内存层级或 SIMD 宽度,算子反而利用率低。所以要在目标硬件实测。
why_en: Pruning physically removes compute units, so the real speedup depends on whether the leftover dimensions align with the device's memory and parallelism, and a 40% FLOP cut may yield only 25% wall-clock speedup when pruned channel counts misalign with the memory hierarchy or SIMD width, so you re-profile on the target hardware.
options: 不必重新 profile,FLOP 降多少延迟就降多少,40% 就是 40%
重新 profile 只是为了测功耗,和延迟无关
FLOP 越低模型越准,profile 是为了确认精度而非速度
剪枝物理删算子,若剪后维度不对齐访存/并行结构,40% FLOP 可能只换来约 25% 实测加速
options_en: No need to re-profile — latency drops exactly as FLOPs drop, so 40% means 40%.
Re-profiling only measures power draw and has nothing to do with latency.
Lower FLOPs means higher accuracy, so profiling confirms accuracy, not speed.
Pruning physically removes ops, and if leftover dimensions misalign with memory/parallelism, a 40% FLOP cut may yield only ~25% measured speedup.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浮点运算次数,理论计算量,不等于实测延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FLOP (Floating Point Operations) is a theoretical compute count that does not equal measured latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 寄存器→缓存→显存的层级,维度不对齐会导致访存低效、算子跑不满。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The memory hierarchy spans registers, caches, and device memory; misaligned dimensions cause inefficient access and underutilized compute.

termDefinitions.meaning: 真实设备上跑一遍的实际耗时。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Wall-clock latency is the actual elapsed time of a run on real hardware.

optionMeanings: 选项主张：不必重新 profile,FLOP 降多少延迟就降多少,40% 就是 40%。
选项主张：重新 profile 只是为了测功耗,和延迟无关。
选项主张：FLOP 越低模型越准,profile 是为了确认精度而非速度。
选项主张：剪枝物理删算子,若剪后维度不对齐访存/并行结构,40% FLOP 可能只换来约 25% 实测加速。

会让系统依赖「重新 profile 只是为了测功耗,和延迟无关」这个前提。

会让方案围绕「剪枝物理删算子,若剪后维度不对齐访存/并行结构,40% FLOP 可能只换来约 25% 实测加速」展开。

Lower FLOPs means higher accuracy, so profiling confirms accuracy, not speed.
