Image count is unrelated to index architecture; any count uses the same brute-force search.
optionExplanations: 错；主流视觉搜索早已十亿级，把它当过度设计是严重低估现实规模。
对；50 亿+ 的真实锚点把'十亿'从假设变成生产常态，直接决定必须用 ANN 与专门索引架构。
错；恰恰相反，生产系统常态就在十亿级以上，十万级是玩具规模。
错；数量级直接决定能否暴力检索，十亿级下暴力不可行,架构必须随规模变。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — mainstream visual search is already billion-scale, so calling it over-engineering badly underestimates reality.
Correct — the 5B+ anchor turns 'a billion' from hypothesis into a production norm that directly mandates ANN and a dedicated index architecture.
Wrong — on the contrary, production systems routinely exceed a billion; hundreds of thousands is toy scale.
Wrong — the order of magnitude directly decides whether brute force is possible; at a billion it is infeasible, so architecture must scale with size.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对十亿量级向量建索引以支持检索，Pinterest 达 50 亿+，是行业真实规模。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Billion-scale indexing builds an index over a billion-order vectors for retrieval; Pinterest reaches 5B+, a real industry scale.

scenario: Staff+ 面试里，要把视觉搜索定位成公司级能力，而不是一个孤立功能。
scenario_en: In a Staff+ interview, you position visual search as a company-level capability, not an isolated feature.
q: Staff+ 视角下，视觉搜索该被框成什么？
q_en: At Staff+, how should visual search be framed?
why: 框成平台能力：一套共享 embedding 基础设施服务发现/购物/审核多个场景；多索引架构(目录索引+网络索引并行查询)；带量化重建成本的 embedding 版本化；把离线 recall@k→在线 CTR→季度营收串成指标层级。这体现从功能到平台的整合思维。
why_en: Frame it as a platform capability on shared embedding infra serving discovery/shopping/moderation, with a multi-index architecture querying catalog and web indexes in parallel and a metric hierarchy from recall@k to CTR to revenue.
tradeoff: 平台能力(共享 embedding、多索引、指标层级) vs 单点功能(只做一条查询流)
whenOtherWins: 在早期 MVP、只需验证单一图搜图场景时，做成单一功能更快落地；平台化在多场景复用和规模化时才回本。
options: 框成一个独立小功能：只做图搜图一条查询流，够用就行
框成平台能力：共享 embedding 基础设施服务发现/购物/审核，多索引并行，指标层级串到营收
框成一次性项目：上线后不再演化，不需要版本化或多索引
框成纯模型问题：把精力全放在训练更大的编码器上
options_en: Frame it as a standalone mini-feature: just one image-to-image query flow, good enough.
Frame it as a platform capability: shared embedding infra serving discovery/shopping/moderation, multi-index in parallel, metric hierarchy tied to revenue.
Frame it as a one-off project: no evolution after launch, no versioning or multi-index needed.
Frame it as a pure model problem: put all effort into training a bigger encoder.
optionExplanations: 错；只做一条查询流是 L4 视角，错过了共享基础设施与多场景复用的平台价值。
对；共享 embedding+多索引并行+recall→CTR→营收的层级，正是从功能上升到平台的 Staff+ 整合。
错；embedding drift 与业务演化决定它必须持续版本化，一次性项目框法站不住。
错；本课明确说多数人过度准备模型层、准备不足 scoping，纯模型框法正踩这个坑。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — one query flow is the L4 view and misses the platform value of shared infra and multi-scenario reuse.
Correct — shared embeddings plus parallel multi-index plus a recall-to-CTR-to-revenue hierarchy is exactly the Staff+ integration from feature to platform.
Wrong — embedding drift and business evolution require ongoing versioning, so a one-off framing does not hold.
Wrong — the lesson explicitly says most people over-prepare the model layer and under-prepare scoping, and a pure-model framing walks into that trap.

termDefinitions.meaning: 并行查询多个专用索引(如商品目录索引+网络图索引)再融合结果，服务不同意图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A multi-index architecture queries multiple specialized indexes in parallel (e.g. catalog and web) and fuses results to serve different intents.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把某功能建成可被多场景(发现/购物/审核)复用的共享基础设施，而非孤立特性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A platform capability builds a function as shared infrastructure reusable across scenarios (discovery/shopping/moderation) rather than an isolated feature.

scenario: 团队想用点击/购买数据反哺重排器训练，形成越用越准的正循环。
scenario_en: The team wants click/purchase data to feed re-ranker training, forming a virtuous cycle that improves with use.
q: 这个'正循环'成立的前提是什么？
q_en: What is the precondition for this virtuous cycle to hold?
why: CTR/转化数据能反哺重排器训练形成正循环，但前提是上游检索先 surface 出足够多的相关候选——没有好候选，就没有有意义的点击信号可学，循环空转。所以检索召回是这个飞轮的入口闸门。
why_en: CTR/conversion data can train the re-ranker in a virtuous cycle only if upstream retrieval first surfaces enough relevant candidates, otherwise there is no meaningful click signal to learn from.
options: 只要有用户流量，循环就自动成立，和检索质量无关
前提是上游检索先 surface 出足够相关候选，否则没有有意义的点击信号可学，飞轮空转
前提是把延迟压到 0，用户才会产生足够点击
前提是关闭 zero-result 兜底，只留最相关的一个结果
options_en: Any user traffic makes the cycle self-sustaining, regardless of retrieval quality.
The precondition is that upstream retrieval first surfaces enough relevant candidates, else there is no meaningful click signal to learn from and the flywheel spins empty.
The precondition is driving latency to zero so users generate enough clicks.
The precondition is disabling zero-result fallback and keeping only the single most relevant result.
optionExplanations: 错；有流量但候选都不相关，点击数据也是噪声，学不出更好的排序，循环无从建立。
对；重排器只能在检索给的候选里重排，候选里没有好结果，反哺信号就无价值，检索召回是入口闸门。
错；延迟为 0 不可能也非关键,循环的瓶颈是候选相关性不是速度。
错；只留一个结果反而扼杀探索与点击多样性，采不到足够训练信号，与正循环相悖。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — with traffic but irrelevant candidates, click data is noise that cannot teach better ranking, so the cycle never forms.
Correct — the re-ranker can only reorder the candidates retrieval gives it; without good ones the feedback signal is worthless, making retrieval recall the entry gate.
Wrong — zero latency is impossible and not the point; the cycle's bottleneck is candidate relevance, not speed.
Wrong — keeping a single result kills exploration and click diversity, starving training signal, against the virtuous cycle.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上点击/购买数据反哺重排器训练、模型再改善体验的自强化循环，需上游召回足够候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A virtuous cycle feeds online click/purchase data back into re-ranker training so the model improves the experience, requiring upstream recall to surface enough candidates.

scenario: 图搜商品要把用户随手拍的真实照片(杂乱光照/背景/遮挡)对到干净的目录商品图。
scenario_en: Image-to-product must map a user's casual real photo (messy lighting, background, occlusion) to a clean catalog product image.
q: 为什么图搜商品必须跨越'域差'，不跨越会怎样？
q_en: Why must image-to-product bridge a domain gap, and what happens if it does not?
why: 真实照片和目录图分布不同(光照/背景/遮挡差异)=域差。若 embedding 只在干净目录图上学，遇到真实照片就对不准，检回视觉相近但错款的结果。要用真实-目录成对数据做跨模态/域适应训练来跨越它。
why_en: Real photos and catalog images have different distributions (lighting, background, occlusion), so an embedding trained only on clean catalog images misaligns on real photos and returns similar-looking wrong products.
tradeoff: 用真实-目录成对数据训练(跨域但贵) vs 只用干净目录图(便宜但真实照片对不准)
options: 域差不存在，只要分辨率一致，真实照片和目录图对模型没区别
真实照片与目录图分布不同(光照/背景/遮挡)；只学目录图会在真实照片上对不准、检回错款
跨越域差只需把用户照片调成黑白，消除颜色差异即可
域差只影响延迟不影响准确率，压缩预处理就能解决
options_en: There is no domain gap; as long as resolution matches, real photos and catalog images look the same to the model.
Real photos and catalog images have different distributions (lighting/background/occlusion); training only on catalog images misaligns on real photos and returns wrong products.
Bridging the gap just needs converting user photos to grayscale to remove color differences.
The domain gap only affects latency, not accuracy, and compressing preprocessing solves it.
optionExplanations: 错；分辨率一致解决不了光照/背景/遮挡带来的分布差异，域差是真实存在的核心难点。
对；分布不一致会让 embedding 空间对不齐，必须用真实-目录成对数据训练来弥合，否则错款频出。
错；转黑白丢信息更糟，域差是多因素分布差异，不是单一颜色问题。
错；域差是准确率(匹配对不对)问题，不是延迟问题，预处理压缩救不了。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — matching resolution does not fix the distribution difference from lighting/background/occlusion; the domain gap is a real core difficulty.
Correct — a distribution mismatch misaligns the embedding space, so real-photo-to-catalog paired training is needed to bridge it, or wrong products keep appearing.
Wrong — grayscale discards information and worsens it; the gap is a multi-factor distribution difference, not a single color issue.
Wrong — the domain gap is an accuracy (correct-match) problem, not latency, so preprocessing compression cannot solve it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让模型在源域(干净目录图)学到的能力迁移到目标域(真实用户照片)的训练技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain adaptation is training so a model's ability learned on the source domain (clean catalog images) transfers to the target domain (real user photos).

scenario: 面试要你列出视觉搜索的核心业务指标，每个都能连到一个设计杠杆。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to list visual search's core business metrics, each mapping to a design lever.
q: 以下哪些是视觉搜索的核心业务指标？(多选)
q_en: Which of these are visual search's core business metrics? (multiple)
why: 三个核心业务指标：CTR(结果吸引力/相关性→重排器)、购买转化率(终极营收→意图分类)、空结果率(索引覆盖→ANN 回退层)。GPU 利用率是基建运维指标，不是衡量搜索质量的业务指标。
why_en: The three core business metrics are CTR (attractiveness → re-ranker), purchase conversion (revenue → intent classifier), and zero-result rate (coverage → ANN fallback); GPU utilization is infra ops, not a search-quality business metric.
options: CTR：结果被点击的比例，衡量吸引力/相关性
购买转化率：产生交易的会话比例，终极营收指标
空结果率：无结果越阈值的查询比例，衡量索引覆盖
GPU 利用率：训练集群的算力占用率
options_en: CTR: the fraction of results clicked, measuring attractiveness/relevance.
Purchase conversion rate: the fraction of sessions with a transaction, the ultimate revenue metric.
Zero-result rate: the fraction of queries with no result above threshold, measuring index coverage.
GPU utilization: the compute-usage rate of the training cluster.
optionExplanations: 对；CTR 低(recall 够)指向重排问题，是能连到具体杠杆的业务指标。
对；转化是最终营收信号，低转化(高 CTR)指向意图错配→上游意图分类。
对；空结果率衡量覆盖，高则加 ANN 回退层，是功能可用性的门槛指标。
错；GPU 利用率是基建成本/运维指标，衡量不了搜索结果好不好，不是业务指标。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — low CTR with adequate recall points to a ranking problem, a business metric mapping to a concrete lever.
Correct — conversion is the ultimate revenue signal, and low conversion with high CTR points to intent mismatch and an upstream intent classifier.
Correct — zero-result rate measures coverage, and high values call for ANN fallback tiers, the functionality-gating metric.
Incorrect — GPU utilization is an infra cost/ops metric that cannot measure result quality, not a business metric.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个业务指标异常时对应要动的架构组件(CTR→重排器、转化→意图分类、空结果→回退层)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A design lever is the architectural component to adjust when a business metric is off (CTR→re-ranker, conversion→intent classifier, zero-result→fallback tiers).

scenario: <200ms 预算里，embedding 推理占 10–50ms 通常是最大头，团队想知道该优化哪。
scenario_en: Within the sub-200ms budget, embedding inference at 10–50ms is usually the biggest chunk, and the team wants to know what to optimize.
q: 既然 embedding 推理是主导延迟，优化重点该放哪？
q_en: Since embedding inference dominates latency, where should optimization focus?
why: embedding 推理 10–50ms 是延迟大头，编码器选择(ResNet 更快约 10ms vs ViT/CLIP 更慢约 30–50ms)与批处理、GPU 加速是主要优化点。相比之下 ANN 检索仅 1–10ms，优化它对总延迟收益小。要优化主导项，别去抠已经很快的环节。
why_en: Embedding inference at 10–50ms dominates, so encoder choice (ResNet ~10ms vs ViT/CLIP ~30–50ms), batching, and GPU acceleration are the main levers, whereas ANN at 1–10ms is already cheap.
options: 优先优化 ANN 检索，把 1–10ms 再压一半，收益最大
优先优化 embedding 推理(选更快编码器/批处理/GPU 加速)，因为它是 10–50ms 的延迟大头
优先优化网络序列化，那才是绝对的瓶颈
三个阶段平均用力,不看谁占比大
options_en: Optimize ANN retrieval first, halving its 1–10ms for the biggest win.
Optimize embedding inference first (faster encoder/batching/GPU acceleration) because it is the 10–50ms latency dominator.
Optimize network serialization first, which is the true bottleneck.
Spread effort evenly across all three stages regardless of their share.
optionExplanations: 错；ANN 已经只占 1–10ms，把最快的环节再优化对 <200ms 总预算几乎没影响。
对；抓延迟大头，换更快编码器或批处理/GPU 加速能实打实压缩总延迟，是对症优化。
错；网络序列化只占残余预算，不是主导项，先动它是抓错重点。
错；不看占比平均用力效率低，应把力气压在 10–50ms 的 embedding 推理上。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — ANN is already just 1–10ms, so optimizing the fastest stage barely moves the sub-200ms total.
Correct — target the dominator; a faster encoder or batching/GPU acceleration truly shrinks total latency, an on-target optimization.
Wrong — network serialization is only the leftover budget, not the dominator, so starting there misplaces the focus.
Wrong — spreading evenly ignores shares and is inefficient; effort belongs on the 10–50ms embedding inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 延迟预算里占比最大的阶段(此处 embedding 推理)，优化它对总延迟收益最高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The dominant cost is the stage taking the largest share of the latency budget (here embedding inference), where optimization yields the most.

scenario: 同一道视觉搜索题，L4、L5、Staff+ 候选人在'把哪些决策讲明确'上差别很大。
scenario_en: On the same visual-search question, L4, L5, and Staff+ candidates differ in which decisions they make explicit.
q: L4、L5、Staff+ 在视觉搜索 scoping 上的关键差别是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference among L4, L5, and Staff+ in scoping visual search?
why: L4：认出 embedding 检索+CNN 编码器+ANN，提 CTR，但不分两种表述、把指标当可互换、不量化规模。L5：明确选并论证表述、定义指标并做冲突分析、给数值延迟预算、点名 HNSW/IVF、标出 embedding drift。Staff+：再上升到平台能力+多索引+版本化+指标层级。差别在'把哪些决策讲明确'。
why_en: L4 identifies embedding retrieval, CNN, ANN, and CTR but conflates formulations and metrics and does not quantify scale; L5 justifies the formulation, analyzes metric conflicts, gives a numeric budget, and flags drift; Staff+ rises to platform capability and multi-index.
tradeoff: L4(认出组件但不分表述/不量化) vs L5(论证表述+冲突分析+数值预算) vs Staff+(平台化整合)
options: 差别只在于 Staff+ 用了更大的模型，L4 模型太小
L4/L5/Staff+ 答案本质一样，只是表达详略不同
L4 认出组件但不分表述/不量化；L5 论证表述+指标冲突分析+数值预算；Staff+ 上升到平台+多索引+版本化
差别在于 L4 只谈业务、Staff+ 只谈模型，正好互补
options_en: The difference is only that Staff+ uses a bigger model and L4's is too small.
L4/L5/Staff+ answers are essentially the same, differing only in verbosity.

L4 identifies components but does not distinguish formulations or quantify; L5 justifies the formulation with metric-conflict analysis and a numeric budget; Staff+ rises to platform, multi-index, and versioning.
The difference is that L4 only talks business and Staff+ only talks models, complementing each other.
optionExplanations: 错；本课强调多数人过度准备模型层，差别不是模型大小而是 scoping 的明确度。
错；不是详略问题，而是是否区分表述、是否做指标冲突分析、是否量化规模的实质差异。
对；层级差别是'把哪些决策讲明确'——表述、指标冲突、规模、平台化，逐级上升。
错；Staff+ 恰恰把业务指标层级与模型/架构整合起来，不是只谈模型。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the lesson stresses most people over-prepare the model layer; the difference is scoping explicitness, not model size.
Wrong — it is not about verbosity but the substantive difference of distinguishing formulations, analyzing metric conflicts, and quantifying scale.
Correct — the level gap is which decisions you make explicit — formulation, metric conflicts, scale, platformization — rising step by step.
Wrong — Staff+ actually integrates the business-metric hierarchy with model/architecture, not model-only.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把哪些设计决策(表述、指标、规模)显式讲清，是本课认为多数人准备不足的能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scoping is making which design decisions (formulation, metrics, scale) explicit, the ability the lesson says most candidates under-prepare.

q: 把视觉搜索的数据+embedding 摄取管线按正确顺序排列：
q_en: Order the visual-search data and embedding ingestion pipeline correctly:
scenario: 为 Pinterest Lens 式系统设计数据层：一张新图从爬取到进索引要经过哪些阶段。
scenario_en: Designing the data layer for a Pinterest Lens-style system: the stages a new image passes from crawl to index.
steps: 去重：pHash/dHash 粗筛→桶内 embedding 聚类→选代表图
摄取：爬取图像、抽取元数据
索引：ANN 建库(HNSW/IVF)、蓝绿部署、多模态元数据存储
安全过滤：NSFW+政策检测器→隔离/人工复核
embedding 生成：选架构、embedding 版本化、批量推理
why: 顺序：摄取→安全过滤(必须在 embedding 前，别把不安全内容白算白存)→去重→embedding 生成→索引。安全过滤前置是关键：放在最前才不浪费算力和索引容量在会被删的内容上。
why_en: Ingest, then safety-filter before embedding (so you never waste compute/storage on unsafe content), then dedup, then generate embeddings, then index.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  I[摄取] --> S[安全过滤] --> D[去重] --> E[embedding 生成] --> X[索引]

termDefinitions.meaning: 用选定编码器把图像批量编码成向量，是数据层最高杠杆的决策(决定向量空间质量)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding generation encodes images into vectors with a chosen encoder, the highest-leverage data-layer decision as it sets vector-space quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 管线入口：爬取图像并抽取元数据(标题/标签/价格等)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ingestion is the pipeline entry: crawling images and extracting metadata (title, tags, price).

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 移动端视觉搜索，延迟预算极紧(需 ~10ms 编码)、微调预算有限，主要做同域内图搜图。
scenario_en: Mobile visual search with a very tight latency budget (~10ms encode), limited fine-tuning budget, mostly in-domain image-to-image.
q: 该选哪种 embedding 编码器？
q_en: Which embedding encoder should you pick?
why: 选 ResNet：卷积自带平移不变性等强归纳偏置，预训练 checkpoint 收敛快、微调成本低，推理约 10ms/GPU 适合移动端延迟约束。代价是跨域泛化弱、无原生文本，跨模态要另配文本编码器。
why_en: Pick ResNet: convolutional inductive biases and fast-converging pretrained checkpoints give low fine-tune cost and ~10ms inference, fitting the mobile latency budget.
tradeoff: ResNet(约 10ms、微调便宜) vs ViT/CLIP(更准/跨模态但 30–50ms、更贵)
whenOtherWins: 若要跨域泛化或原生图文跨模态检索(图搜商品)，CLIP 更合适；若不缺预训练数据、追求大规模图搜图精度上限，ViT 更合适。
options: ResNet：强归纳偏置、微调便宜、约 10ms/GPU 推理，适配移动端延迟约束
CLIP：因为它零样本跨模态最强，延迟不重要
ViT：因为大 benchmark 精度最高，移动端也该用最准的
都不选，直接暴力像素比对省掉编码器
options_en: ResNet: strong inductive biases, cheap fine-tuning, ~10ms/GPU inference, fitting the mobile latency budget.
CLIP: because it is best at zero-shot cross-modal, and latency does not matter.
ViT: because it has the highest large-benchmark accuracy, so mobile should use the most accurate too.
None: just do brute-force pixel comparison and skip the encoder.
optionExplanations: 对；移动端延迟约束是硬约束，ResNet 的约 10ms 推理+低微调成本+同域够用，正好卡这个 profile。
错；场景是同域图搜图且延迟极紧，CLIP 的 30–50ms 超预算、跨模态能力这里也用不上。
错；ViT 约 20–40ms 且 data-hungry，移动端延迟和微调预算都不允许，精度最高≠这里最合适。
错；像素比对不具语义、也不省算力，十亿级更不可行，答非所问。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the mobile latency budget is a hard constraint, and ResNet's ~10ms inference plus low fine-tune cost plus in-domain sufficiency fits this profile exactly.
Wrong — the scenario is in-domain image-to-image with a very tight budget, where CLIP's 30–50ms overshoots and its cross-modal power is unused.
Wrong — ViT at ~20–40ms and data-hungry violates both the mobile latency and fine-tune budgets; highest accuracy is not most-fit here.
Wrong — pixel comparison lacks semantics, saves no compute, and is infeasible at a billion scale, missing the point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 残差卷积网络，靠卷积的平移不变性等强归纳偏置，微调成本低、推理快，适合延迟约束场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ResNet (Residual Network) is a convolutional net whose inductive biases like translation invariance make it cheap to fine-tune and fast to run, fitting latency-constrained settings.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型结构自带的先验假设(如 CNN 的平移不变性)，让它用更少数据学得更快。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inductive bias is a structural prior a model carries (e.g. CNN translation invariance) that lets it learn faster with less data.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 图搜商品，需要跨域(真实照片↔目录图)且原生支持图文跨模态检索，微调资源较充足。
scenario_en: Image-to-product needing cross-domain (real photo↔catalog) and native image-text cross-modal retrieval, with ample fine-tune resources.
q: 这种跨模态场景该选哪种编码器？
q_en: Which encoder fits this cross-modal scenario?
why: 选 CLIP：双编码器(图+文)用对比学习训进共享潜空间，天然支持零样本跨模态检索、跨域泛化好。代价是约 30–50ms、微调吃资源，且只微调图像编码器会 alignment drift。这里跨模态是核心需求，CLIP 最匹配。
why_en: Pick CLIP: its dual image-text encoders trained contrastively into a shared latent space give native zero-shot cross-modal retrieval and strong cross-domain generalization.
tradeoff: CLIP(原生跨模态/跨域强) vs ResNet(快但无文本、跨域弱)
whenOtherWins: 若延迟预算极紧且只做同域图搜图，ResNet 的约 10ms 更合适；不需要文本模态时上 CLIP 是浪费。
options: ResNet：最快，跨模态可以后面再拼个文本编码器凑合
ViT：精度最高，跨模态需求可以忽略
CLIP：双编码器对比学习进共享潜空间，原生零样本跨模态+跨域泛化强，正合此场景
随便选，编码器对跨模态检索没有影响
options_en: ResNet: fastest, and cross-modal can be bolted on later with a text encoder.
ViT: highest accuracy, and the cross-modal need can be ignored.
CLIP: dual encoders contrastively trained into a shared latent space, native zero-shot cross-modal plus strong cross-domain, fitting this scenario.
Any encoder; it makes no difference to cross-modal retrieval.
optionExplanations: 错；ResNet 无原生文本，硬拼文本编码器还要额外对齐层，跨模态不是它的强项，事倍功半。
错；场景核心就是跨模态，忽略它等于答错题；ViT 也无原生多模态。
对；共享潜空间让图和文本可直接比对，跨域泛化又好，恰好命中图搜商品的跨模态核心需求。
错；编码器决定向量空间是否跨模态可比，选错直接决定能不能做图文检索，影响巨大。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — ResNet has no native text; bolting on a text encoder plus an alignment layer is not its strength, a lot of effort for little.
Wrong — the scenario's core is cross-modal, so ignoring it answers the wrong question, and ViT also lacks native multi-modality.
Correct — the shared latent space lets image and text be compared directly with good cross-domain transfer, hitting image-to-product's cross-modal core need.
Wrong — the encoder decides whether the vector space is cross-modal comparable, so the choice directly governs whether image-text retrieval works, a huge impact.

termDefinitions.meaning: 双编码器(图+文)对比学习模型，把图文映射进共享潜空间，支持零样本跨模态检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining) is a dual image-text encoder trained contrastively into a shared latent space for zero-shot cross-modal retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无需在目标任务上微调即可直接检索，靠预训练学到的通用图文对齐。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Zero-shot retrieval works without task-specific fine-tuning, relying on general image-text alignment learned in pretraining.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 要在 ResNet、ViT、CLIP 之间按泛化、微调成本、多模态能力做取舍，而非排名。
scenario_en: You must trade off ResNet, ViT, and CLIP on generalization, fine-tune cost, and multi-modality, not rank them.
q: ResNet / ViT / CLIP 在泛化、微调成本、多模态上如何对比？
q_en: How do ResNet, ViT, and CLIP compare on generalization, fine-tune cost, and multi-modality?
why: ResNet：同域内泛化好、微调便宜、无多模态，适合移动端延迟约束；ViT：大预训练下泛化强、微调中等、无原生多模态，适合大规模图搜图；CLIP：零样本跨域最强、微调贵、原生图文，适合跨模态/图搜商品。是三条 profile 的取舍不是排名。
why_en: ResNet is good in-domain, cheap to fine-tune, no multi-modal (mobile); ViT is strong with large pretraining, medium cost, no native multi-modal (large-scale image-to-image); CLIP is best zero-shot cross-domain, expensive, native image-text (cross-modal).
tradeoff: ResNet(便宜快、同域) vs ViT(准但 data-hungry) vs CLIP(跨模态但贵)
options: 三者优劣绝对：CLIP 永远最好，其次 ViT，ResNet 最差
ResNet 同域好/微调低/无多模态；ViT 泛化强/成本中/无原生多模态；CLIP 零样本跨域优/成本高/原生图文
三者能力完全相同，选哪个只看代码好不好写
ViT 微调最便宜、数据需求最低，任何场景都优先选它
options_en: There is an absolute ranking: CLIP is always best, then ViT, then ResNet worst.
ResNet is in-domain/low cost/no multi-modal; ViT is strong-generalization/medium cost/no native multi-modal; CLIP is zero-shot cross-domain/high cost/native image-text.
All three are identical in capability; choose by which is easiest to code.
ViT is cheapest to fine-tune with the lowest data need, so always prefer it.
optionExplanations: 错；不存在绝对排名，本课明确说是按延迟/规模/微调资源匹配 profile 的取舍。
对；每种架构有清晰的 profile，按延迟预算、索引规模、微调资源匹配，而非分高下。
错；三者能力差异巨大(跨模态/泛化/成本),不是编码难易问题。
错；ViT 恰恰 data-hungry、微调成本中等，不是最便宜也非万能首选。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — there is no absolute ranking; the lesson says to match a profile by latency/scale/fine-tune resources as a trade-off.
Correct — each architecture has a clear profile, matched by latency budget, index scale, and fine-tune resources rather than ranked.
Wrong — the three differ enormously (cross-modal/generalization/cost), not a coding-ease question.
Wrong — ViT is actually data-hungry with medium fine-tune cost, neither cheapest nor a universal default.

termDefinitions.meaning: 视觉 Transformer，用自注意力让每个 patch 关注全局，大预训练下检索精度高但 data-hungry。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ViT (Vision Transformer) uses self-attention so every patch attends globally, giving high retrieval accuracy with large pretraining but is data-hungry.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个特征能看到的输入范围；ViT 靠自注意力实现全局感受野，CNN 靠堆卷积逐层扩大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The receptive field is how much input a feature can see; ViT gets a global one via self-attention while CNNs grow it by stacking convolutions.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 用领域数据微调 CLIP 提升目录检索，但为省事只微调了图像编码器，文本编码器冻结不动。
scenario_en: Fine-tuning CLIP on domain data to improve catalog retrieval, but to save effort only the image encoder is trained while the text encoder is frozen.
q: 只微调 CLIP 的图像编码器会导致什么问题？
q_en: What problem arises from fine-tuning only CLIP's image encoder?
why: alignment drift：图像 embedding 在微调中漂移，而文本 embedding 冻结不动，两个空间失去对齐→跨模态余弦不再可靠，图文检索退化。要么图文联合微调(两空间一起动、保持对齐)，要么用 adapter 层限制漂移。
why_en: Alignment drift: the image embeddings shift during fine-tuning while the text embeddings stay fixed, desyncing the two spaces so cross-modal cosine becomes unreliable.
tradeoff: 只微调图像编码器(省事但 drift) vs 图文联合微调(保持对齐但成本高)
diagram:
flowchart LR I[图像编码器
微调后漂移] -.失去对齐.-> T[文本编码器
冻结不动] I --> X[跨模态余弦不可靠]
options: 没问题，只动图像编码器更省算力，检索质量不受影响
会让文本编码器过拟合，图搜图反而变差
alignment drift：图像 embedding 漂移、文本冻结，两空间失对齐→跨模态余弦不可靠，图文检索退化
会导致模型无法收敛，训练直接崩溃
options_en: No problem; training only the image encoder saves compute and retrieval quality is unaffected.
It overfits the text encoder and makes image-to-image worse.
Alignment drift: image embeddings shift while text is frozen, desyncing the two spaces so cross-modal cosine is unreliable and image-text retrieval degrades.
It prevents the model from converging and training crashes outright.
optionExplanations: 错；省了算力却毁了对齐，跨模态检索质量恰恰受重创，不是不受影响。
错；文本编码器是冻结的不会过拟合，问题出在图像侧漂移离开了文本空间。
对；共享空间的价值靠两侧对齐维持，单动一侧就撕裂对齐，跨模态余弦失真是直接后果。
错；训练照常收敛，问题是收敛到一个与文本空间错位的图像空间,不是崩溃。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — it saves compute but wrecks alignment, so cross-modal retrieval quality is badly hurt, not unaffected.
Wrong — the text encoder is frozen and cannot overfit; the issue is the image side drifting away from the text space.
Correct — the shared space's value depends on both sides staying aligned, so moving only one tears the alignment and distorts cross-modal cosine.
Wrong — training converges fine; the problem is converging to an image space misaligned with the text space, not a crash.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只微调 CLIP 一侧编码器使图、文 embedding 空间不再对齐，跨模态相似度失真。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alignment drift is when fine-tuning only one CLIP encoder desyncs the image and text embedding spaces, distorting cross-modal similarity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在冻结主干上插入的小可训练层，以低成本适配领域并限制对齐漂移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An adapter layer is a small trainable layer inserted on a frozen backbone to adapt to a domain cheaply while limiting alignment drift.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 红色皮革钱包和红色皮革手袋在 embedding 空间里几乎重合，但它们是不同品类。
scenario_en: A red leather wallet and a red leather handbag sit almost on top of each other in embedding space, yet are different categories.
q: 为什么只靠视觉相似度做检索不够，要怎么补？
q_en: Why is visual similarity alone insufficient, and how do you fix it?
why: 纯视觉 embedding 会把'看起来像'的错品类拉到一起(红钱包≈红手袋)，检回对但不对款。补法：两阶段——检索只用视觉快速取候选，重排再融合文本相关性(品类/元数据)把错品类压下去。视觉负责快召回，文本负责纠品类。
why_en: Pure visual embeddings pull look-alike wrong categories together (wallet≈handbag), so add a re-ranking stage that fuses text relevance to correct the category.
tradeoff: 只用视觉(快但混品类) vs 加文本重排(纠品类但多一阶段成本)
options: 只靠视觉就够，红钱包和红手袋本来就该算相似
换更大的图像编码器就能区分品类，不需要文本信号
纯视觉会把错品类拉到一起(红钱包≈红手袋)；用两阶段+文本重排融合品类/元数据纠正
把相似度阈值调到极高，只留一模一样的图,品类问题自然消失
options_en: Visual alone is enough; a red wallet and a red handbag should count as similar anyway.
A bigger image encoder can tell categories apart, so no text signal is needed.
Pure visual pulls wrong categories together (wallet≈handbag); a two-stage pipeline with text re-ranking fuses category/metadata to fix it.
Set the similarity threshold extremely high to keep only identical images, and category issues vanish.
optionExplanations: 错；用户要的是对的品类不是纯视觉像，把钱包当手袋推正是要避免的失败。
错；再大的视觉模型也难仅凭外观分清同色异类,文本元数据是更直接的品类信号。
对；视觉快召回+文本重排纠品类分工明确，直接解决 look-alike 错品类问题。
错；阈值拉到极高会暴增空结果、扼杀召回，且同色异类仍可能极相似,治标不治本。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — users want the correct category, not mere visual likeness, and pushing a wallet as a handbag is exactly the failure to avoid.
Wrong — even a bigger visual model struggles to separate same-color different-category by appearance alone; text metadata is a more direct category signal.
Correct — visual for fast recall plus text re-ranking for category correction is a clean split that directly solves look-alike wrong categories.
Wrong — an extreme threshold explodes zero-results and kills recall, and same-color different-category can still look nearly identical, treating symptoms not cause.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在视觉检索候选上再融合文本相关性等信号重新排序,纠正纯视觉的错品类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multi-modal re-ranking rescores visual-retrieval candidates by fusing text relevance and other signals, correcting pure-visual category errors.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 检索要在十亿向量里 <10ms 出候选,重排要在小候选集上精排且落在 10–30ms 预算。
scenario_en: Retrieval must return candidates from a billion vectors in <10ms, while re-ranking must precisely reorder a small set within a 10–30ms budget.
q: 两阶段管线里,视觉和文本信号该怎么分工?
q_en: In the two-stage pipeline, how should visual and text signals be divided?
why: 检索阶段只用视觉 embedding:纯视觉余弦快、能在十亿向量里 <10ms 近似召回 top-k。重排阶段在小得多的 top-k(100–500)上融合视觉+文本(BM25 或轻量 cross-encoder),拼接分数过小 MLP/GBDT 得融合相关性,落 10–30ms。快而近似 vs 精而多模态。
why_en: Retrieval uses vision-only embeddings for a fast <10ms ANN recall of top-k, then re-ranking on the small top-k (100–500) fuses visual plus text via a small MLP/GBDT within 10–30ms.
tradeoff: 检索(视觉-only、快、近似、十亿级) vs 重排(多模态、精、小候选集)
diagram:
flowchart LR Q[查询图] --> R["检索: 视觉-only ANN
<10ms, 十亿级"] --> K["top-k 100-500"] --> RR["重排: 视觉+文本融合
10-30ms"]
whenOtherWins: 若候选集本就很小(千级以下)且延迟宽松,可跳过两阶段直接用多模态精排;两阶段的价值在十亿级召回必须先快后精。
options: 检索和重排都用视觉+文本全信号,保证每步都最准
检索只用文本 BM25,重排才引入视觉,反过来分工
检索用视觉-only ANN 在十亿级 <10ms 召回 top-k;重排在小候选集融合视觉+文本(MLP/GBDT),10–30ms
只做检索不做重排,靠视觉召回直接返回,省掉一阶段
options_en: Use full visual+text signals in both retrieval and re-ranking so every step is maximally accurate.
Retrieval uses text BM25 only and visual is added at re-ranking — the reverse division.
Retrieval uses vision-only ANN to recall top-k in <10ms at billion scale; re-ranking fuses visual+text (MLP/GBDT) on the small set within 10–30ms.
Do only retrieval and skip re-ranking, returning visual recall directly to save a stage.
optionExplanations: 错;十亿级用全信号精排跑不进 <10ms,重信号必须留给小候选集,否则延迟爆表。
错;十亿级用文本 BM25 主召回既慢又丢视觉主线,分工反了。
对;先用便宜的视觉余弦大规模快召回,再在小集合上花得起多模态精排,各自卡住自己的延迟预算。
错;省掉重排就回到纯视觉错品类问题(红钱包≈红手袋),质量代价太大。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — full-signal precise ranking over a billion cannot fit <10ms; heavy signals must be reserved for the small set or latency blows up.
Wrong — text BM25 as the billion-scale primary recall is slow and drops the visual main line, reversing the division.
Correct — cheap visual cosine for large-scale fast recall, then affordable multi-modal precision on the small set, each within its own latency budget.
Wrong — skipping re-ranking reverts to pure-visual category errors (wallet≈handbag), too large a quality cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先视觉-only ANN 快召回 top-k,再多模态重排精排小候选集,兼顾规模与精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two-stage retrieval first recalls top-k with vision-only ANN, then precisely re-ranks the small set multi-modally, balancing scale and precision.

termDefinitions.meaning: 经典文本检索打分函数,按词频/逆文档频率衡量查询与文档的相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BM25 (Best Matching 25) is a classic text-retrieval scoring function ranking query-document relevance by term frequency and inverse document frequency.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 重排阶段要把视觉相似度分和文本相关度分拼在一起,学一个融合相关性分,团队要在 MLP 和 GBDT 间选。
scenario_en: Re-ranking must fuse visual and text scores into one learned relevance, and the team chooses between an MLP and a GBDT.
q: 拼接视觉+文本分做融合打分,MLP 和 GBDT 怎么选?
q_en: To fuse visual and text scores, how do you choose between MLP and GBDT?
why: 把视觉分+文本分拼成特征向量喂一个小融合模型:MLP 端到端可微、能与编码器联合训、相关性更好但难调试;GBDT(LambdaMART)把分当表格特征,迭代快、可解释(特征重要性)、易调试,但不能联合训。按需要联合训还是要可解释来选。
why_en: Concatenate visual and text scores into a small fusion model: an MLP is end-to-end differentiable and jointly trainable but harder to debug, while a GBDT is fast to iterate and interpretable but not jointly trainable.
tradeoff: MLP(可微/可联合训/难调试) vs GBDT(可解释/迭代快/不能联合训)
whenOtherWins: 若想端到端与编码器联合优化、追求相关性上限,选 MLP;若要快速迭代、特征可解释、易线上调试,选 GBDT。
options: MLP:端到端可微、能与编码器联合训、相关性更好但难调试;GBDT:迭代快、可解释、易调试但不能联合训
两者完全等价,随便选,融合效果一样
GBDT 是深度模型可端到端联合训,MLP 是树模型不能微分
只能用规则加权求和,MLP 和 GBDT 都不适合做融合
options_en: MLP: end-to-end differentiable, jointly trainable with encoders, better relevance but harder to debug; GBDT: fast to iterate, interpretable, easy to debug but not jointly trainable.
They are equivalent; pick either and fusion works the same.
GBDT is a deep model trainable end-to-end, and MLP is a tree model that cannot differentiate.
Only rule-based weighted sums work; neither MLP nor GBDT suits fusion.
optionExplanations: 对;两者是不同取舍轴——要联合优化/相关性上限选 MLP,要可解释/快迭代/易调试选 GBDT。
错;二者在可微性、可解释性、能否联合训上差别明显,不是随便选。
说反了;MLP 才是可微的神经网络,GBDT 是梯度提升树、不能与编码器端到端联合训。
错;规则加权太死板学不到复杂交互,MLP/GBDT 正是为学融合分而用,这条否定了正解。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — they are different trade-off axes: MLP for joint optimization and relevance ceiling, GBDT for interpretability, fast iteration, and easy debugging.
Wrong — they differ clearly in differentiability, interpretability, and joint trainability, not interchangeable.
Backwards — the MLP is the differentiable neural net, while GBDT is gradient-boosted trees that cannot train end-to-end with encoders.
Wrong — rule-based sums are too rigid to learn complex interactions; MLP/GBDT exist precisely to learn the fusion score, so this denies the right answer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多层感知机,可微神经网络,可与编码器端到端联合训练学融合相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MLP (Multi-Layer Perceptron) is a differentiable neural net trainable end-to-end with encoders to learn fused relevance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 梯度提升决策树,把分数当表格特征,迭代快、可解释,但不能与编码器联合训。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GBDT (Gradient Boosted Decision Trees) treats scores as tabular features, fast and interpretable, but not jointly trainable with encoders.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 十亿级图库里,同一张图有大量精确重复,还有裁剪/加水印/调色的近重复。
scenario_en: In a billion-image library, exact duplicates abound plus near-duplicates from crops, watermarks, and color shifts.
q: 重复和近重复不处理会带来什么后果?
q_en: What happens if duplicates and near-duplicates go unhandled?
why: 精确重复白占存储、还挤掉结果多样性;近重复(裁剪/水印/调色)会虚高召回、让 top-10 全是几乎一样的图,惹恼用户。所以去重既省索引又提体验,是十亿级的关键管线问题。
why_en: Exact dupes waste storage and hurt diversity, while near-dupes (crops, watermarks, color shifts) inflate recall and fill the top-10 with near-identical images, frustrating users.
options: 重复无害,反而能加强热门图的曝光,不用处理
只影响存储成本,对检索结果质量没有任何影响
精确重复浪费存储+损多样性;近重复虚高召回、top-10 near-identical 惹恼用户,去重省索引又提体验
近重复会自动被 ANN 过滤掉,不需要专门去重
options_en: Duplicates are harmless and even boost exposure of popular images, so no handling is needed.
It only affects storage cost with no impact on retrieval result quality.
Exact dupes waste storage and hurt diversity; near-dupes inflate recall and fill the top-10 with near-identical results frustrating users, so dedup saves index and improves experience.
Near-duplicates are automatically filtered by ANN, so no dedicated dedup is needed.
optionExplanations: 错;重复堆曝光只会让结果单调、多样性崩,用户体验变差不是变好。
错;近重复直接毁 top-10 多样性,是结果质量问题不只是存储。
对;两类重复分别打击存储/多样性和召回/体验,去重是同时省成本、提质量的关键步骤。
错;ANN 只找最近邻,近重复恰恰是最近邻,会被原样召回,不会自动去掉。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — piling on exposure makes results monotonous and collapses diversity, worsening experience not improving it.
Wrong — near-dupes directly ruin top-10 diversity, a result-quality issue, not just storage.
Correct — the two dup types hit storage/diversity and recall/experience respectively, so dedup both saves cost and raises quality.
Wrong — ANN finds nearest neighbors, and near-dupes are exactly the nearest neighbors, so they get recalled as-is, not auto-removed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 非逐像素相同但内容几乎一样的图(裁剪/水印/调色),会虚高召回、损结果多样性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A near-duplicate is not pixel-identical but nearly the same content (crop, watermark, color shift), inflating recall and hurting diversity.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

q: 把两遍去重管线按执行顺序排列:
q_en: Order the two-pass deduplication pipeline:
scenario: 十亿级图库要既高效又准确地去重,先粗筛再精聚类。
scenario_en: A billion-image library must dedup both efficiently and accurately, coarse-filter first then precisely cluster.
steps: 桶内计算两两 embedding 余弦相似度,低于阈值聚成一簇
用感知哈希(pHash/dHash)对全库做 O(1) 粗筛,分到哈希桶
每簇按质量(分辨率、无水印)选一张 canonical 代表图保留
why: 先用 pHash/dHash 做 O(1) 粗筛把候选分桶(便宜、能挡掉精确/近精确重复),再在桶内算两两 embedding 余弦精聚类,最后每簇按质量选 canonical 代表。先便宜粗筛再贵精算,是十亿级可行的关键。
why_en: First perceptual-hash the whole library O(1) into buckets, then compute pairwise embedding cosine within each bucket to cluster, then pick a quality canonical per cluster.
diagram:
flowchart LR H["pHash/dHash 粗筛
O(1) 分桶"] --> C["桶内余弦聚类"] --> R["选 canonical 代表"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 感知哈希:对图像内容算指纹,内容相近哈希也相近,O(1) 比对可快速筛重复。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pHash (perceptual hash) fingerprints image content so similar images have similar hashes, enabling O(1) duplicate screening.

termDefinitions.meaning: 差值哈希:更轻量的感知哈希,按相邻像素梯度方向生成指纹。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: dHash (difference hash) is a lighter perceptual hash that fingerprints images by the gradient direction between adjacent pixels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个重复簇里按质量(分辨率、无水印)选出的唯一保留图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A canonical representative is the single image kept per duplicate cluster, chosen by quality like resolution and no watermark.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 去重的相似度阈值要定:一个商品有 5 种颜色,理应各自出现;但裁剪/水印近重复该合并。
scenario_en: You must set the dedup similarity threshold: a product in 5 colors should each appear, but crop/watermark near-dupes should merge.
q: 去重阈值太激进(太紧)会有什么代价?
q_en: What is the cost of an over-aggressive (too-tight) dedup threshold?
why: 阈值太紧会把合法变体误合(5 色商品塌成 1 个),损失应有的多样性和商品覆盖。阈值太松又漏掉近重复、top-10 全一样。所以要在已知变体组的留出集上校验阈值,再上线。Pinterest 去重砍了约 15% 索引同时提升感知质量。
why_en: A too-tight threshold collapses legitimate variants (5 colors into 1), losing diversity and coverage, so validate the threshold against held-out known-variant groups before deploying.
tradeoff: 阈值太紧(误合法变体、损多样性) vs 太松(漏近重复、top-10 雷同)
whenOtherWins: 若库里几乎没有合法变体、只有纯拷贝(如证件照库),可用更紧阈值多去重;有多色/多角度合法变体时必须放宽并做变体组校验。
options: 太紧只会更干净,没有任何代价,能紧就尽量紧
太紧会把合法变体(如 5 色商品)误合成 1 个,损多样性/覆盖;要用已知变体留出集校验阈值
阈值和多样性无关,只影响去重速度
太紧会漏掉近重复,让 top-10 变得雷同
options_en: Tighter is only cleaner with no cost, so tighten as much as possible.
Too tight merges legitimate variants (e.g. 5 colors into 1), losing diversity/coverage, so validate the threshold on held-out known-variant groups.
The threshold is unrelated to diversity and only affects dedup speed.
Too tight lets near-duplicates through, making the top-10 look identical.
optionExplanations: 错;太紧会误杀合法变体,牺牲多样性与商品覆盖,代价真实存在。
对;紧阈值把该保留的多色变体塌掉,必须靠变体组留出集把阈值校准到既去重又保变体。
错;阈值直接决定哪些图被合并,深刻影响多样性,不只是速度。
说反了;漏近重复、top-10 雷同是阈值太松的后果,不是太紧。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — too tight kills legitimate variants, sacrificing diversity and product coverage, a real cost.
Correct — a tight threshold collapses multi-color variants that should stay, so a variant-group held-out set is needed to calibrate between deduping and preserving variants.
Wrong — the threshold decides which images merge and deeply affects diversity, not just speed.
Backwards — missing near-dupes and an identical top-10 is the consequence of too loose, not too tight.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一商品的正当不同版本(多颜色/多角度),应各自保留而非被去重合并。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A legitimate variant is a valid different version of the same product (color, angle) that should be kept, not merged away by dedup.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 离线 recall 很高,但用户反馈 top-10 结果几乎一模一样(同图的不同裁剪/水印版)。
scenario_en: Offline recall is high, but users report the top-10 results look nearly identical (crop/watermark versions of one image).
q: 这个症状指向什么问题?
q_en: What does this symptom point to?
why: 去重相似度阈值太宽松(permissive):近重复没被合并,同一张图的多个版本一起挤进 top-10,recall 看着高实则多样性崩。修法是收紧阈值/补近重复检测,让每个内容只保留 canonical 代表。
why_en: The dedup similarity threshold is too permissive: near-duplicates were not merged, so multiple versions of one image crowd the top-10, inflating recall while diversity collapses.
options: 编码器太弱,换更大模型就能让 top-10 更多样
ANN 召回不足,加大 top-k 就能提升多样性
去重阈值太宽松:近重复没合并,同图多版本挤进 top-10,recall 虚高但多样性崩
延迟太高导致结果重复,优化速度即可
options_en: The encoder is too weak; a bigger model would diversify the top-10.
ANN recall is insufficient; increasing top-k would improve diversity.
The dedup threshold is too permissive: near-dupes were not merged, so one image's versions crowd the top-10, inflating recall while diversity collapses.
Latency is too high causing duplicate results; optimizing speed fixes it.
optionExplanations: 错;换大模型不解决重复项没被去掉的问题,近重复照样最近邻,top-10 仍雷同。
错;加大 top-k 只会召回更多同图版本,多样性更差不是更好。
对;症状(高 recall+雷同 top-10)正是去重太松的特征,收紧阈值/补近重复检测即可。
错;延迟与结果是否重复无关,速度救不了去重阈值太松。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a bigger model does not remove un-deduped copies; near-dupes remain nearest neighbors and the top-10 stays identical.
Wrong — increasing top-k recalls more versions of the same image, worsening diversity not improving it.
Correct — the symptom (high recall plus identical top-10) is the signature of too-permissive dedup, fixed by tightening the threshold or adding near-dup detection.
Wrong — latency is unrelated to result duplication; speed cannot fix a too-loose dedup threshold.

termDefinitions.meaning: 去重相似度门槛太低,近重复不被判为重复,导致同图多版本共存于结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A permissive threshold is too low a dedup bar, so near-duplicates are not caught and multiple versions of one image coexist in results.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 评审问去重到底值不值得做,你要给一个可信的行业量级。
scenario_en: Review asks whether dedup is worth it, and you need a credible industry magnitude.
q: 去重能带来多大量级的收益?说明什么?
q_en: What magnitude of benefit does dedup bring, and what does it show?
why: Pinterest 报告去重砍了约 15% 索引规模,同时提升了感知质量(结果更多样)。这个约 15% 是经验观测,说明去重不是可选优化——它同时省存储/索引成本又提体验,是十亿级数据层的必要一环。
why_en: Pinterest reports dedup cut the index by about 15% while improving perceived quality, showing dedup both saves cost and improves experience, not an optional add-on.
options: 去重只省不到 0.1% 索引,基本没用,可以跳过
去重会让索引变大约 15%,是净成本,得不偿失
Pinterest 去重砍约 15% 索引同时提升感知质量,说明它同时省成本又提体验,是必要一环
去重收益无法量化,纯靠感觉,不值得投入
options_en: Dedup saves under 0.1% of the index, basically useless, so skip it.
Dedup grows the index by about 15% as a net cost, not worth it.
Pinterest's dedup cut about 15% of the index while improving perceived quality, showing it both saves cost and improves experience, a necessary step.
Dedup's benefit cannot be quantified, purely a feeling, not worth investing in.
optionExplanations: 错;约 15% 的索引缩减在十亿级是巨大存储/成本节省,远非可忽略。
说反了;去重是缩小索引不是增大,方向搞反。
对;约 15% 的经验数字把'省成本+提体验'量化,论证去重是数据层必要环节而非可选。
错;Pinterest 已给出约 15% 的可量化收益,并非无法衡量。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a ~15% index reduction at a billion scale is huge storage/cost savings, far from negligible.
Backwards — dedup shrinks the index, not grows it; the direction is reversed.
Correct — the ~15% empirical figure quantifies 'save cost plus improve experience,' arguing dedup is a necessary data-layer step, not optional.
Wrong — Pinterest gives a quantifiable ~15% benefit, so it is not unmeasurable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 去重去掉冗余图后索引规模的下降比例(Pinterest 约 15%),直接省存储与检索成本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Index reduction is the drop in index size after dedup removes redundant images (Pinterest ~15%), directly saving storage and retrieval cost.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 要给十亿级图库加 NSFW/政策过滤,有人提议在检索返回结果后再过滤,反正最终会挡住。
scenario_en: Adding NSFW/policy filtering to a billion-image library, someone proposes filtering after retrieval returns results since it blocks in the end anyway.
q: 安全过滤该放在管线的哪一步?
q_en: Where in the pipeline should safety filtering sit?
why: 放在 embedding+索引之前的摄取阶段做上游门禁:过滤放在索引后会白白在不安全内容上耗存储/算力/索引容量;而检索后过滤一旦失败或延迟抖动,不安全内容就直达用户。前置门禁既省资源又堵住泄露路径。
why_en: Filter upstream at ingestion, before embedding and indexing: post-index filtering wastes storage/compute/index on unsafe content, and post-retrieval filtering lets unsafe content reach users on any failure.
tradeoff: 上游门禁(省资源+堵泄露) vs 检索后过滤(白耗索引且失败即泄露)
diagram:
flowchart LR
  I[摄取] --> S{NSFW/政策检测}
  S -->|超阈值| Q[隔离/人工复核]
  S -->|通过| E[embedding+索引]
whenOtherWins: 对已受信、来源可控的私有目录(如自家审核过的商品库),前置门禁可轻量化;开放爬取内容必须严格前置。
options: 检索返回后再过滤,反正最终会挡住不安全内容,简单省事
放在 embedding+索引之前的摄取门禁:否则白耗索引资源,且检索后过滤失败即泄露给用户
过滤放在最后展示层的前端,让浏览器判断是否显示
不过滤,靠用户举报事后删除即可
options_en: Filter after retrieval returns, since it blocks unsafe content in the end, simple and easy.
Put it as an ingestion gate before embedding and indexing: otherwise index resources are wasted and post-retrieval filtering leaks to users on failure.
Filter at the front-end display layer and let the browser decide whether to show.
Do not filter; rely on user reports to delete afterward.
optionExplanations: 错;检索后过滤先把不安全内容 embedding、索引了,浪费资源,还留下过滤失败即泄露的窗口。
对;前置门禁在摄取就挡住,既不浪费下游算力/索引,又根除检索后泄露风险,是 Staff+ 的平台思维。
错;把安全判断丢给前端不可靠、易被绕过,不安全内容已进系统,门禁太靠后。
错;事后删除意味着不安全内容已触达用户,安全过滤必须前置预防而非补救。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — post-retrieval filtering first embeds and indexes unsafe content, wasting resources and leaving a leak window on filter failure.
Correct — an ingestion gate blocks at entry, wasting no downstream compute/index and eliminating post-retrieval leakage, the Staff+ platform view.
Wrong — delegating safety to the front-end is unreliable and bypassable, and unsafe content already entered the system, gating far too late.
Wrong — deleting afterward means unsafe content already reached users; safety filtering must prevent upstream, not remediate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不适宜公开展示的内容(色情/暴力等),需在摄取阶段由分类器检出并隔离。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NSFW (Not Safe For Work) is content unsuitable for public display (explicit/violent), detected and quarantined by a classifier at ingestion.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在管线早期(摄取)就拦截不合规内容,避免下游浪费资源与泄露风险。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An upstream gate blocks non-compliant content early (at ingestion), avoiding downstream resource waste and leakage risk.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 要在摄取阶段对每张图判 NSFW+政策违规(暴力/仇恨符号/版权),且不能拖慢管线太多。
scenario_en: At ingestion you must score each image for NSFW plus policy violations (violence, hate symbols, copyright) without slowing the pipeline much.
q: 上游安全过滤该用什么设计?
q_en: What design should upstream safety filtering use?
why: 用轻量二分类器(小/蒸馏 CNN)在摄取时对每张图打 NSFW+政策分:超阈值→进隔离队列人工复核;低于→放行进 embedding 管线。轻量是为了不拖慢十亿级摄取,人工复核兜住边界样本。
why_en: Use a lightweight binary classifier (small/distilled CNN) at ingestion to score each image for NSFW+policy: above threshold goes to a human-review quarantine queue, below proceeds to embedding.
options: 用一个几十亿参数的大模型逐张精判,慢一点没关系
轻量二分类器(小/蒸馏 CNN)摄取时打分:超阈值进隔离队列人工复核,低于放行进 embedding
靠关键词过滤文件名,不看图像内容
让用户上传时自己勾选是否安全,系统信任其声明
options_en: Use a multi-billion-parameter model to judge each image precisely; a bit slow is fine.
A lightweight binary classifier (small/distilled CNN) scores at ingestion: above threshold goes to a human-review quarantine queue, below proceeds to embedding.
Filter by keywords in the filename without looking at image content.
Let users self-declare safety at upload and trust their claim.
optionExplanations: 错;十亿级摄取用超大模型逐张精判会成瓶颈,过滤器要轻量才跟得上吞吐。
对;蒸馏小 CNN 快速打分、超阈值转人工复核,兼顾吞吐与边界样本的准确,是标准上游门禁设计。
错;文件名关键词绕不过改名,也看不懂图像内容,挡不住真正的违规图。
错;信任用户自我声明等于没有门禁,不安全内容会大量混入。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — a giant model judging each image at billion-scale ingestion becomes a bottleneck; the filter must be lightweight to match throughput.
Correct — a distilled small CNN scores fast and routes above-threshold to human review, balancing throughput and borderline accuracy, the standard upstream gate.
Wrong — filename keywords are defeated by renaming and cannot read image content, missing real violations.
Wrong — trusting user self-declaration is no gate at all, and unsafe content floods in.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被安全分类器判为可疑的图暂存于此,等待人工复核再决定删除或放行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quarantine queue holds images flagged suspicious by the safety classifier for human review before deletion or release.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由大模型蒸馏出的小卷积网络,推理快、成本低,适合摄取阶段高吞吐打分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distilled CNN is a small convolutional net distilled from a large model, fast and cheap for high-throughput scoring at ingestion.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 安全过滤阈值定太严,把医学影像、艺术裸体等合法内容也误判成违规删掉了。
scenario_en: The safety threshold is set too strict, wrongly removing legitimate content like medical imagery and fine-art nudes as violations.
q: 安全过滤的核心张力是什么,误报太多会怎样?
q_en: What is safety filtering's central tension, and what does over-flagging cause?
why: 核心张力是 false positive:太严会误删合法内容(医学影像、艺术),抬高空结果率(zero-result rate);太松又放不安全内容过关。安全过滤的误报率直接驱动 zero-result 指标。业界(Google SafeSearch)用分级阈值+边界样本人工复核折中。
why_en: The tension is false positives: too strict removes legitimate content (medical, fine art) and raises zero-result rate, while too permissive lets unsafe through, so tiered thresholds plus human review balance it.
tradeoff: 太严(误删合法、升 zero-result) vs 太松(放行不安全内容)
options: 没有张力,阈值越严越好,宁可错杀不可放过
核心张力是 false positive:太严误删合法内容、抬高 zero-result;太松放不安全内容;用分级阈值+人工复核折中
误报只影响存储,不影响任何检索指标
误报会降低延迟,所以其实是好事
options_en: There is no tension; stricter is always better, better to over-remove than let through.
The tension is false positives: too strict removes legitimate content and raises zero-result, too permissive lets unsafe through; balance with tiered thresholds plus human review.
False positives only affect storage, not any retrieval metric.
False positives reduce latency, so they are actually good.
optionExplanations: 错;宁可错杀会误删医学/艺术等合法内容,推高空结果率、伤害覆盖,不是越严越好。
对;误报把合法内容挡在门外直接抬高 zero-result,漏报又放不安全内容,分级阈值+人工复核是标准折中。
错;误删合法内容直接推高 zero-result rate,是明确的检索指标恶化,不只是存储。
错;误报与延迟无关,还会恶化覆盖与用户体验,绝非好事。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — over-removing kills legitimate medical/art content, raising zero-result and hurting coverage; stricter is not always better.
Correct — false positives bar legitimate content and directly raise zero-result while false negatives let unsafe through, so tiered thresholds plus human review are the standard balance.
Wrong — removing legitimate content directly raises zero-result rate, a clear retrieval-metric degradation, not just storage.
Wrong — false positives are unrelated to latency and worsen coverage and experience, far from good.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把合法内容误判为违规删掉,直接推高 zero-result rate、损害覆盖。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A safety false positive wrongly flags legitimate content as a violation and removes it, directly raising zero-result rate and hurting coverage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对分类器判不准的边界样本引入人工判定,平衡误报与漏报。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Human-in-the-loop routes borderline classifier cases to human judgment, balancing false positives and false negatives.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 数据层各阶段不是孤立的,一个阶段的质量会传导到另一个阶段。
scenario_en: Data-layer stages are not isolated; one stage's quality propagates to another.
q: 数据层各阶段之间有哪些真实的相互影响?(多选)
q_en: Which real cross-stage interconnections exist in the data layer? (multiple)
why: 两条真实传导:①更好的 embedding→去重簇更紧(同物聚得更准);②安全过滤的误报率直接驱动 zero-result rate(误删合法内容=更多空结果)。这些串联说明数据层要整体设计,不能各管一段。
why_en: Better embeddings make dedup clusters tighter, and the safety-filter false-positive rate directly drives the zero-result rate, so the data layer must be designed as a whole.
options: 更好的 embedding → 去重簇更紧(同一物体聚得更准)
安全过滤误报率 → 直接抬高 zero-result rate(误删合法内容)
去重阈值 → 影响 top-10 结果的多样性
GPU 品牌 → 决定 embedding 的语义质量
options_en: Better embeddings → tighter dedup clusters (same object groups more accurately).
Safety-filter false-positive rate → directly raises zero-result rate (removes legitimate content).
Dedup threshold → affects the diversity of the top-10 results.
GPU brand → determines the semantic quality of embeddings.
optionExplanations: 对;embedding 空间更好,同物体距离更近,去重聚类更准更紧,是真实传导。
对;安全误报=误删合法图,合法内容变少直接推高空结果率,是明确的跨阶段影响。
对;去重阈值松紧直接决定 top-10 里保留多少同图版本,影响多样性。
错;GPU 品牌只影响算力/速度,embedding 的语义质量由模型与训练数据决定,与品牌无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — a better embedding space brings same objects closer, making dedup clustering more accurate and tighter, a real propagation.
Correct — safety false positives remove legitimate images, and fewer legitimate items directly raise zero-result, a clear cross-stage effect.
Correct — the dedup threshold's tightness decides how many versions of one image remain in the top-10, affecting diversity.
Incorrect — GPU brand only affects compute/speed; embedding semantic quality comes from the model and training data, unrelated to brand.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据层一个阶段的质量或参数影响另一个阶段的指标,要求整体协同设计。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross-stage interconnection is when one data-layer stage's quality or parameter affects another stage's metric, demanding holistic design.

category: Visual Search Data Strategy Embedding Generation

scenario: 把原始 CLIP 嵌入做成生产级视觉搜索(Pinterest Lens / Google Lens):用户拍一张图,返回相似商品并可按属性筛选。
scenario_en: Turning raw CLIP embeddings into production visual search (Pinterest Lens / Google Lens): a user snaps a photo, gets similar products, and can filter by attribute.
q: 生产级视觉搜索的三大架构决策是什么？
q_en: What are the three architectural decisions of production visual search?
why: 三大决策:(1)CLIP 编码器配置(zero-shot/联合微调/区域特征)决定检索质量;(2)跨模态 re-ranking——快速 ANN 召回后,用融合打分重排;(3)属性抽取头,给结果做 faceted 筛选(颜色/风格/品类)。L5+ 会追问 modality gap、微调时的 alignment drift、延迟预算。
why_en: Three decisions: CLIP encoder config for retrieval, cross-modal re-ranking after fast ANN recall, and attribute-extraction heads for faceted filtering — with senior probes on the modality gap, alignment drift, and latency budgets.
diagram:
flowchart LR Q["查询图"] --> E["CLIP 图像编码器"] E --> A["ANN 召回 top-k"] A --> R["跨模态 re-rank
融合三路分数"] R --> F["属性头 faceted 筛选"] F --> O["结果"]
options: (1)选向量数据库 (2)选 CDN (3)选前端框架
(1)CLIP 编码器配置(检索) (2)跨模态 re-ranking (3)属性抽取头(faceted 筛选)
(1)训练一个从零的图像分类器 (2)接入支付 (3)做用户画像
(1)只用 zero-shot CLIP (2)不做重排 (3)不做属性筛选,越简单越好
options_en: (1) pick a vector DB, (2) pick a CDN, (3) pick a frontend framework.
(1) CLIP encoder config (retrieval), (2) cross-modal re-ranking, (3) attribute-extraction heads (faceted filtering).
(1) train an image classifier from scratch, (2) integrate payments, (3) build user profiles.
(1) use only zero-shot CLIP, (2) skip re-ranking, (3) skip attribute filtering — simpler is better.
optionExplanations: 向量库/CDN/前端是周边基建,不是视觉搜索的模型架构决策。
对;编码器配置、re-ranking、属性头正是本课三大决策,分别管检索质量、排序、筛选。
从零训分类器绕开了 CLIP 的跨模态检索能力,支付/画像也与本题无关。
全省掉重排和属性筛选会牺牲相关性和可筛选体验,不是合理架构。
optionExplanations_en: Vector DB/CDN/frontend are peripheral infra, not the visual-search model decisions.
Correct — encoder config, re-ranking, and attribute heads are the lesson's three decisions, governing retrieval quality, ordering, and filtering.
Training a classifier from scratch bypasses CLIP's cross-modal retrieval, and payments/profiles are off-topic.
Dropping re-ranking and attribute filtering sacrifices relevance and filterability — not a sound architecture.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用对比学习把图像和文本编码进同一潜空间的模型,支持零样本跨模态检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) encodes images and text into one shared latent space via contrastive learning, enabling zero-shot cross-modal retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把结果按属性(颜色/风格/品类)拆成可勾选的维度,让用户逐维过滤。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Faceted filtering breaks results into checkable attribute dimensions (color/style/category) so users filter per facet.

scenario: 为什么 CLIP 一训练完就能直接拿图搜文、拿文搜图,不用为每个类别单独训分类器。
scenario_en: Why CLIP can do image-to-text and text-to-image search right after training, without per-category classifiers.
q: CLIP 的对比学习目标训出了什么,带来什么能力？
q_en: What does CLIP's contrastive objective train, and what capability does it give?
why: CLIP 用对比目标把图像编码器和文本编码器联合训进同一个共享潜空间——匹配的图文对拉近、不匹配的推远。结果是图像和文本嵌入可直接比余弦,实现零样本跨模态检索(拿图搜相近文本描述,反之亦然),无需为新类别重训。
why_en: CLIP jointly trains image and text encoders into one shared latent space by pulling matched image-text pairs together, so image and text embeddings are directly comparable by cosine for zero-shot cross-modal retrieval.
options: 把图像和文本编码器联合训进同一共享潜空间,匹配对拉近,得到零样本跨模态检索能力
为每个商品类别单独训一个分类器,靠投票检索
只训图像编码器,文本靠人工打标签对齐
训一个生成模型,靠生成描述再做字符串匹配
options_en: Jointly trains image and text encoders into one shared latent space, pulling matched pairs together, giving zero-shot cross-modal retrieval.
Trains a separate classifier per product category and retrieves by voting.
Trains only the image encoder, aligning text via manual labels.
Trains a generative model that writes captions, then does string matching.
optionExplanations: 对;联合对比训练造出共享潜空间,图文嵌入可直接比余弦,零样本跨模态检索。
逐类别分类器不具跨模态检索能力,新类别还要重训,与 CLIP 思路相反。
只训图像编码器无法对齐文本空间,人工打标对齐不到潜空间层面。
生成描述+字符串匹配丢掉了语义嵌入,退回到脆弱的关键词匹配。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — joint contrastive training builds a shared space where image/text embeddings compare by cosine for zero-shot cross-modal retrieval.
Per-category classifiers lack cross-modal retrieval and need retraining for new categories — opposite to CLIP.
Training only the image encoder can't align the text space, and manual labels don't align at the latent-space level.
Caption generation plus string matching drops the semantic embedding and reverts to brittle keyword matching.

termDefinitions.term: shared latent space / 共享潜空间
termDefinitions.meaning: 图像和文本被编码到同一向量空间,匹配的图文距离近,可直接跨模态比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shared latent space encodes images and text into one vector space where matched pairs are close, allowing direct cross-modal comparison.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无需为新类别再训练,直接用已学的嵌入完成检索/分类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Zero-shot means retrieving or classifying new categories directly from learned embeddings without extra training.

scenario: 即使训得很好的 CLIP,拿一张查询图去找它最近的文本嵌入,返回的描述常常不是最相关的。
scenario_en: Even with well-trained CLIP, an image's nearest text embeddings are often not the most relevant descriptions.
q: 为什么图像的最近文本邻居未必最相关？这是什么现象？
q_en: Why are an image's nearest text neighbors not necessarily the most relevant, and what is this phenomenon?
why: 这是 modality gap:即便共享潜空间,视觉和文本嵌入仍聚成两个不同的子空间,跨模态余弦系统性地低于同模态余弦。于是拿图直接比文本的原始余弦会偏,不能盲信——这正是要在 re-ranking 里加一路专门的 cross-modal alignment 学习分数、而不是只用原始余弦的原因。
why_en: It's the modality gap: even in a shared space, visual and text embeddings cluster in distinct subspaces and cross-modality cosine is systematically lower than within-modality, so raw image-to-text cosine is biased.
options: 因为 CLIP 没训好,再多训几轮就没这个问题了
modality gap:视觉与文本嵌入聚成不同子空间,跨模态余弦系统性偏低,原始图-文余弦不可盲信
因为文本编码器坏了,换个文本模型即可
因为图像分辨率不够,提高分辨率就能对齐
options_en: Because CLIP wasn't trained enough; a few more epochs remove it.
The modality gap: visual and text embeddings cluster in distinct subspaces and cross-modality cosine is systematically lower, so raw image-to-text cosine can't be trusted blindly.
Because the text encoder is broken; swap the text model.
Because image resolution is too low; raising resolution aligns them.
optionExplanations: modality gap 是对比训练的结构性现象,不是训练不足,多训不消除。
对;跨模态余弦系统性低于同模态,所以要用学习的 alignment 分数矫正,不能只信原始余弦。
文本编码器没坏,gap 来自两个模态嵌入的子空间分离,换模型不解决。
分辨率与 modality gap 无关,这是嵌入空间几何而非像素问题。
optionExplanations_en: The modality gap is a structural phenomenon of contrastive training, not undertraining, and more epochs don't remove it.
Correct — cross-modality cosine is systematically lower than within-modality, so a learned alignment score corrects it rather than trusting raw cosine.
The text encoder isn't broken; the gap comes from subspace separation between modalities, and swapping models doesn't fix it.
Resolution is unrelated to the modality gap, which is embedding-space geometry, not pixels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 共享空间里视觉与文本嵌入各自聚成不同子空间,跨模态余弦低于同模态余弦。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The modality gap is that visual and text embeddings occupy distinct subspaces in the shared space, making cross-modality cosine lower than within-modality.

scenario: 要为一个特定领域商品目录(如时尚)选 CLIP 编码器配置,同时权衡检索质量、延迟、微调成本、对齐风险。
scenario_en: Choosing a CLIP encoder config for a domain catalog (fashion), weighing retrieval quality, latency, fine-tune cost, and alignment risk.
q: zero-shot / 联合微调双编码器 / 只微调图像 / 微调+区域特征,该怎么对比取舍？
q_en: How to compare zero-shot / fine-tune both / image-only / fine-tune+region configs?
why: zero-shot 当基线(中等质量、零微调成本、低风险);联合微调双编码器是生产目标(高质量,联合训练让两个空间一起动、抑制 drift);只微调图像风险最高(图像动、文本不动→alignment drift);微调+区域特征是精度上限但索引延迟+15-25ms。用延迟预算+目录专属度来定。
why_en: Zero-shot is the baseline, fine-tuning both encoders is the production target (joint training shifts both spaces together, limiting drift), image-only has the highest alignment-drift risk, and fine-tune+region is the accuracy ceiling at +15-25ms indexing.
tradeoff: 联合微调双编码器(高质量、抑制 drift) vs 只微调图像(省一半微调但 alignment drift 最高)
options: 四种配置检索质量一样,只是成本不同
zero-shot 基线;联合微调双编码器=生产目标(抑制 drift);只微调图像=风险最高;微调+区域=精度上限但索引更慢
只微调图像最优,因为省一半微调成本又不掉质量
永远选 zero-shot,微调纯属浪费
options_en: All four configs have equal retrieval quality, only cost differs.
Zero-shot baseline; fine-tune both = production target (limits drift); image-only = highest risk; fine-tune+region = accuracy ceiling but slower indexing.
Image-only is best: it halves fine-tune cost with no quality loss.
Always choose zero-shot; fine-tuning is pure waste.
optionExplanations: 四种配置质量差异明显(zero-shot 中、区域特征最高),不是仅成本不同。
对;这正是按质量/成本/对齐风险的四档取舍,联合微调是生产甜点,区域特征是精度天花板。
只微调图像会引入 alignment drift、跨模态检索退化,省成本却掉质量。
领域目录上联合微调显著提质,zero-shot 只是起点,不该永远停在基线。
optionExplanations_en: The four differ clearly in quality (zero-shot moderate, region highest), not just cost.
Correct — this is the four-way quality/cost/alignment-risk tradeoff: joint fine-tuning is the production sweet spot, region features the accuracy ceiling.
Image-only introduces alignment drift and degrades cross-modal retrieval — cheaper but lower quality.
Joint fine-tuning materially lifts quality on a domain catalog; zero-shot is only a start, not a permanent stop.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只微调一个编码器时,它的嵌入偏离另一个固定编码器的空间,破坏跨模态对齐。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alignment drift is when fine-tuning one encoder shifts its embeddings away from the other fixed encoder's space, breaking cross-modal alignment.

scenario: 有一个特定领域商品目录(时尚服饰),zero-shot CLIP 检索质量只是中等,想提上去又不想引入对齐风险。
scenario_en: You have a domain catalog (fashion apparel) where zero-shot CLIP retrieval is only moderate, and you want higher quality without adding alignment risk.
q: 该怎么微调 CLIP,既提检索质量又控制对齐风险？
q_en: How should you fine-tune CLIP to raise retrieval quality while controlling alignment risk?
why: 在目录图文对上做领域对比训练、同时微调图像和文本两个编码器。联合训练让两个空间一起漂移、保持对齐,把 alignment drift 压到中等;还要冻结温度参数防止相似度坍缩。只微调一侧才会引入高 drift。
why_en: Do domain contrastive training on catalog pairs while fine-tuning both encoders, so the two spaces shift together and stay aligned, keeping drift moderate.
tradeoff: 联合微调双编码器(高质量、两空间同步、抑制 drift) vs 只微调图像(省成本但 drift 高)
options: 只微调图像编码器,文本冻结,省一半算力
在目录图文对上做领域对比训练、联合微调两个编码器,两空间同步漂移保持对齐
只微调文本编码器,图像冻结
两个都冻结,只在上面加一个线性分类头
options_en: Fine-tune only the image encoder with text frozen, halving compute.
Do domain contrastive training on catalog pairs and fine-tune both encoders, so the two spaces shift together and stay aligned.
Fine-tune only the text encoder with the image frozen.
Freeze both and add a linear classification head on top.
whenOtherWins: 若下游只做图搜图(image-to-image)、根本不用跨模态文本对齐,那只微调图像编码器就够,不必付联合微调双编码器的成本。
whenOtherWins_en: If the downstream is image-to-image only and never uses cross-modal text alignment, fine-tuning just the image encoder suffices without the cost of tuning both.
optionExplanations: 只微调图像→图像空间漂走、文本不动→跨模态对齐被破坏,drift 最高。
对;联合微调让两空间一起动、保持对齐,是领域目录的生产级做法,还要冻温度防坍缩。
只微调文本同样单侧漂移,破坏对齐,和只微调图像一个毛病。
全冻结加线性头学不到领域检索所需的嵌入调整,提质有限。
optionExplanations_en: Image-only shifts the image space while text stays fixed, breaking cross-modal alignment — highest drift.
Correct — joint fine-tuning moves both spaces together and preserves alignment, the production approach for a domain catalog, plus freeze temperature to avoid collapse.
Text-only is also one-sided drift, breaking alignment — the same flaw as image-only.
Freezing both with a linear head can't learn the embedding shifts domain retrieval needs, so quality gains are limited.

termDefinitions.term: domain contrastive training / 领域对比训练
termDefinitions.meaning: 用本领域的图文匹配对继续做对比学习,让 CLIP 适配该目录的语义。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain contrastive training continues contrastive learning on in-domain image-text pairs to adapt CLIP to the catalog's semantics.

scenario: 联合微调双编码器时,如果放开 CLIP 对比损失里的温度参数一起学,训练容易出问题。
scenario_en: When fine-tuning both encoders, letting CLIP's contrastive temperature parameter train freely tends to cause trouble.
q: 领域微调时为什么要冻结温度参数？不冻会怎样？
q_en: Why freeze the temperature parameter during domain fine-tuning, and what if you don't?
why: 温度控制相似度分布的尖锐程度。领域微调时若让它自由学,容易把相似度分布压塌(similarity collapse)——所有对的余弦挤到一起、失去区分度,检索排序失效。冻结温度保住相似度尺度,让微调只调嵌入方向而非塌缩尺度。
why_en: Temperature controls how sharp the similarity distribution is, and letting it train freely during domain fine-tuning can collapse similarities together, destroying the ranking discriminability.
options: 温度无所谓,冻不冻结果一样
不冻温度可能让相似度分布坍缩、失去区分度,检索排序失效;冻结保住相似度尺度
冻温度是为了加快训练速度,和相似度无关
温度越大越好,应该放开让它一直增大
options_en: Temperature doesn't matter; frozen or not, the result is the same.
Not freezing can collapse the similarity distribution and lose discriminability, breaking retrieval ranking; freezing preserves the similarity scale.
Freezing temperature only speeds up training, unrelated to similarity.
Higher temperature is always better; let it grow freely.
optionExplanations: 温度直接决定相似度分布尖锐度,冻不冻对训练稳定性影响很大。
对;放开温度易 similarity collapse,冻结它让微调只调方向、保住排序区分度。
冻温度主要是防坍缩、稳住相似度尺度,不是为了提速。
温度不是越大越好,失控会抹平相似度差异,反而坏了检索。
optionExplanations_en: Temperature directly sets the sharpness of the similarity distribution, so freezing strongly affects training stability.
Correct — a free temperature risks similarity collapse; freezing it keeps fine-tuning to direction changes and preserves ranking discriminability.
Freezing temperature is mainly to prevent collapse and stabilize the similarity scale, not to speed training.
Bigger temperature isn't better; unbounded, it flattens similarity differences and harms retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对比损失里缩放相似度 logits 的标量,控制分布尖锐度;过度自由会导致相似度坍缩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Temperature is a scalar scaling similarity logits in the contrastive loss, controlling sharpness; left too free it collapses similarities.

termDefinitions.meaning: 所有样本的相似度被压到相近数值,失去区分度,检索无法排序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Similarity collapse is when all similarities squeeze to near-equal values, losing discriminability so retrieval can't rank.

scenario: 为省成本,团队只微调 CLIP 的图像编码器,文本编码器完全冻结。上线后发现图搜图很准,但拿图搜文本描述的跨模态检索明显退化。
scenario_en: To save cost the team fine-tunes only CLIP's image encoder, freezing the text encoder. In production image-to-image is accurate, but image-to-text cross-modal retrieval clearly degrades.
q: '图搜图准、跨模态退化'这个现象说明发生了什么？
q_en: What does 'image-to-image accurate but cross-modal degraded' indicate happened?
why: 这是 alignment drift:图像嵌入被微调推动、漂离了固定的文本嵌入空间。图搜图只用图像空间内部关系,所以还准;但跨模态余弦依赖两个空间对齐,图像一漂就不可靠了。修法是联合微调两个编码器,让空间一起动。
why_en: It's alignment drift: fine-tuning shifted the image embeddings away from the fixed text embedding space, so image-to-image (within one space) stays accurate while cross-modal cosine (needs alignment) degrades.
options: 文本编码器过拟合了,应该多训文本
图像分辨率下降导致,提高分辨率即可
alignment drift:图像嵌入漂离固定文本空间→图搜图(同空间)仍准、跨模态(需对齐)退化;修法是联合微调
ANN 索引损坏,重建索引即可恢复
options_en: The text encoder overfit; train text more.
Image resolution dropped; raising it fixes it.
Alignment drift: image embeddings shifted away from the fixed text space → image-to-image (same space) stays accurate, cross-modal (needs alignment) degrades; fix by fine-tuning jointly.
The ANN index is corrupted; rebuild it to recover.
optionExplanations: 文本编码器是被冻结的、根本没训,谈不上过拟合。
现象源于嵌入空间对齐被破坏,不是像素分辨率问题。
对;只微调图像→图像空间漂走→同模态检索不受影响、跨模态对齐坏掉,联合微调才治本。
ANN 索引没坏,图搜图还准就说明检索管线正常,问题在跨模态对齐。
optionExplanations_en: The text encoder was frozen and never trained, so overfitting doesn't apply.
The symptom comes from broken embedding-space alignment, not pixel resolution.
Correct — image-only fine-tuning drifts the image space, so within-modality retrieval is unaffected while cross-modal alignment breaks; joint fine-tuning is the fix.
The ANN index isn't corrupted — accurate image-to-image shows retrieval works; the issue is cross-modal alignment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只在图像嵌入空间内找相似图,不涉及文本,故不受跨模态对齐影响。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Image-to-image retrieval finds similar images within the image embedding space only, so it's unaffected by cross-modal alignment.

scenario: 时尚/家具类目录,用户很在意纹理、图案、形状这些细粒度视觉属性,全图嵌入常常抓不准。
scenario_en: For a fashion/furniture catalog, users care about fine-grained texture, pattern, and shape that a full-image embedding often blurs.
q: 什么时候值得上区域特征(region features)？代价是什么？
q_en: When are region features worth it, and what do they cost?
why: 当目录是属性敏感型(时尚、家具)、要抓纹理/图案/形状时值得。区域特征用 RoI pooling 只编码目标区域而非整图,抓到全图嵌入糊掉的细节,是精度上限档。代价是每张图 +15-25ms 的索引延迟(注意是建库时的,不是查询时的)。
why_en: Worth it for attribute-sensitive catalogs (fashion, furniture) needing texture/pattern/shape: region features use RoI pooling on the object region instead of the full image, at +15-25ms per-image indexing latency.
tradeoff: 区域特征(抓细粒度纹理/形状但 +15-25ms 索引) vs 全图嵌入(快但糊掉细节)
options: 任何目录都无脑上区域特征,越细越好
属性敏感目录(时尚/家具)要抓纹理/图案/形状时:RoI pooling 编码目标区域,代价是每图 +15-25ms 索引延迟
只在延迟预算极紧时上区域特征,因为它更快
区域特征只影响文本编码,和图像细节无关
options_en: Blindly use region features for any catalog; finer is always better.
For attribute-sensitive catalogs (fashion/furniture) needing texture/pattern/shape: RoI pooling encodes the object region, costing +15-25ms per-image indexing latency.
Only use region features under a tight latency budget because they're faster.
Region features only affect text encoding, unrelated to image detail.
whenOtherWins: 若目录是粗粒度品类(如'找一张沙发'不在乎具体纹理),全图嵌入已经够,区域特征只是白增索引延迟和算力。
whenOtherWins_en: If the catalog is coarse-grained (find 'a sofa' regardless of texture), full-image embeddings suffice and region features just add indexing latency and compute.
optionExplanations: 无脑上区域特征在粗粒度目录上白花索引算力,还不一定提质。
对;区域特征是属性敏感目录的精度上限,代价落在建库延迟而非查询延迟。
区域特征增加索引延迟,不是更快,选项把代价方向说反了。
区域特征作用在图像端抓细节,和文本编码无关,张冠李戴。
optionExplanations_en: Blind use wastes indexing compute on coarse catalogs without guaranteed gains.
Correct — region features are the accuracy ceiling for attribute-sensitive catalogs, with the cost on indexing latency, not query latency.
Region features add indexing latency, not speed — the option reverses the cost direction.
Region features act on the image side to capture detail, unrelated to text encoding — a mismatch.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只对目标框内区域做池化编码,得到聚焦局部细节(纹理/形状)的特征,而非整图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RoI (Region of Interest) pooling encodes only the object's bounding region to capture local detail (texture/shape) instead of the whole image.

scenario: 想领域适配 CLIP,但完整联合微调两个大编码器的算力/存储成本偏高,又担心微调破坏原有对齐。
scenario_en: You want to domain-adapt CLIP, but full joint fine-tuning of both large encoders is costly, and you fear it breaks the existing alignment.
q: 有没有介于'全量联合微调'和'完全冻结'之间的折中做法？
q_en: Is there a middle ground between full joint fine-tuning and full freezing?
why: 用 adapter 层:在冻结的编码器里插入少量可训练的小模块,只训这些 adapter。它是折中——微调成本远低于全量、又因为主干冻结而天然限制了 drift。质量介于 zero-shot 和全量联合微调之间。
why_en: Use adapter layers: insert small trainable modules into frozen encoders and train only those, which lowers fine-tune cost and, because the backbone is frozen, inherently limits drift.
tradeoff: adapter(低微调成本、限制 drift、质量中上) vs 全量联合微调(质量最高但成本高)
options: adapter 层:冻结主干、只训插入的小模块,微调成本低且天然限制 drift,质量介于 zero-shot 与全量微调之间
只能二选一:要么全量联合微调,要么完全 zero-shot,没有中间档
把学习率调到极大,快速全量微调一遍就好
只微调图像编码器当折中,反正省一半
options_en: Adapter layers: freeze the backbone and train only inserted small modules — low fine-tune cost and inherently limited drift, quality between zero-shot and full fine-tuning.
It's binary: either full joint fine-tuning or pure zero-shot, no middle ground.
Just set a huge learning rate and do one fast full fine-tune.
Fine-tune only the image encoder as the middle ground since it halves cost.
whenOtherWins: 若领域与预训练分布差得很远、需要大幅重塑嵌入,adapter 的容量可能不够,这时全量联合微调更合适。
whenOtherWins_en: If the domain is far from the pretraining distribution and embeddings must shift a lot, adapters may lack capacity and full joint fine-tuning fits better.
optionExplanations: 对;adapter 只训小模块、冻主干,兼顾低成本和低 drift,是标准折中。
adapter 正是二者之间的第三档,'只能二选一'忽略了它。
调大学习率的全量微调更易破坏对齐,不是稳妥折中。
只微调图像会引入 alignment drift,不是安全折中,和 adapter 目的相反。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — adapters train small modules with a frozen backbone, balancing low cost and low drift — the standard middle ground.
Adapters are exactly that third option between the two; 'binary' ignores them.
A huge-LR full fine-tune more easily breaks alignment — not a safe middle ground.
Image-only fine-tuning introduces alignment drift — not a safe middle ground and opposite to adapters' purpose.

termDefinitions.meaning: 插入冻结主干中的少量可训练小模块,只训它们即可低成本领域适配、限制漂移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adapter layers are small trainable modules inserted into a frozen backbone; training only them gives low-cost domain adaptation with limited drift.

scenario: 面试官想听你怎么把三种编码器配置摆成一条演进路线,而不是纠结哪个'最好'。
scenario_en: The interviewer wants you to lay the three configs on an evolution path rather than argue which is 'best'.
q: zero-shot / 联合微调 / 区域特征,分别对应产品的哪个阶段？
q_en: Zero-shot / joint fine-tuning / region features each map to which product stage?
why: 把它们摆成一条线:zero-shot 当原型/基线(零成本先跑通),联合微调当生产目标(领域上提质、抑制 drift),区域特征当精度上限(属性敏感目录才付它的索引成本)。最终由延迟预算+目录专属度来定停在哪一档,而不是笼统说哪个最好。
why_en: Present them as a path: zero-shot as prototype/baseline, joint fine-tuning as the production target, region features as the accuracy ceiling — letting latency budget and catalog specificity decide where to stop.
tradeoff: 沿 zero-shot→联合微调→区域特征逐档提质(成本递增) vs 一步到顶(索引/微调成本浪费)
options: 三种配置互斥,生产里只能选一个永远用
zero-shot=原型基线;联合微调=生产目标(提质抑 drift);区域特征=精度上限(属性敏感目录才用);由延迟预算+目录专属度定档
永远直接上区域特征,一步到位最省事
三种没区别,随便选一个即可
options_en: The three are mutually exclusive; production picks one forever.

Zero-shot = prototype baseline; joint fine-tuning = production target (quality + limits drift); region features = accuracy ceiling (attribute-sensitive catalogs); latency budget + catalog specificity decide the stop.
Always jump straight to region features to be done in one step.
The three are indistinguishable; pick any.
whenOtherWins: 若是快速验证一个新品类、还没打算投微调,就该停在 zero-shot 这一档先跑通体验,不必立刻上联合微调或区域特征。
whenOtherWins_en: For quickly validating a new category with no plan to invest in fine-tuning, stop at zero-shot to prove the experience before joint fine-tuning or region features.
optionExplanations: 三档是一条演进路线而非互斥,可随需求沿线推进。
对;基线→生产→上限的演进,由延迟预算和目录专属度决定停在哪,是成熟的表述。
一步上区域特征在不需要细粒度的目录上白花索引成本,不该无脑到顶。
三档质量/成本差异明显,不是没区别可随便选。
optionExplanations_en: The three are an evolution path, not mutually exclusive, advanced along as needs grow.
Correct — baseline → production → ceiling, with latency budget and catalog specificity deciding where to stop, is the mature framing.
Jumping to region features wastes indexing cost on catalogs that don't need fine detail — no blind maxing.
The three differ clearly in quality/cost, so they aren't interchangeable picks.

scenario: 目录有海量商品,不可能对每个候选都跑昂贵的融合打分。
scenario_en: The catalog has huge item counts, so running the expensive fusion score on every candidate is impossible.
q: 视觉搜索的检索为什么要分两阶段,各做什么？
q_en: Why is visual-search retrieval two-stage, and what does each stage do?
why: 两阶段:先用快速 ANN 检索,在整个目录里粗召回 top-k(约 100-500)候选;再用一个更有表达力的 re-ranker 对这几百个候选精细重排。ANN 便宜但粗,重排贵但准——只对短名单跑贵的打分,兼顾规模与相关性。
why_en: Two stages: fast ANN retrieval coarsely recalls the top-k (100-500) from the whole catalog, then a more expressive re-ranker finely reorders those few hundred, so the costly scoring runs only on a shortlist.
options: 只跑一次 ANN 就直接返回,不需要重排
先快速 ANN 粗召回 top-k(约 100-500),再用更强的 re-ranker 对短名单精排,兼顾规模与相关性
先对全目录跑 re-ranker,再用 ANN 采样
两阶段都用同一个模型跑两遍,只是重复
options_en: Run ANN once and return directly, no re-ranking needed.
Fast ANN coarsely recalls the top-k (100-500), then a stronger re-ranker finely reorders the shortlist, balancing scale and relevance.
Run the re-ranker over the whole catalog first, then sample with ANN.
Run the same model twice in both stages — just repetition.
optionExplanations: 只用 ANN 会漏掉重排能纠正的相关性,原始余弦受 modality gap 影响不够准。
对;ANN 收窄到短名单、re-ranker 精排,只对几百个跑贵打分,是两阶段标准解。
顺序颠倒:re-ranker 只能跑短名单,不可能先对全目录跑再采样。
两阶段用不同模型各司其职,不是同一模型重复跑。
optionExplanations_en: ANN-only misses the relevance re-ranking corrects, since raw cosine is biased by the modality gap.
Correct — ANN narrows to a shortlist and the re-ranker finely reorders, running the costly score on only a few hundred — the standard two-stage solution.
Order reversed: the re-ranker can only run on a shortlist, not the whole catalog before sampling.
The two stages use different models with distinct roles, not one model run twice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索:牺牲少量精确度,在海量向量里毫秒级召回相近候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) search trades a little exactness for millisecond recall of nearby candidates among massive vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对召回的短名单用更有表达力的打分函数重新排序,提升 top 结果相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A re-ranker reorders the recalled shortlist with a more expressive scoring function to improve top-result relevance.

scenario: re-ranker 要把多路信号融合成一个更好的排序分,先要说清它融合哪几路。
scenario_en: The re-ranker fuses several signals into a better ranking score; first be clear which ones.
q: 跨模态 re-ranker 融合哪三类分数？(多选)
q_en: Which three score types does the cross-modal re-ranker fuse? (multiple)
why: 三路:(1)visual similarity——查询图与候选图嵌入的余弦;(2)text relevance——候选元数据(标题/描述/标签)与查询上下文的匹配,用 BM25 或轻量 cross-encoder;(3)cross-modal alignment——查询图 CLIP 嵌入与候选文本 CLIP 嵌入的余弦。三路拼接后交给学习的融合模型。
why_en: Three: visual similarity (cosine of query-image and candidate-image embeddings), text relevance (candidate metadata vs query context via BM25 or a light cross-encoder), and cross-modal alignment (cosine of query-image CLIP embedding and candidate-text CLIP embedding).
options: visual similarity:查询图与候选图嵌入的余弦
text relevance:候选元数据与查询上下文的匹配(BM25 或轻量 cross-encoder)
cross-modal alignment:查询图 CLIP 嵌入与候选文本 CLIP 嵌入的余弦
server latency:候选所在服务器的响应延迟,越低排越前
options_en: Visual similarity: cosine of query-image and candidate-image embeddings.
Text relevance: candidate metadata vs query context (BM25 or a light cross-encoder).
Cross-modal alignment: cosine of the query-image CLIP embedding and the candidate-text CLIP embedding.
Server latency: the candidate's server response time, ranked higher when lower.
optionExplanations: 对;图-图余弦是最直接的视觉相似度,来自召回阶段的嵌入。
对;候选标题/描述与查询上下文的文本匹配,补充纯视觉之外的语义。
对;图查询直接对候选文本描述做语义匹配,是提升最大的一路(需矫正 modality gap)。
错;服务器延迟是运维指标,与内容相关性无关,不该进排序分。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — image-to-image cosine is the most direct visual similarity, from the recall-stage embeddings.
Correct — matching candidate title/description to query context adds semantics beyond pure vision.
Correct — matching the image query to candidate text descriptions is the highest-lift signal (correcting the modality gap).
Wrong — server latency is an ops metric unrelated to content relevance and shouldn't enter the ranking score.

termDefinitions.meaning: 经典词频-逆文档频率检索打分函数,衡量查询词与文档的文本匹配强度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BM25 is a classic term-frequency/inverse-document-frequency retrieval score measuring text match between query and document.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把查询和候选拼在一起送进一个模型联合编码打分,比双塔更准但更慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross-encoder jointly encodes the query and candidate together to score them, more accurate but slower than a dual-encoder.

scenario: 候选商品有文本描述(标题/标签)。你想让'描述与查询图的语义匹配'也参与排序,而不是只看图像像不像。
scenario_en: Candidates have text descriptions (titles/tags). You want 'how well the description semantically matches the query image' to affect ranking, not just how visually similar.
q: 该加哪一路分数来捕捉'候选描述与查询图的语义匹配'？
q_en: Which score captures 'candidate description semantically matching the query image'?
why: 加 cross-modal alignment 分数:算查询图的 CLIP 嵌入与候选文本的 CLIP 嵌入的余弦。它跨模态地把'这张图'和'这段描述'对上,是提升最大的一路。因为有 modality gap,不能盲信原始余弦,所以它作为一路特征喂给学习的融合模型去矫正。
why_en: Add the cross-modal alignment score: cosine between the query-image CLIP embedding and the candidate-text CLIP embedding, matching 'this image' to 'this description' across modalities — the highest-lift signal.
tradeoff: cross-modal alignment(捕捉图-文语义、提升最大但需文本前向) vs 只用图-图余弦(纯视觉、漏语义)
