q: 矩阵分解把用户-物品交互矩阵近似成什么？
q_en: What does matrix factorization approximate a user-item matrix as?
options: 用户矩阵 U 与物品矩阵 V 的低秩乘积
每个用户单独训练一棵决策树
所有点击行为的倒排索引
只保留热门物品的固定队列
why: 决定性是低秩约束：U·Vᵀ 近似稀疏交互矩阵 R，逼模型共享用户/物品的行为模式。
why_en: Matrix factorization approximates the sparse interaction matrix as a low-rank product of a user matrix and an item matrix.
options_en: A low-rank product of a user matrix U and an item matrix V.
A separate decision tree trained for every user.
An inverted index over every click event.
A fixed queue containing only popular items.
optionMeanings: 把稀疏矩阵压缩成两个低秩矩阵的乘积。
决策树按用户建模，不产出共享向量。
倒排索引按查询词组织，不是矩阵分解。
热门队列没有低秩向量结构。
optionScenarioImpacts: 低秩约束逼出用户和物品的共享行为模式。
每用户一棵树，规模上不可行也不共享结构。
倒排索引服务的是关键词检索，不是推荐向量。
固定队列无法个性化，也没有向量可用。
optionDirectness: 讲矩阵分解公式时，应落到 U 和 V 的低秩乘积。
按规则树预测单个用户时才像决策树问题。
关键词检索用倒排索引，推荐矩阵分解不是这条路。
热门队列可做兜底流量，不能学习个性化向量。
optionMeanings_en: It compresses a sparse matrix into the product of two low-rank matrices.
A decision tree is modeled per user and produces no shared vector.
An inverted index is organized by query term, not by factorization.
A popularity queue has no low-rank vector structure.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The low-rank constraint forces shared behavior patterns.
One tree per user does not scale and shares no structure.
Inverted indexes serve keyword search, not recommendation vectors.
A fixed queue cannot personalize and yields no vectors.
optionDirectness_en: When explaining factorization, name the low-rank product of U and V.
Decision trees fit per-feature prediction, not shared vector factorization.
Inverted indexes fit keyword retrieval, not recommendation factorization.
A popular-item queue can be a fallback, but it learns no personalized vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大而稀疏的交互矩阵近似成两个低秩矩阵的乘积。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Matrix factorization approximates a large sparse interaction matrix as the product of two low-rank matrices.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用远小于原始规模的维度数来近似矩阵，逼共享结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Low-rank means approximating a matrix with far fewer dimensions than its original size, forcing shared structure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按特征分裂做预测的树状模型，不产出向量表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A decision tree is a branching model that predicts by splitting on features, not by producing vector embeddings.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从词映射到包含该词的文档列表的检索结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inverted index maps each term to the list of documents containing it, used for keyword search.

q: 补全矩阵分解的典型形状。
q_en: Fill in the typical shape of matrix factorization.
text: 若 R 是 users × items，矩阵分解学习 U: users × {{k}} 和 V: items × {{k}}，使 U·Vᵀ 近似 {{R}}。
why: k 通常远小于用户数和物品数，逼模型压缩出共享的行为模式。
why_en: The rank k is far smaller than the number of users or items, forcing the model to compress shared behavior patterns.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分解出的向量维度，通常远小于用户数或物品数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: k is the embedding rank, the vector dimension used in the factorization, usually far smaller than the number of users or items.

scenario: 你需要给推荐系统一个便宜、能解释的召回 baseline，只有用户-物品交互日志。
scenario_en: You need a cheap, explainable retrieval baseline for a recommender, and the only signal is user-item interaction logs.
q: 召回 baseline 最合适的起点是？
q_en: What is the best starting baseline for retrieval?
options: 从零训练大型多模态 Transformer
只按视频标题做关键词匹配
矩阵分解学向量，再接近邻搜索召回
给每个用户手写推荐规则
why: 决定性是只有交互日志且要便宜可解释，矩阵分解能直接从矩阵学向量。它不是终态方案，只是可比较的地板线。
why_en: Matrix factorization is a cheap, mature retrieval baseline when the only signal is a sparse interaction matrix.
whenOtherWins: 如果有丰富文本/图像/序列信号且质量要求更高，两塔或序列模型会更有上限。
tradeoff: 便宜可解释的基线 vs 更高质量但更贵的表示
options_en: Train a large multimodal transformer from scratch.
Match candidates only by title keywords.
Learn vectors via matrix factorization, then retrieve with nearest-neighbor search.
Hand-write recommendation rules per user.
optionMeanings: 从零训练大模型，成本和数据需求都很高。
关键词匹配理解不了语义相似。
矩阵分解便宜成熟，直接从交互矩阵学向量。
手写规则不随数据规模增长而扩展。
optionScenarioImpacts: 在只有交互日志、要快速起步时代价过高。
标题相似不代表用户会喜欢。
能马上给出可比较的召回地板线。
维护成本随用户数线性甚至更快增长。
optionDirectness: 多模态模型适合质量上限目标，不适合便宜 baseline。
标题关键词可做冷启动补充，但浪费了已有交互日志。
只有交互矩阵时，矩阵分解能最快产出召回向量。
手写规则适合小规模策略兜底，不适合学习长期模式。
optionMeanings_en: Training from scratch demands heavy data and compute.
Keyword matching cannot capture semantic similarity.
Matrix factorization is cheap and mature, learning vectors directly from the interaction matrix.
Hand-written rules don't scale as the user base grows.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It costs too much for a fast, cheap starting point.
Similar titles don't mean the user will like the video.
It gives a comparable retrieval floor right away.
Maintenance cost grows at least linearly with users.
optionDirectness_en: A multimodal model fits a quality ceiling, not a cheap baseline.
Title keywords can help cold start, but they waste the available interaction logs.
With only interactions, matrix factorization quickly produces retrieval vectors.
Handwritten rules can be a small fallback, but they do not learn long-term patterns.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大而稀疏的交互矩阵近似成两个低秩矩阵的乘积。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Matrix factorization approximates a large sparse interaction matrix as the product of two low-rank matrices.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于注意力机制的神经网络架构，常用于文本/多模态编码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transformer is a neural network architecture built on attention, commonly used to encode text or multimodal input.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在向量空间里快速找出与查询最接近的候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Approximate nearest-neighbor search quickly finds the candidates closest to a query vector.

q: 两塔模型为什么适合大规模召回？
q_en: Why do two-tower models scale for large retrieval?
options: 它每次请求精排全量候选
候选向量离线算好，在线只编码查询再搜索
它训练时不需要负样本
它只适合小规模数据场景
why: 决定性是候选向量可离线预计算入索引，在线只跑查询塔加近邻搜索，才能毫秒级查亿级候选。
why_en: A two-tower model scales retrieval because candidate embeddings are precomputed offline and only the query tower runs online.
tradeoff: 候选离线预计算 vs 在线全量精排
diagram:
flowchart LR
  User[User or query] --> QT[Query tower]
  Item[Items] --> IT[Item tower]
  IT --> ANN[ANN index]
  QT --> Search[Nearest search]
  ANN --> Search
  Search --> TopK[Top K]
options_en: It reranks the full candidate pool on every request.
Candidate vectors are precomputed offline, so online serving only encodes the query and searches.
It needs no negative samples during training.
It only fits small-scale datasets.
optionMeanings: 把召回和精排全量计算混为一谈。
查询塔和候选塔分离，候选侧可预先算好。
对比学习恰恰依赖负样本区分正负对。
两塔在超大规模数据上才最有优势。
optionScenarioImpacts: 全量精排在亿级候选下延迟不可接受。
在线只需一次编码加一次近邻查询，毫秒级响应。
没有负样本，模型学不到区分边界。
小数据集用不到两塔的规模优势。
optionDirectness: 全量精排适合小候选集，亿级召回在线算不动。
候选侧稳定且巨大时，离线预计算是规模化前提。
负样本质量影响训练边界，不能从流程里拿掉。
小数据也能用两塔，但它的核心收益在大规模候选。
optionMeanings_en: This confuses retrieval with full reranking.
Query and item towers are separate, so the candidate side is precomputed.
Contrastive training relies on negatives to separate positive and negative pairs.
Two-tower's advantage shows up mainly at very large scale.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Full reranking is unacceptably slow over billions of candidates.
Online cost is one query encode plus one nearest-neighbor lookup.
Without negatives, the model learns no decision boundary.
Small datasets don't need two-tower's scale advantage.
optionDirectness_en: Full reranking can work on small candidate sets, not billion-scale online retrieval.
When candidates are huge and stable, offline precompute is the scaling move.
Negative quality shapes the learned boundary, so it cannot be removed.
Two-tower can run on small data, but its main value is massive candidate scale.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用两个独立编码器分别编码查询和候选，输出到同一向量空间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A two-tower model uses two separate encoders, one for the query and one for the candidate, that output into the same vector space.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时用来代表“不相关”的候选，帮助模型学习区分边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Negative samples are candidates labeled as not relevant during training, used to teach the model a decision boundary.

q: 补全两塔模型的关键约束。
q_en: Fill in the key constraint of a two-tower model.
text: 用户塔和物品塔可以结构不同，但输出必须进入{{同一个向量空间}}，这样 dot product 才能表示{{匹配分数}}。
why: 两塔维度或语义空间若不一致，点积就没有训练意义。
why_en: If the two towers don't share one output space, the dot product between them has no trained meaning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个向量对应元素相乘再求和，常用来打相似度分数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dot product multiplies two vectors element-wise and sums the results, commonly used as a similarity score.

scenario: 搜索系统需要语义召回：在线 query 千变万化，文档库很大但更新相对慢。
scenario_en: A search system needs semantic retrieval: live queries vary constantly, while the document corpus is large and changes slowly.
q: 应优先用哪种 embedding serving 方式？
q_en: Which embedding serving pattern should you choose first?
options: 每次请求重新编码全部文档
只用 SQL LIKE 做全表扫描
把所有可能查询提前枚举好
文档离线编码入索引，查询在线编码
why: 决定性是文档库大且更新慢、查询侧多变，离线编码文档、在线只编码查询是语义召回的标准结构。
why_en: For semantic retrieval, stable documents should be embedded offline while only the query is embedded online.
whenOtherWins: 如果语料只有几百条、延迟不敏感，直接交叉编码全量候选可能更简单且质量更高。
tradeoff: 文档离线预计算 vs 查询在线实时编码
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Docs[Documents] --> Offline[Offline embed]
  Offline --> Index[ANN index]
  Query[Live query] --> Online[Online embed]
  Online --> Index
  Index --> Results[Retrieved docs]
options_en: Re-encode every document on each request.
Use a SQL LIKE full-table scan only.
Pre-enumerate every possible query in advance.
Embed documents offline into an index, and embed the query online.
optionMeanings: 对大文档库来说计算量完全不可行。
关键词全表扫描没有语义理解。
查询千变万化，无法穷举。
文档侧稳定可预计算，查询侧必须实时。
optionScenarioImpacts: 延迟随文档库线性增长，无法上线。
同义词、语义相关查询会被漏掉。
新查询永远不在枚举表里。
把大部分计算前移到离线，在线只算查询。
optionDirectness: 语料很小时可现算；大文档库每次重算会拖垮延迟。
精确关键词搜索可用 LIKE，但语义召回会漏同义表达。
固定 query 列表很小时可缓存；开放搜索无法穷举。
文档慢变、查询快变时，应离线文档、在线查询。
optionMeanings_en: This is computationally infeasible for a large document store.
Keyword full-table scans have no semantic understanding.
Queries vary endlessly and cannot be enumerated.
Documents are stable and precomputed; queries must be encoded live.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Latency grows with the document store and won't ship.
Synonym and semantically related queries get missed.
New queries are never in the enumerated table.
It moves most compute offline, leaving only the query online.
optionDirectness_en: On-the-fly encoding is fine for tiny corpora; large corpora break latency.
LIKE fits exact keyword search, but misses semantic matches.
Caching all queries works only for a closed query set; open search cannot enumerate them.
When documents change slowly and queries vary, embed documents offline and queries online.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用向量相似度而不是关键词匹配来找相关文档。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Semantic retrieval finds relevant documents using vector similarity instead of keyword matching.

scenario: 两塔模型训练时，一个 batch 里有很多候选可以当负样本。
scenario_en: During two-tower training, each batch contains many candidates that can be used as negatives.
q: InfoNCE 相比 triplet loss 的核心优势是？
q_en: What is InfoNCE's main advantage over triplet loss?
options: 把 batch 内其他候选都当负样本，监督更密集
训练时完全不需要正样本
只能用于训练图 embedding
能保证挑出的负样本都是真负样本
why: 决定性是监督密度：InfoNCE 用一个正样本对多个 batch 负样本做分类，比 triplet 更密集。
why_en: InfoNCE gives denser supervision than triplet loss by treating every other candidate in the batch as a negative.
tradeoff: batch 内密集监督 vs 单一 margin 约束
options_en: It treats every other candidate in the batch as a negative, giving denser supervision.
It needs no positive pairs at all.
It only works for training graph embeddings.
It guarantees every sampled negative is truly negative.
optionMeanings: InfoNCE 把一个正样本对一堆负样本做分类式学习。
对比学习恰恰需要正样本对来定义“相似”。
两种损失都是通用的对比学习目标，不限图数据。
batch 内负样本仍可能是假负例。
optionScenarioImpacts: 同一批数据能拿到远多于 triplet 的对比信号。
没有正样本，模型无法学到该靠近谁。
InfoNCE 广泛用于文本、图像和推荐向量。
假负例会给训练带来噪声，需要额外处理。
optionDirectness: batch 内候选可信时，InfoNCE 能一次利用多个负样本。
无监督预训练也需要正关系或增强视图来定义靠近谁。
图 embedding 可用对比损失，但 InfoNCE 不限于图。
负样本质量仍要审，batch 负例可能是假负例。
optionMeanings_en: InfoNCE trains as classification: one positive against many negatives.
Contrastive learning needs positive pairs to define 'similar' at all.
Both losses are general contrastive objectives, not graph-only.
In-batch negatives can still be false negatives.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The same batch yields far more contrastive signal than triplet.
Without positives, the model has nothing to pull together.
InfoNCE is widely used for text, image, and recommendation vectors.
False negatives add training noise that needs extra handling.
optionDirectness_en: When in-batch candidates are usable, InfoNCE gets many negatives per step.
Even self-supervised setups need positive relations or views to define closeness.
Graph embeddings can use contrastive losses, but InfoNCE is not graph-only.
Negative quality still matters because in-batch negatives can be false negatives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一个正样本和多个负样本当分类问题训练的对比损失。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: InfoNCE is a contrastive loss that trains the model to pick the positive out of a batch of positive and negative candidates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让锚点向正样本靠近、离负样本至少差一个 margin 的对比损失。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Triplet loss pushes an anchor closer to its positive than to a negative by at least a fixed margin.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次训练迭代里一起处理的一组样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A batch is the group of training examples processed together in one training step.

rows: 稀疏，一条 margin 约束
batch 内其余候选全当负例

scenario: 两塔模型训练检索用的 embedding，需要负样本教模型分辨相关与不相关候选。
scenario_en: You are training retrieval embeddings for a two-tower model, and negatives teach the model to separate relevant from irrelevant candidates.
q: 训练检索 embedding 时，hard negative 指什么？
q_en: In retrieval embedding training, what is a hard negative?
options: 随机从全库采到的冷门候选
已经被用户点击过的正样本
模型觉得相关但实际标签为负的候选
完全没有任何特征的空样本
why: Hard negative 最能暴露模型边界错误，因为它看起来像好候选但标签为负。只用随机负样本提升有限。
why_en: A hard negative is a candidate the current model thinks is relevant but is actually labeled negative.
options_en: A random, rarely-seen candidate sampled from the whole pool.
A candidate already labeled positive by a user click.
A candidate the current model ranks as relevant but is actually negative.
A blank candidate with no features at all.
optionMeanings: 随机负样本通常太容易，模型学不到细节。
点击过的样本本身是正样本，不是负样本。
hard negative 卡在模型判断边界上。
空样本没有信号，训练价值很低。
optionScenarioImpacts: 只用随机负样本，质量提升会很快停滞。
把正样本当负样本会直接污染标签。
最能暴露模型的边界错误，逼模型学细粒度区分。
空样本对梯度几乎没有贡献。
optionDirectness: 随机负样本适合早期打底，但很快变得太容易。
点击正样本用于拉近距离，不能当 hard negative。
模型已混淆的负例最适合训练细粒度边界。
空样本可测鲁棒性，但不是有效的检索负例。
optionMeanings_en: Random negatives are usually too easy for the model to learn from.
A clicked sample is a positive, not a negative.
A hard negative sits right on the model's decision boundary.
A blank sample carries no signal, so it teaches little.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Relying only on random negatives quickly plateaus quality.
Mislabeling a positive as negative directly corrupts the labels.
It best exposes the model's boundary mistakes, teaching finer distinctions.
A blank sample contributes almost nothing to the gradient.
optionDirectness_en: Random negatives are useful early, but soon become too easy.
Clicked positives should be pulled closer, not treated as hard negatives.
Confusing negatives are best for training the fine decision boundary.
Blank samples may test robustness, but they are not useful retrieval negatives.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型当前认为相关、但真实标签是负的候选，最能暴露模型边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hard negative is a candidate the current model ranks as relevant that is actually labeled negative.

termDefinitions.meaning: 专门为召回排序训练、让相关查询-候选更靠近的向量表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A retrieval embedding is a vector representation trained so that relevant query-candidate pairs end up close together.

scenario: 两塔模型用随机负样本训练后，离线 recall 停滞，线上常召回相似但不合适的内容。
scenario_en: A two-tower model trained with random negatives has stalled offline recall, and online it often retrieves similar but unsuitable content.
q: 下一步最有效的训练改进是什么？
q_en: What training improvement is most useful next?
options: 把 embedding 维度直接降到 8
周期性挖掘 hard negatives 混入训练
删除训练集里所有的正样本
只优化训练集上的准确率指标
why: 随机负样本太弱，模型学不到细粒度区分；定期用模型快照挖 hard negatives 能逼近真实召回错误。
why_en: Periodic hard-negative mining trains the model against the confusing candidates it currently retrieves.
whenOtherWins: 如果模型还没学到基本正负关系，先扩大正样本覆盖和修正标签质量更重要。
tradeoff: 定期挖掘 hard negative 的工程成本 vs 随机负样本的信号强度
options_en: Shrink the embedding dimension straight down to 8.
Periodically mine hard negatives and mix them into training.
Delete every positive sample from the training set.
Optimize only for training-set accuracy.
optionMeanings: 降维和负样本质量是两个不相关的问题。
用模型快照定期挖出边界候选混进训练。
没有正样本对比对，模型学不到相似。
训练集指标和线上 recall 停滞是两码事。
optionScenarioImpacts: 维度不是这里 recall 停滞的原因。
逼近真实召回错误，提升细粒度区分能力。
模型会完全失去“该靠近谁”的信号。
线上表现依然不会改善。
optionDirectness: 降维用于降成本，不会修复随机负样本太弱。
模型已有基础能力后，挖 hard negative 能继续逼近线上错误。
没有正样本时，对比训练不知道该拉近哪一对。
训练集准确率可作监控，但不能替代召回质量改进。
optionMeanings_en: Dimension size is unrelated to negative-sample quality.
Use a frozen model snapshot to periodically mine boundary candidates.
Without positive pairs, the model learns nothing about similarity.
Training-set metrics and online recall stalling are separate issues.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Dimension is not the cause of the recall stall here.
It approximates real retrieval mistakes and sharpens fine-grained distinctions.
The model loses all signal about what it should be near.
Online performance still would not improve.
optionDirectness_en: Dimension reduction cuts cost; it does not fix weak negative samples.
After the model has basics, hard-negative mining targets real online mistakes.
Without positives, contrastive training has no pair to pull together.
Training accuracy can be monitored, but it is not a retrieval-quality fix.

options_en: A large 1024+ dimension, ignoring cost.
Keep the dimension equal to the number of users.
A small-to-medium 64-256 dimension, weighing throughput and cost first.
Randomly change the vector dimension on every request.

高 QPS 粗召回先用小/中维度压低延迟和内存。
固定维度是 ANN 索引比较向量的基本前提。

Dimension has no necessary relationship to the number of users.
Small-to-medium dimensions keep search cost down under high QPS.
Dimension must stay fixed, or the index cannot compare vectors.

Dimension would balloon uncontrollably as users grow.

User count affects the number of vector rows, not the dimension itself.
For high-QPS coarse retrieval, smaller dimensions reduce latency and memory.
Fixed dimension is required for an ANN index to compare vectors.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS, queries per second, measures how many requests a system handles each second.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding dimension is the length of the vector, trading off representational power against training and search cost.

scenario: 召回既要快速粗筛候选，又想在精排阶段保留高质量向量。

q: Matryoshka embedding 的用途是什么？

A prefix of the same vector is also a valid, usable embedding.
Make ANN retrieval work without building any index.
Automatically eliminate cold start for every new entity.

Training makes prefixes like the first 64 or 128 dimensions usable as vectors on their own.

Cold start needs content or exploration signals, not prefix training alone.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时让向量的前缀（如前 64/128 维）也单独有效的技巧。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Matryoshka embedding is trained so that its prefixes, like the first 64 or 128 dimensions, are also valid embeddings on their own.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻搜索，在向量索引里快速找出最接近的候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN, approximate nearest neighbor search, quickly finds the closest candidates inside a vector index.

scenario: 你训练完 embedding，面试官问怎么评估质量。
scenario_en: You have trained embeddings, and the interviewer asks how you would evaluate their quality.
q: intrinsic 和 extrinsic 评估的主要区别是？
q_en: What is the main difference between intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation?
options: 前者只能线上跑，后者只能离线跑
前者用于 SQL 查询，后者用于 Redis 缓存
前者不需要任何数据就能评估
前者看向量空间本身，后者看下游任务效果
why: Intrinsic 看向量空间本身（邻居、相似词）；extrinsic 看下游任务效果（recall@k、线上转化）。面试主指标应锚定 extrinsic。
why_en: Intrinsic evaluation inspects the embedding space itself, while extrinsic evaluation measures performance on the downstream task.
tradeoff: 向量空间自身结构 vs 下游任务真实效果
options_en: Intrinsic can only run online, extrinsic only offline.
Intrinsic is for SQL queries, extrinsic is for Redis caching.
Intrinsic needs no data at all to evaluate.
Intrinsic inspects the vector space itself; extrinsic measures downstream task performance.
optionMeanings: 两者的线上/离线归属和实际情况相反。
SQL/Redis 是存储技术，不是评估方法。
两类评估都需要数据，只是数据类型不同。
intrinsic 看几何结构，extrinsic 看任务指标。
optionScenarioImpacts: 会让人误判该在什么阶段用哪种评估。
混淆存储技术和评估方法两个概念。
会误以为可以不用数据就下结论。
extrinsic 结果应该是汇报给业务方的主线数字。
optionDirectness: 线上/离线是执行环境，不是 intrinsic/extrinsic 的定义。
SQL 和 Redis 是存储组件，不是 embedding 评估维度。
两类评估都要样本或任务数据，不能凭空判断。
选主指标时，应区分看空间本身还是看下游效果。

SQL and Redis are storage technologies, not evaluation methods.
Both evaluation types need data, just different kinds.

It confuses storage technology with an evaluation method.
It wrongly implies conclusions can be drawn without data.
Interviews should anchor the headline metric on extrinsic, with intrinsic as a sanity check.
optionDirectness_en: Online versus offline is an execution setting, not this definition.
SQL and Redis are storage components, not embedding evaluation types.
Both evaluation types need samples or task data.
For the main metric, separate space inspection from downstream performance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 直接检查向量空间本身的性质，比如近邻是否合理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Intrinsic evaluation directly inspects properties of the embedding space itself, such as whether nearest neighbors look sensible.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用下游任务的真实效果衡量 embedding 好坏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Extrinsic evaluation measures embedding quality by performance on the actual downstream task.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量排序结果质量的指标，位置越靠前权重越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG is a ranking-quality metric that weights correctly ranked results more heavily near the top of the list.

scenario: 你训练了商品 embedding 用于召回，面试官问怎么评估。
scenario_en: You trained product embeddings for retrieval, and the interviewer asks how to evaluate them.

只问同事的主观感觉并打分

A 2D projection is a visualization trick, not a metric.
Training loss only reflects fitting progress, not retrieval quality.
Subjective opinion cannot be quantified or reproduced.

A nice-looking projection doesn't mean good retrieval.
Low loss does not imply high recall.
It cannot track whether iterations are truly improving.

A 2D projection is a sanity check, not proof of retrieval quality.
Loss shows optimization progress, not business retrieval performance.
Subjective ratings can collect feedback, but they cannot compare iterations reliably.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时完全没用过、专门留来测试的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Held-out data is data kept aside and never used during training, reserved for testing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索返回的前 K 个结果中，命中真正相关项的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall@K measures the fraction of truly relevant items found within the top K retrieved results.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量排序结果质量的指标，位置越靠前权重越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG is a ranking-quality metric that weights correctly ranked results more heavily near the top of the list.

scenario: 推荐系统的候选库很大，检索延迟预算很紧。
scenario_en: A recommender has a huge candidate pool and a tight retrieval latency budget.
q: 候选侧 embedding 生产环境通常怎么 serving？

Store them only in the browser's localStorage.

日志适合审计或训练数据，不服务在线查询。

localStorage is for one browser, not a shared server-side retrieval index.

termDefinitions.meaning: 离线一次性算好大量向量，再加载供在线查询使用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Batch precomputing means computing a large set of vectors offline once, then loading them for online queries.

模型从此不再需要冷启动策略

没有行为信号，推荐就无法个性化。

options: 等它自然积累大量观看后再处理
随机给它一个热门视频的向量
用标题、缩略图、作者等内容生成 embedding
把它永远排在推荐列表末尾
why: 新视频没有行为信号，只能先靠标题、缩略图、作者等内容特征估计受众，再用探索流量逐步混入行为信号。
why_en: A cold-start video should begin with a content and metadata embedding, then blend in behavioral signals as they arrive.
whenOtherWins: 如果平台明确只推荐成熟库存，等待行为数据更安全，但会牺牲新创作者成长。
tradeoff: 立即可得的内容特征 vs 更慢积累的行为信号
diagram:
flowchart LR
  New[New entity] --> NoHist[No behavior history]
  New --> Content[Content metadata]
  Content --> Initial[Initial embedding]
  Interactions[New interactions] --> Blend[Blend behavior]
  Initial --> Blend
options_en: Wait until it naturally accumulates lots of views.
Randomly assign it a popular video's embedding.
Generate an embedding from title, thumbnail, and author metadata.
Permanently rank it at the bottom of every list.
optionMeanings: 等待意味着新视频永远得不到曝光。
借用热门向量会让新视频被错误地当成爆款。
内容/属性特征在上传时就能立即拿到。
永久垫底等于放弃这条内容的冷启动机会。
optionScenarioImpacts: 新创作者的内容永远没有被发现的机会。
推荐会系统性地把冷门内容当热门推。
能给出合理曝光，之后再混入行为信号更新。
牺牲了新内容成长和平台多样性。
optionDirectness: 等行为数据适合成熟库存策略，但会放弃新内容曝光。
借热门向量只适合临时兜底，不能代表这条视频。
零观看时，标题、缩略图、作者是立即可用信号。
永久垫底是业务策略放弃，不是冷启动表示方案。
optionMeanings_en: Waiting means the new video never gets exposure.
Borrowing a popular vector wrongly treats the new video as a hit.
Content and metadata features are available immediately at upload time.
Permanently ranking last means giving up on this content's cold start.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: New creators' content never gets a chance to be discovered.
Recommendations systematically push cold content as if it were popular.
It gives reasonable exposure now, then updates as behavior signal arrives.
It sacrifices new-content growth and platform diversity.
optionDirectness_en: Waiting for behavior fits mature-only inventory, but sacrifices new exposure.
Borrowing a popular vector is only a crude fallback and misrepresents the video.
With zero views, title, thumbnail, and author are the immediately available signals.
Permanent bottom ranking is giving up, not building a cold-start representation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从标题、缩略图、文本等属性生成的向量，无需互动数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A content embedding is generated from attributes like title, thumbnail, or text, and needs no interaction data.

scenario: 系统要在毫秒级从大规模候选库里检索最相关结果。
scenario_en: The system needs to retrieve the most relevant results from a large candidate pool within milliseconds.
q: 按正确顺序排列 embedding 检索 serving 流程。
q_en: Put the embedding retrieval serving flow in the right order.
why: 候选侧预计算是规模化关键；在线路径只做请求编码、近邻检索和下游处理，把重计算放到离线。
why_en: Retrieval scales by precomputing candidate vectors offline, embedding the request online, searching the ANN index, then handing results downstream.
whenOtherWins: 如果候选库很小、延迟不敏感，在线全量编码和精排会更简单。
tradeoff: 候选离线预计算 vs 请求在线实时编码
steps: 在线计算 query/user embedding
离线编码候选并构建 ANN 索引
用 ANN 找 top-k 近邻
把候选交给 ranker 或生成器下游处理
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Encode candidates] --> B[Build ANN]
  B --> C[Embed request]
  C --> D[Search top K]
  D --> E[Rank or generate]

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持快速近邻搜索的向量索引结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ANN index is a vector index structure built to support fast nearest-neighbor search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在线把用户请求或查询实时编码成的向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A query embedding is the vector produced by encoding the user's request or query online, in real time.

scenario: 你在训练两塔召回模型，需要让 loss 把 query 和 candidate 向量对齐到同一空间。
scenario_en: You are training a two-tower retrieval model and need the loss to align query and candidate vectors in one space.
q: 按正确顺序排列两塔 contrastive 训练流程。
q_en: Put the two-tower contrastive training flow in the right order.
why: 训练先定义正负关系，再编码两侧、算相似度，最后用 loss 调整空间，负样本质量决定边界学得多细。
why_en: Two-tower contrastive training collects pairs, encodes both sides, scores similarity, and updates the towers to separate positives from negatives.
whenOtherWins: 如果候选数量很小且质量优先，交叉编码器可直接联合看 query 和 candidate。
tradeoff: 双塔预计算效率 vs 交叉编码质量
steps: 计算 batch 内所有 query-candidate 相似度
收集正样本对并采样负样本
更新两个塔让正样本更近、负样本更远
分别编码 query/user 和 candidate/item
diagram:
flowchart LR
  P[Positive pairs] --> E[Encode both sides]
  N[Negatives] --> E
  E --> S[Similarity matrix]
  S --> L[Contrastive loss]
  L --> U[Update towers]

termDefinitions.meaning: 用两个独立编码器分别编码查询和候选，输出到同一向量空间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A two-tower model uses two separate encoders, one for the query and one for the candidate, that output into the same vector space.

termDefinitions.meaning: 拉近正样本、推远负样本的训练目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A contrastive loss trains the model to pull positive pairs closer together and push negative pairs farther apart.

scenario: 你要在面试白板上说明两塔召回分数如何从向量得到。
scenario_en: You need to explain on a whiteboard how a two-tower retrieval score is computed from vectors.
q: 这段代码最准确表达了哪种线上打分？
q_en: What online scoring pattern does this code represent?
codeSample:
score = dot(query_embedding, item_embedding)
top_k = ann_index.search(query_embedding, k=100)
options: 用候选发布时间作为唯一排序分数
用查询向量与候选向量的点积/近邻距离打分
用数据库自增 ID 排序
把训练 loss 直接当线上分数用
why: 两塔训练让同空间向量的点积代表匹配度；代码用点积算分、ANN 做近邻搜索，这是召回分，不是最终精排。
why_en: Two-tower retrieval scores candidates by vector similarity, typically dot product plus ANN search for the top-k lookup.
whenOtherWins: 如果需要精细理解 query 和候选的逐 token 交互，交叉编码 ranker 会赢但成本更高。
tradeoff: 向量相似度召回分 vs 精细逐 token 交互打分
options_en: Rank candidates only by their publish timestamp.
Score candidates by the dot product or nearest-neighbor distance between query and candidate vectors.
Sort candidates by database auto-increment ID.
Use the training loss value directly as the online score.
optionMeanings: 发布时间和向量匹配度没有直接关系。
两塔训练目标就是让点积代表匹配度。
自增 ID 只是存储顺序，无语义。
训练 loss 是优化过程的中间量，不是打分函数。
optionScenarioImpacts: 会把召回退化成纯时间排序，丢失相关性。
代码里的 dot + ANN search 正对应这个逻辑。
召回结果和用户意图完全脱节。
loss 数值不能直接拿来给候选排序。
optionDirectness: 时间排序适合新鲜度召回，但这段代码没有时间特征。
两塔召回线上常用点积或近邻距离给候选打分。
ID 排序适合稳定分页，不表达 query-item 匹配。
loss 只用于训练更新，线上排序要用相似度分数。
optionMeanings_en: Publish time has no direct relationship to vector match quality.
The two-tower training objective is exactly to make dot product represent match quality.
Auto-increment ID is just storage order with no semantics.
Training loss is an intermediate optimization value, not a scoring function.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It degrades retrieval into pure time ordering, losing relevance.
The dot plus ANN search in the code matches this exactly.
Retrieved results become disconnected from user intent.
A loss value cannot be used directly to rank candidates.
optionDirectness_en: Time sorting fits freshness ranking, but this code has no time feature.
Two-tower retrieval commonly scores candidates by dot product or neighbor distance.
ID ordering fits stable pagination, not query-item matching.
Loss drives training updates; online ranking uses similarity scores.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个向量对应元素相乘再求和，常用来打相似度分数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dot product multiplies two vectors element-wise and sums the results, commonly used as a similarity score.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持快速近邻搜索的向量索引结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ANN index is a vector index structure built to support fast nearest-neighbor search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索返回的前 k 个最相关候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: top_k refers to the k most relevant candidates returned by a search.

q: 在 embedding 面试回答中，哪些点能显示生产经验？（多选）
q_en: Which points show production experience in an embedding interview? (multi-select)
options: 说明训练目标和使用的 loss
说明负样本采样策略
只说“语义很强”，不解释服务方式
说明维度选择背后的成本权衡
why: 高级回答会覆盖训练目标、负采样和维度权衡，而不是停在“向量能理解语义”这种空泛断言。
why_en: A production-grade embedding answer names the training objective, negative-sampling strategy, and dimension tradeoff.
options_en: Name the training objective and the loss used.
Explain the negative-sampling strategy.
Just say 'the semantics are strong' without explaining serving.
Explain the cost tradeoff behind the dimension choice.
optionMeanings: 目标决定了向量空间里“相似”具体指什么。
负样本策略决定模型能学到多细的区分边界。
这是空洞断言，没有可验证的工程细节。
维度选择反映了对成本和质量的权衡意识。
optionScenarioImpacts: 体现候选真正理解训练是如何塑造向量空间的。
体现候选知道随机负样本的局限和改进路径。
面试官听不出候选是否真的做过生产系统。
体现候选考虑过服务成本，不只是模型质量。
optionDirectness: 讲训练目标能说明你知道相似度从哪里来。
讲负采样能说明你知道边界质量怎么改。
只说语义强无法落到训练、评估或 serving。
讲维度成本能说明你考虑过线上资源。
optionMeanings_en: The objective decides what 'similar' actually means in the vector space.
The negative-sampling strategy decides how fine a boundary the model can learn.
This is an empty claim with no verifiable engineering detail.
The dimension choice shows awareness of the cost-quality tradeoff.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It shows the candidate understands how training shapes the vector space.
It shows the candidate knows the limits of random negatives and how to fix them.
The interviewer cannot tell if the candidate has really built a production system.
It shows the candidate considered serving cost, not just model quality.
optionDirectness_en: Naming the objective shows you know where similarity comes from.
Naming negative sampling shows you know how boundary quality improves.
A vague semantics claim does not reach training, evaluation, or serving.
Dimension cost shows you have considered online resources.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为对比训练挑选“不相关”候选的策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Negative sampling is the strategy for choosing 'not relevant' candidates used in contrastive training.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时用来衡量预测好坏、指导参数更新的目标函数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Loss is the objective function that measures prediction quality and drives parameter updates during training.

scenario: 内容审核团队想直接复用推荐团队训练好的 embedding。
scenario_en: A content moderation team wants to directly reuse embeddings trained by the recommendation team.
q: 推荐 embedding 直接挪给内容审核用，最大风险是？
q_en: What is the biggest risk of reusing recommendation embeddings for moderation?
options: embedding 完全不能作为特征输入
审核模型会自动变成无监督模型
所有向量维度都自带人工标签
训练目标可能和审核风险不一致
why: 推荐 embedding 表示的是原训练目标学到的结构，可能编码“会互动”而非“是否违规”，需验证下游收益和偏差。
why_en: Shared embeddings carry the structure of their original training objective, which may not align with a new downstream task.
options_en: Embeddings can never be used as an input feature.
The moderation model automatically becomes unsupervised.
Every dimension comes with a human-readable label.
The original training objective may not align with moderation risk.
optionMeanings: 跨团队复用 embedding 做特征是常见做法。
换用途不会改变模型本身的监督方式。
embedding 维度通常没有人工可读标签。
推荐目标学的是“会互动”，不等于“是否违规”。
optionScenarioImpacts: 这个说法直接否定了 embedding 迁移的价值。
监督方式取决于任务设计，不会自动改变。
维度含义通常隐式，需要额外分析才能解释。
直接套用可能漏检或误伤，需要验证下游收益。
optionDirectness: embedding 可迁移做特征，但必须验证任务是否对齐。
监督方式由审核模型训练决定，不由 embedding 来源决定。
维度通常不可解释，不能当人工标签直接用。
跨任务复用时，先检查原训练目标和新风险是否一致。
optionMeanings_en: Reusing embeddings across teams as features is common practice.
Changing the use case does not change the model's own supervision.
Embedding dimensions usually carry no human-readable label.
The recommendation objective learns 'will engage,' not 'is this a violation.'
optionScenarioImpacts_en: This claim directly denies the value of transferring embeddings.
Supervision style depends on task design, not on reuse.
Dimension meaning is usually implicit and needs extra analysis to interpret.
Direct reuse risks misses or false flags, so downstream gains must be validated.
optionDirectness_en: Embeddings can transfer as features, but task alignment must be checked.
The moderation model training setup decides supervision, not embedding origin.
Dimensions are usually implicit, so they cannot serve as human labels.
For cross-task reuse, compare the old training objective with the new risk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 判断内容是否违规、需要处理的系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Content moderation is the system that judges whether content violates policy and needs action.

scenario: 平台需要找出内容库里高度相似的重复内容。
scenario_en: The platform needs to find highly similar duplicate content in a large content library.
q: 有了好 embedding 后，近重复检测通常怎么做？
q_en: With good embeddings, how do you usually detect near duplicates?
options: 按向量距离阈值找邻近样本
只比较原始字符串长度
随机抽样，全靠人工肉眼看
按主键做哈希取模分组
why: embedding 把语义或行为相似的实体放得近，近重复可以用距离阈值系统性发现；阈值要按误报/漏报权衡调。
why_en: Near-duplicate detection typically uses a distance threshold inside a good embedding space.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Item[Item embedding] --> ANN[Nearest neighbors]
  ANN --> Dist[Distance threshold]
  Dist --> Dup[Near duplicate set]
  Dup --> Review[Tune FP FN]
options_en: Find neighboring samples using a vector-distance threshold.
Compare only the raw string length.
Randomly sample and eyeball every pair manually.
Group items by hashing and modding the primary key.
optionMeanings: 距离近的向量代表语义或行为上相近的实体。
字符串长度和内容相似度基本无关。
人工肉眼查看在大规模数据下不可扩展。
哈希取模只是分桶，不反映内容相似度。
optionScenarioImpacts: 用 ANN 或阈值就能系统性地找出近重复。
长度相同的内容可能完全不相关。
覆盖率低，容易漏掉大部分重复对。
同一哈希桶里的内容不一定相似。
optionDirectness: 有可靠向量空间时，距离阈值能规模化筛近重复。
字符串长度只适合粗过滤，不代表语义重复。
人工抽查适合校准阈值，不能覆盖大库。
哈希取模适合分片，不表达内容相似。
optionMeanings_en: Vectors close in distance represent entities similar in meaning or behavior.
String length has almost nothing to do with content similarity.
Manual eyeballing does not scale to large datasets.
Hash-and-mod grouping only buckets items and ignores content similarity.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: ANN plus a threshold systematically surfaces near-duplicates.
Content of the same length can be completely unrelated.
Coverage is low, missing most true duplicate pairs.
Items in the same hash bucket are not necessarily similar.
optionDirectness_en: In a reliable vector space, a distance threshold scales near-duplicate search.
String length can be a crude filter, but not a semantic duplicate test.
Manual review can calibrate thresholds, but cannot cover a large library.
Hash modding is for sharding, not content similarity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 内容高度相似但不完全相同的一对样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A near-duplicate is a pair of samples that are highly similar but not exactly identical.

termDefinitions.meaning: 判断两个向量是否“足够近”的截断值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distance threshold is the cutoff value used to decide whether two vectors are 'close enough' to count as similar.

scenario: 你已经有商品 embedding，面试官问它该进 ranker 还是只做召回。
scenario_en: You already have product embeddings, and the interviewer asks whether they belong in the ranker or only in retrieval.
q: 最合理的回答是什么？
q_en: What is the most reasonable answer?
options: embedding 只能用来做召回
embedding 只能当分类标签用
召回用相似度，ranker 也能把它当特征
embedding 只能用来做离线可视化
why: embedding 既能做 ANN 检索 key，也能作为 ranker 的紧凑语义特征，是否同时用取决于延迟和收益。
why_en: The same embedding can power retrieval by similarity and also serve as a compact feature for the ranker.
whenOtherWins: 如果 ranker 已有更强的原始多模态特征，直接喂 embedding 的边际收益可能较小。
tradeoff: 召回相似度用法 vs ranker 特征用法
options_en: Embeddings can only be used for retrieval.
Embeddings can only serve as a classification label.
Retrieval uses similarity, and the ranker can also use it as a feature.
Embeddings can only be used for offline visualization.
optionMeanings: 召回之外，embedding 还能给 ranker 当输入特征。
标签是离散类别，embedding 是连续向量，不是一回事。
同一份向量能同时支撑召回和精排两个阶段。
可视化只是分析手段，不是它的唯一用途。
optionScenarioImpacts: 这个说法会让你漏掉精排阶段的一个便宜信号。
把向量和标签混淆会误导模型设计。
两阶段可以共用同一份 embedding，节省成本。
低估了 embedding 在生产模型里的实际用途。
optionDirectness: 只做召回会漏掉 ranker 可用的紧凑语义特征。
分类标签是监督目标，embedding 是连续输入特征。
同一向量可先召回，再作为 ranker 的一个特征。
可视化适合调试，不是生产里的唯一用途。
optionMeanings_en: Beyond retrieval, an embedding can also be an input feature for the ranker.
A label is discrete while an embedding is continuous; they are not the same thing.
The same vector can support both the retrieval and ranking stages.
Visualization is just one analysis tool, not its only use.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: This claim makes you miss a cheap signal available at ranking time.
Confusing a vector with a label misleads model design.
Both stages can share the same embedding, saving cost.
It underestimates how embeddings are actually used in production models.
optionDirectness_en: Retrieval-only use misses a compact semantic feature for the ranker.
A label is a supervision target; an embedding is a continuous input feature.
The same vector can retrieve candidates and then feed the ranker.
Visualization helps debugging, but it is not the only production use.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对召回候选做精细排序、给出最终展示顺序的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A ranker is the model that finely sorts retrieved candidates to produce the final display order.

scenario: 面试官让你从头讲一个 ML 系统该怎么评估，你要给出一个可复用的框架顺序。
scenario_en: An interviewer asks you to explain how to evaluate an ML system from scratch, and you need a reusable discussion order.
q: ML 系统设计里组织 evaluation 讨论的推荐顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the recommended order for structuring an ML system evaluation discussion?
why: 先锚定业务目标，再逐层落到产品指标、ML 指标和评估方法，最后处理不平衡、标注成本等挑战。
why_en: A strong evaluation answer works top-down: business goal, product metric, ML metric, methodology, then known pitfalls.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Biz[Business goal] --> Product[Product metric]
  Product --> ML[ML metric]
  ML --> Method[Offline or online]
  Method --> Risks[Bias and drift]
options: 先调超参 → 再找业务目标 → 最后上线
只报 accuracy → 结束
业务目标 → 产品指标 → ML 指标 → 评估方法 → 挑战
先画数据库表 → 再谈模型
options_en: Tune hyperparameters first, then look for a business goal, then ship.
Just report accuracy and stop there.
Business goal, then product metric, ML metric, evaluation method, and challenges.
Start by drawing database tables, then discuss the model.
optionExplanations: 反了：先调参数会让指标脱离业务价值，价值判断应该在最前面。
单一 accuracy 没有区分产品指标和 ML 指标，也漏掉了方法论和挑战。
对；这个顺序保证每一层指标都能回溯到业务价值，不是拍脑袋定的。
评估框架是自上而下的目标分解，不是从数据库表结构开始的。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards — tuning first detaches metrics from business value, which should anchor the discussion.
A single accuracy number skips product metrics, ML metrics, and the challenges discussion.
Correct — each layer of metric traces back to business value instead of being picked arbitrarily.
The framework decomposes a goal top-down; it does not start from a database schema.

termDefinitions.meaning: 直接衡量模型输出质量的技术指标，如 precision、NDCG。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ML metric is a technical measure of model output quality, such as precision or NDCG.

termDefinitions.meaning: 好看但不反映真实业务价值的指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A vanity metric looks impressive on a dashboard but does not track real business value.

scenario: 面试官问“怎么评估这个 ML 系统”，题目还很模糊。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks how you would evaluate this ML system, but the prompt is still vague.
q: 你最应该先问或先确定什么？
q_en: What should you ask or pin down first?
why: 没有业务目标，ML 指标容易变成 vanity metric。先确定动作和价值，再选择产品指标与技术指标。
why_en: Evaluation should begin with the business outcome because technical metrics only matter if they track that outcome.
tradeoff: 业务目标优先 vs 技术指标优先
options: 系统要优化的业务结果是什么
模型有几层神经网络
数据库主键类型
前端展示颜色
options_en: What business outcome is this system meant to move?
How many neural network layers does the model have?
What is the primary key type in the database?
What color scheme does the front end use?
whenOtherWins: 如果业务目标已被明确约束，下一步才是选择产品/ML 指标和实验设计。
optionExplanations: 对；没先钉住业务结果，后面所有指标都可能是空转。
模型层数是架构细节，回答不了“评估什么”这个问题。
主键类型属于存储设计，和评估要解决的问题无关。
UI 配色不是技术判断，和 ML 系统评估无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — without a pinned business outcome, every downstream metric risks being arbitrary.
Layer count is an architecture detail; it does not answer what to evaluate.
Primary key type is a storage decision, unrelated to evaluation.
UI color scheme is not a technical judgment relevant to ML evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 好看但不反映真实业务价值的指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A vanity metric looks impressive but does not track real business value.

scenario: 内容审核模型判断一条帖子是否违规，你要向面试官解释 precision 和 recall 分别衡量什么。
scenario_en: A content moderation model decides whether a post violates policy, and you need to explain what precision and recall measure.
q: 分类系统里 precision 和 recall 的区别是？
q_en: In a classifier, what is the difference between precision and recall?
why: Precision 关心误杀少不少，recall 关心漏抓少不少。阈值移动会在两者之间做权衡。
why_en: Precision measures correctness among positive predictions, while recall measures how many true positives were found.
tradeoff: precision（误判成本）vs recall（漏判成本）
options: precision 只反映延迟高低
precision 看预测为正的准确率，recall 看正例的覆盖率
precision 用来做回归，recall 用来做排序
两者衡量完全相同的东西
options_en: Precision only reflects latency.
Precision measures accuracy among positive predictions, recall measures coverage of real positives.
Precision is used for regression, recall for ranking.
The two measure exactly the same thing.
optionExplanations: 错；precision 和延迟无关，它算的是预测为正里对了多少。
对；precision = 判为正里真对的比例，recall = 真实正例里被抓到的比例。
错；precision/recall 都是分类指标，不是回归或排序专用词。
错；分母不同——一个基于预测为正，一个基于真实为正，会给出不同数字。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — precision has nothing to do with latency; it measures correctness among positive predictions.
Correct — precision is accuracy among predicted positives; recall is coverage of actual positives.
Incorrect — both are classification metrics, not one for regression and one for ranking.
Incorrect — they use different denominators (predicted-positive vs actual-positive), so they diverge.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测为正的样本里，真正为正的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision is the share of positive predictions that are actually correct.

termDefinitions.meaning: 所有真实正例里，被模型正确找出的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall is the share of actual positives that the model correctly identifies.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把模型打分转成是/否判断所用的分界值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A threshold is the score cutoff used to turn a model's score into a yes/no decision.

scenario: 有害内容自动删除必须避免误删，产品要求删除内容 95% 以上确实违规。
scenario_en: An automated harmful-content remover must avoid false removals, and product requires over 95 percent of removed items to truly violate policy.
q: 离线主阈值指标应更靠近哪个？
q_en: Which offline operating-point metric should be the primary threshold metric?
why: 自动动作的 guardrail 是高 precision，所以在 precision=95% 的操作点看 recall 更贴近决策。Accuracy 在低 prevalence 下会误导。
why_en: When automated action requires 95% precision, recall at that precision is the meaningful operating metric.
tradeoff: precision 门槛（误删风险）vs recall（覆盖率）
options: 总体 accuracy
训练 loss 最低值
ROC 曲线截图
Recall@Precision95
options_en: Overall accuracy.
The lowest training loss value.
A screenshot of the ROC curve.
Recall at 95 percent precision.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是早期模型比较且没有固定动作阈值，PR-AUC 更稳定。
optionExplanations: 错；类别很不平衡时 accuracy 会被大量负例主导，掩盖误删风险。
错；训练 loss 不是业务对齐的评估指标，也不反映线上误删率。
错；ROC 曲线本身不是一个可跟踪的单一数字，也不对齐 95% precision 门槛。
对；先卡住 95% precision 的误删门槛，再看这时能抓到多少，最贴近业务约束。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — with heavy imbalance, accuracy is dominated by negatives and hides the false-removal risk.
Incorrect — training loss is not aligned to the business guardrail or live removal errors.
Incorrect — a ROC curve is not a single trackable number, and it ignores the 95% precision requirement.
Correct — fix the 95% precision guardrail first, then track how much you catch at that point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在 precision 固定为 95% 的阈值下，模型能达到的 recall。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall at precision 95 is the recall achieved at the threshold where precision equals 95 percent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测正确的样本占全部样本的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Accuracy is the share of all predictions that are correct.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在不同阈值下画出真阳性率对假阳性率的曲线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ROC curve plots the true positive rate against the false positive rate across thresholds.

scenario: 内容审核数据里正例只占 1%，你要向面试官解释为什么团队用 PR-AUC 而不是 ROC-AUC 报告模型质量。
scenario_en: In content moderation data, positives are only 1 percent, and you need to explain why the team reports PR-AUC instead of ROC-AUC.
q: 强类别不平衡时，为什么 PR-AUC 往往比 ROC-AUC 更有用？
q_en: Why is PR-AUC often more useful than ROC-AUC under heavy class imbalance?
why: 正例 <1% 时，模型对正例很差也能有好看的 ROC-AUC；PR 曲线直接暴露 precision/recall 权衡。
why_en: PR-AUC is more informative under heavy class imbalance because it focuses on positive-class retrieval quality.
tradeoff: PR-AUC（正类质量）vs ROC-AUC（整体区分能力）
options: PR-AUC 不需要人工标签数据
PR-AUC 高就能直接自动上线
PR-AUC 更关注正类，不被负例稀释
ROC-AUC 只适用于回归任务
options_en: PR-AUC does not need any human labels.
A high PR-AUC means you can auto-launch the model.
PR-AUC focuses on positive-class quality and is not diluted by negatives.
ROC-AUC only applies to regression tasks.
optionExplanations: 错；PR-AUC 和 ROC-AUC 一样都要靠标注好的正负例来算。
错；再高的 PR-AUC 也只是代理指标，上线还要看业务和安全信号。
对；PR-AUC 只看正类，不会被海量真负例稀释，对稀有正例更敏感。
错；ROC-AUC 是分类指标，衡量正负样本的区分能力，不用于回归。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — PR-AUC needs labeled positives and negatives just like ROC-AUC does.
Incorrect — a high PR-AUC is still a proxy metric; launch decisions need business and safety signals too.
Correct — PR-AUC focuses on the positive class and is not diluted by the huge number of true negatives.
Incorrect — ROC-AUC is a classification metric measuring class separability, not a regression metric.

termDefinitions.meaning: precision-recall 曲线下的面积，综合衡量不同阈值下的表现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PR-AUC is the area under the precision-recall curve across all thresholds.

termDefinitions.meaning: ROC 曲线下的面积，衡量模型整体区分正负样本的能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ROC-AUC is the area under the ROC curve, measuring how well a model separates positive from negative classes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 正负样本数量差距很大，比如正例只占 1%。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Class imbalance means one class is far rarer than the other, such as positives being only 1 percent of the data.

q: 补全 F1 的含义。
q_en: Fill in what F1 means.
why: F1 方便但会隐藏业务上 precision 与 recall 的不对称成本。
why_en: F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, but it can hide asymmetric business costs.
text: F1 是 precision 和 recall 的{{调和平均}}，适合需要单数概括两者权衡时使用。

termDefinitions.meaning: precision 和 recall 的调和平均数，用一个数概括两者的权衡。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, summarizing their tradeoff in one number.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种平均方式，对较小值更敏感，常用于比例型指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A harmonic mean is an average that is more sensitive to small values, often used for rate-like metrics.

scenario: 新审核模型尚未被信任，但你想知道它在线会标哪些内容。
scenario_en: A new moderation model is not trusted yet, but you want to see what it would flag on live traffic.
q: 最安全的上线评估方式是？
q_en: What is the safest online evaluation method?
why: Shadow mode 只记录预测、不影响用户，能观察分数分布和候选样本，建立信心后再进 A/B。
why_en: Shadow mode lets a classifier make predictions without taking user-visible actions while labels and safety are checked.
tradeoff: 观察风险（shadow mode）vs 反应速度（直接上线）
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Traffic[Live traffic] --> Old[Old model acts]
  Traffic --> New[New model shadows]
  New --> Logs[Predictions only]
  Logs --> Labels[Sample labels]
  Labels --> Decision[Go or hold]
options: Shadow mode：预测但不动作，再抽样校验
直接全量替换旧模型并执行删除
只看训练集上的 accuracy
让用户自己猜模型的判断结果
options_en: Shadow mode: predict without acting, then sample and review.
Fully replace the old model and start removing content immediately.
Only look at training-set accuracy.
Let users guess what the model would decide.
whenOtherWins: 如果动作风险很低、可快速回滚，小流量 A/B 可能更快。
optionExplanations: 对；先看预测不动手，能在零用户风险下积累信心和标注样本。
错；新模型没被验证就全量替换，误删风险和信任成本都很高。
错；训练集 accuracy 不代表线上分布，也看不到误删/漏放情况。
错；这不是评估方法，只是把判断丢给用户，没有任何系统性验证。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — observing predictions without acting builds confidence and labeled samples with zero user risk.
Incorrect — replacing fully before validation risks over-removal and destroys trust if it is wrong.
Incorrect — training accuracy does not reflect live distribution or catch removal/miss errors.
Incorrect — this is not an evaluation method at all; it offloads judgment to users with no rigor.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型只做预测记录，不对外采取真实动作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Shadow mode lets a model make predictions without taking any user-facing action.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把流量随机分组，各自看不同版本来比较效果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An A/B test randomly splits traffic into groups that each see a different version to compare outcomes.

scenario: 内容审核正例只占很小比例，团队打算随机抽样发给标注员打标签。
scenario_en: Positive moderation cases are rare, and the team plans to send random samples to human labelers.
q: 在少数类很稀有的分类评估里，随机标注的主要问题是什么？
q_en: In rare-positive classification evaluation, what is the main problem with random labeling?
why: 随机样本无偏，但低 prevalence 时同样预算几乎都花在负例上，正例估计方差很高。可用分层采样或主动学习降方差。
why_en: Random labeling is unbiased but inefficient for rare positives because most labels are negatives.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Sample[Random 100 labels] --> Neg[~99 negative]
  Sample --> Pos[~1 positive]
  Pos --> HighVar[High-variance estimate]
options: 会自动过拟合
大多数样本是负例，正例估计方差很高
无法计算 precision
不需要人工成本
options_en: The model automatically overfits.
Most samples are negative, so the positive-class estimate has high variance.
Precision can no longer be calculated.
It requires no human labeling cost.
optionExplanations: 错；随机标注是采样问题，不会自动导致过拟合。
对；同样标注预算几乎都花在负例上，正例太少导致估计波动很大。
错；precision 依然能算，只是基于很少正例，数值不稳定。
错；随机标注仍然需要人工审核，只是把预算花在了低信息量样本上。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — random labeling is a sampling issue, not a cause of overfitting by itself.
Correct — most of the labeling budget lands on negatives, so the positive estimate is high-variance.
Incorrect — precision can still be computed, it is just unstable from too few positive labels.
Incorrect — random labeling still needs human review; it just spends budget on low-information samples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 总体里正例真实占比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prevalence is the true share of positive cases in the overall population.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按类别或群体比例分层抽样，保证每类都有代表性样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stratified sampling draws examples proportionally from each subgroup so every group is represented.

termDefinitions.meaning: 优先标注对模型最有信息量的样本，而不是随机标注。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Active learning prioritizes labeling the most informative examples instead of random ones.

scenario: 内容审核的正例 prevalence 低于 1%，标注预算只够随机抽 100 条来估计当前线上比例。
scenario_en: Content moderation prevalence is under 1 percent, and the label budget only allows 100 random samples to estimate the live rate.
q: 正例 prevalence 小于 1% 时，随机抽 100 条最可能发生什么？
q_en: When positive prevalence is under 1 percent, what will most likely happen in 100 random samples?
why: 100 条样本里正例期望不到 1 个，随机抽样在低 prevalence 下方差极大。评估稀有事件要靠更大样本或分层/主动学习采样。
why_en: With prevalence under one percent, a random sample of a hundred likely holds zero or one positive, so the estimate is far too noisy to trust.
options: 一定有 50 个正例
无需人工审核
precision 会等于 recall
大约只有 0-1 个正例，估计会非常不稳定
options_en: There will definitely be 50 positive examples.
No human review would be needed.
Precision would equal recall.
There would be roughly zero or one positive, so the estimate is very unstable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 总体里正例真实占比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Prevalence is the true share of positive cases in the overall population.

optionMeanings: 选项主张：一定有 50 个正例。
选项主张：无需人工审核。
选项主张：precision 会等于 recall。
选项主张：大约只有 0-1 个正例，估计会非常不稳定。
optionDirectness: 只有这个绝对假设成立时才适合。
只有这个绝对假设成立时才适合。
只有题设改成这个方向时才适合。
适合本题给出的约束。
optionScenarioImpacts: 会让系统依赖「一定有 50 个正例」这个前提。
会让系统依赖「无需人工审核」这个前提。
会让系统依赖「precision 会等于 recall」这个前提。
会让方案围绕「大约只有 0-1 个正例，估计会非常不稳定」展开。
optionMeanings_en: There will definitely be 50 positive examples.
No human review would be needed.
Precision would equal recall.
There would be roughly zero or one positive, so the estimate is very unstable.
optionDirectness_en: Only fits when this statement is true: there will definitely be 50 positive examples.
Only fits when this statement is true: no human review would be needed.
Only fits when this statement is true: precision would equal recall.
Use when prevalence under one percent is present.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It commits the design to this assumption: There will definitely be 50 positive examples.
It commits the design to this assumption: No human review would be needed.
It commits the design to this assumption: Precision would equal recall.
It commits the design to this path: There would be roughly zero or one positive, so the estimate is very unstable.

scenario: 分类系统会自动封禁高风险账号，之后训练数据里很少看到这些账号的完整行为。
scenario_en: A classifier automatically bans high-risk accounts, so later training data rarely contains their full follow-up behavior.
q: 评估与训练要防什么？
q_en: What should evaluation and training guard against?
why: 模型先拦截会让后续日志缺失这些账号的真实演化，训练和评估都可能被自己的输出带偏。可用探索流量或 golden set 缓解。
why_en: A classifier can create feedback loops because its actions change the future data used for evaluation and training.
tradeoff: 利用当前模型判断 vs 保留探索流量避免自我强化
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Model[Model action] --> World[Changed traffic]
  World --> Logs[Future logs]
  Logs --> Train[Next training]
  Train --> Model
options: 只是标注员之间打标签不一致
precision 自动变成 100%
模型动作改变未来数据，形成反馈循环
只是模型在训练集上过拟合了
options_en: It is just inconsistency between human annotators.
Precision automatically becomes 100 percent.
The model's own actions change future data, creating a feedback loop.
It is just the model overfitting to the training set.
whenOtherWins: 如果模型只做离线辅助分析、不影响数据产生过程，反馈循环压力小很多。
optionExplanations: 错；标注不一致是标签噪声问题，和模型自己封号改变数据分布是两回事。
错；拦截账号只是让这些样本消失，不会让 precision 凭空变成 100%。
对；被拦截账号的后续行为不再进日志，训练和评估数据会被模型自己的动作污染。
错；过拟合是训练问题，这里的核心是模型的动作反过来污染了未来数据。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — annotator disagreement is a label-noise problem, distinct from the model's own actions reshaping data.
Incorrect — banning accounts just removes those samples; it does not push precision to 100 percent.
Correct — banned accounts' future behavior stops being logged, so the model's own action biases later data.
Incorrect — overfitting is a training issue; the core problem here is the model's action polluting future data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型的动作改变了未来数据，导致训练/评估被自己的输出影响。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feedback loop happens when a model's actions change the future data used to train or evaluate it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 长期不受模型决策影响的稳定评测集合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A golden set is a stable evaluation set that stays unaffected by the model's own decisions.

scenario: 面试官问推荐系统的 evaluation 和一个二分类审核模型有什么本质不同。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks how recommender evaluation differs from evaluating a binary moderation classifier.
q: 推荐系统 evaluation 和二分类最大的差异是什么？
q_en: What is the biggest evaluation difference between a recommender and a binary classifier?
why: 推荐不是单个 yes/no，用户看到的是排序 slate；多样性和长期留存都很重要，离线指标只是线上价值的近似。
why_en: Recommendation evaluation is about ranked slates and long-term user behavior rather than a single binary decision.
tradeoff: 单点判断的 accuracy vs 排序+长期行为的组合指标
options: 推荐价值取决于排序、集合和长期用户行为
推荐只需要 accuracy
推荐没有线上实验
推荐不受反馈循环影响
options_en: Recommendation value depends on ranking, the item set, and long-term user behavior.
Recommendations only need accuracy.
Recommenders have no online experiments.
Recommenders are unaffected by feedback loops.
optionExplanations: 对；用户看到的是一份排好序的清单，好坏取决于顺序、多样性和后续留存。
错；accuracy 是单点分类指标，衡量不了排序质量和长期效果。
错；推荐系统大量依赖 A/B、interleaving 等线上实验来验证离线结论。
错；推荐结果同样会改变未来训练日志，一样存在反馈循环风险。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — users see a ranked list, so quality depends on order, diversity, and downstream retention.
Incorrect — accuracy is a single-item classification metric; it cannot capture ranking quality.
Incorrect — recommenders rely heavily on A/B and interleaving experiments to validate offline results.
Incorrect — recommendation outputs also reshape future training logs, so feedback loops still apply.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次展示给用户的一组排好序的推荐结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A slate is the ordered set of recommended items shown to a user at once.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把两个排序结果混成一个列表给同一用户看，再比较点击偏好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Interleaving mixes two rankers' results into one list shown to the same user, then compares clicks.

scenario: 你要跟面试官解释，为什么排序系统常用 NDCG 而不是简单的 accuracy。
scenario_en: You need to explain why ranking systems often use NDCG instead of simple accuracy.
q: NDCG 适合推荐/搜索的原因是什么？
q_en: Why is NDCG useful for recommendation or search?
why: 用户更关注靠前结果，NDCG 用位置折扣表达这一点，并用理想 DCG 归一化便于跨查询比较。
why_en: NDCG rewards relevant items near the top of a ranked list and normalizes against the ideal ranking.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Top[Relevant at rank 1] -->|full weight| DCG[DCG]
  Low[Relevant at rank 10] -->|discounted| DCG
  DCG --> Norm[Normalize by ideal DCG]
options: 只计算第一个相关结果
高位相关结果权重更大，且按理想排序归一化
只统计系统延迟
忽略排序位置
options_en: It only counts the first relevant result.
Relevant results near the top get more weight, and the score is normalized by the ideal ranking.
It only measures system latency.
It ignores ranking position entirely.
optionExplanations: 错；那是 MRR 的定义，NDCG 会累加多个相关结果、只是位置越靠后权重越小。
对；NDCG 给靠前相关结果更高权重，再除以理想排序的 DCG 做归一化。
错；NDCG 是排序质量指标，和延迟无关。
错；NDCG 的核心正是用位置折扣把排序位置计入分数。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — that describes MRR; NDCG sums many relevant results, just discounted by position.
Correct — NDCG weights top-ranked relevant results more and normalizes by the ideal DCG.
Incorrect — NDCG is a ranking-quality metric, unrelated to latency.
Incorrect — NDCG's core idea is discounting by rank position, not ignoring it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种排序指标，给靠前的相关结果更高权重并做归一化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG rewards relevant results near the top of a ranking and normalizes the score against the ideal ranking.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按位置折扣累加相关性得分，是 NDCG 归一化前的原始分数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DCG sums relevance scores discounted by rank position, before NDCG normalizes it.

scenario: 问答系统只需要展示一个最好的答案，你要解释 MRR 在这种场景里衡量什么、和 NDCG/MAP 有什么不同。
scenario_en: A QA system only needs to show one best answer, and you need to explain what MRR measures compared with NDCG or MAP.
q: MRR 最关注什么？
q_en: What does MRR focus on most?
why: MRR 是第一个相关结果位置倒数的平均值，适合“只需要第一个好答案”的场景，不太关心后续多个相关结果。
why_en: MRR focuses on how early the first relevant result appears.
tradeoff: MRR（首位命中）vs NDCG/MAP（整体排序质量）
options: 所有结果的平均长度
模型参数量
标注员人数
第一个相关结果出现的位置
options_en: The average length of all results.
The number of model parameters.
The number of human annotators.
The position where the first relevant result appears.
optionExplanations: 错；结果长度和相关性排序无关，MRR 不统计这个。
错；参数量是模型规模，不是评估排序质量的指标。
错；标注员人数影响标签成本，不是排序指标本身。
对；MRR 只看第一个相关结果排第几，取倒数再对所有查询平均。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — result length has nothing to do with relevance ranking; MRR does not track it.
Incorrect — parameter count is model size, not a ranking-quality metric.
Incorrect — annotator count affects labeling cost, not the ranking metric itself.
Correct — MRR averages the reciprocal rank of the first relevant result across queries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 第一个相关结果排名倒数的平均值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MRR averages the reciprocal rank of the first relevant result across queries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给靠前相关结果更高权重并归一化的排序指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG rewards relevant results near the top of a ranking and normalizes the score.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对每个相关结果位置算 precision 再平均，奖励相关结果整体靠前。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MAP averages precision at each relevant result's rank, rewarding rankings where relevant items appear early.

scenario: 你要离线评估 up-next 推荐，历史日志有时间顺序。
scenario_en: You are offline-evaluating up-next recommendations, and the historical logs have a clear time order.
q: 更合理的测试集构造是？
q_en: What is the better way to construct the test set?
why: 推荐离线评估要模拟“用过去预测未来”，否则会把明天行为泄漏进今天模型，得分好看但不可信。
why_en: Recommendation offline tests should preserve time so the model predicts future interactions from past behavior.
tradeoff: 按时间切分（防泄漏）vs 随机切分（更简单但会泄漏未来）
options: 把未来点击随机打散进训练集里
构造测试集时不使用用户这个维度
按时间给每个用户留出最后一次互动
只挑最热门的视频当测试样本
options_en: Shuffle all future clicks randomly into the training set.
Build the test set without using the user dimension at all.
Hold out each user's most recent interaction by time.
Test only on the most popular videos.
whenOtherWins: 若问题不是时序推荐而是静态偏好分析，随机用户级 holdout 可能也可接受。
optionExplanations: 错；打散时间顺序会让模型训练时看到未来点击，造成数据泄漏。
错；推荐评估通常按用户维度切分，否则同一用户的历史会同时出现在训练和测试里。
对；按时间为每个用户留出最后一次互动，模拟“用过去预测未来”。
错；只测热门视频会漏掉长尾覆盖率和冷启动表现。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — shuffling breaks time order and leaks future clicks into training, inflating scores.
Incorrect — recommendation tests are usually split by user, or the same user leaks across train/test.
Correct — holding out each user's most recent interaction by time mimics predicting the future from the past.
Incorrect — testing only on popular videos misses long-tail coverage and cold-start performance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按时间顺序把每个用户最后一次互动留作测试，其余作训练。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Leave-one-interaction-out holds out each user's most recent interaction for testing while training on earlier ones.

termDefinitions.meaning: 测试信息意外混进训练数据，导致评估分数虚高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data leakage is when test information accidentally leaks into training, inflating evaluation scores.

scenario: 一次推荐改版让 CTR 明显上升，你要判断这是否足以说明可以全量上线。
scenario_en: A recommender change clearly raises CTR, and you need to decide whether that is enough to ship it fully.
q: 推荐 A/B 测试为什么通常要同时看短期和长期指标？
q_en: Why should recommender A/B tests usually track both short-term and long-term metrics?
why: 推荐系统容易优化短期刺激，长期可能造成疲劳或生态问题；业务目标通常要求两者一起看。
why_en: Recommendation experiments need short-term and long-term metrics because immediate engagement can conflict with retention and satisfaction.
options: 点击可能上升，但留存或多样性会下降
长期指标会自动等同于短期 CTR
短期指标根本没法被记录下来
A/B 测试无法同时追踪多个指标
options_en: Clicks may rise while retention or diversity fall.
Long-term metrics automatically equal short-term CTR.
Short-term metrics simply cannot be logged.
A/B tests cannot track more than one metric at once.
optionExplanations: 对；短期刺激上升不代表长期健康，两者可能背道而驰。
错；长期留存和短期 CTR 是不同的现象，没有必然相等关系。
错；短期指标通常最容易记录，问题恰恰是只看短期不够。
错；A/B 测试可以同时追踪多个指标，这正是发现短长期背离的方法。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — short-term engagement can rise while long-term health silently declines.
Incorrect — long-term retention and short-term CTR are distinct signals, not equal by default.
Incorrect — short-term metrics are usually the easiest to log; the risk is only looking at them.
Incorrect — A/B tests can track multiple metrics at once, which is how you catch this divergence.

termDefinitions.meaning: 点击率，点击次数占展示次数的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CTR, or click-through rate, is the share of impressions that get clicked.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户在一段时间后是否还继续使用产品。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Retention measures whether users keep coming back to the product over time.

scenario: 一次排序改动很小，团队只有有限流量可用于测试，需要尽快判断哪个 ranker 更好。文章提到 interleaving 通常比 A/B 少用 10-20 倍流量就能达到同样统计功效。
scenario_en: A ranking change is small, traffic is limited, and the team needs to quickly tell which ranker is better; interleaving can often need 10 to 20 times less traffic than A/B.
q: Interleaving test 相比普通 A/B 的主要统计优势是什么？
q_en: What is the main statistical advantage of interleaving over a plain A/B test?
why: 同一用户看混合列表，每次点击同时是对一个 ranker 的支持、对另一个的反对，配对比较抵消了用户间噪声，因此常比 A/B 少用 10-20 倍流量。
why_en: Interleaving shows the same user a mixed list so every click is a paired vote, cutting variance and often needing 10 to 20 times less traffic than a plain A/B test.
options: 完全不需要任何流量
同一用户看混合列表，配对比较降低了方差
只能用来比较分类器
完全不需要记录日志
options_en: It needs no traffic at all.
The same user sees a mixed list, so the paired comparison lowers variance.
It can only be used to compare classifiers.
It needs no logging at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把两个排序结果混成一个列表给同一用户看，再比较点击偏好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Interleaving mixes two rankers' results into one list shown to the same user, then compares which one gets more clicks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一个体在相同条件下分别评价两个方案，减少个体间差异带来的噪声。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A paired comparison evaluates two options under the same subject, removing between-subject noise.

optionMeanings: 选项主张：完全不需要任何流量。
选项主张：同一用户看混合列表，配对比较降低了方差。
选项主张：只能用来比较分类器。
选项主张：完全不需要记录日志。
optionDirectness: 只有这个绝对假设成立时才适合。
适合本题给出的约束。
只有这个绝对假设成立时才适合。
只有这个绝对假设成立时才适合。
optionScenarioImpacts: 会让系统依赖「完全不需要任何流量」这个前提。
会让方案围绕「同一用户看混合列表，配对比较降低了方差」展开。
会让系统依赖「只能用来比较分类器」这个前提。
会让系统依赖「完全不需要记录日志」这个前提。
optionMeanings_en: It needs no traffic at all.
The same user sees a mixed list, so the paired comparison lowers variance.
It can only be used to compare classifiers.
It needs no logging at all.
optionDirectness_en: Only fits when this statement is true: it needs no traffic at all.
Use when interleaving shows the same user a mixed list so every click is a paired vote, cutting variance and often needing 10 to 20 times less traffic than a plain A/B test.
Only fits when this statement is true: it can only be used to compare classifiers.
Only fits when this statement is true: it needs no logging at all.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: It commits the design to this assumption: It needs no traffic at all.
It commits the design to this path: The same user sees a mixed list, so the paired comparison lowers variance.
It commits the design to this assumption: It can only be used to compare classifiers.
It commits the design to this assumption: It needs no logging at all.

scenario: 推荐日志只记录了旧模型展示过的项目，新模型想学习未展示项目的真实偏好。
scenario_en: Recommendation logs only contain items shown by the old model, but the new model needs to learn true preferences for unseen items.
q: 必须重点处理什么偏差？
q_en: Which bias must you handle carefully?
why: 用户只能点击看见的东西，旧排序位置会影响标签；需要记录候选、位置、propensity，用探索或逆倾向加权做 debias。
why_en: Recommendation logs are biased by what the old system showed, so counterfactual logging or propensity correction is needed.
tradeoff: 沿用旧策略数据（省成本）vs 注入探索流量做反事实纠偏（更贵但无偏）
options: 训练数据量不够大
模型容量太小，需要加参数
特征工程做得不够精细
position bias 和缺失反事实反馈
options_en: There simply is not enough training data.
The model capacity is too small and needs more parameters.
Feature engineering has not been refined enough.
Presentation/position bias and missing counterfactual feedback.
whenOtherWins: 如果训练数据来自均匀随机展示或人工标注集合，position bias 会小很多。
optionExplanations: 错；数据量再大也救不了系统性偏差，问题不是样本不够多。
错；加大模型参数解决不了展示偏差，这是数据本身带偏的问题。
错；特征做得再精细，模型学到的仍是被展示偏差污染过的数据。
对；用户只点击看到的项目，旧排序决定了谁被看到，没展示过的项目缺少真实反馈。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — more data cannot fix a systematic bias; the problem is not sample size.
Incorrect — more model capacity does not fix exposure bias baked into the data itself.
Incorrect — no matter how refined the features are, the model still learns from exposure-biased data.
Correct — users can only click what was shown, so the old ranking decides who gets feedback at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户更容易点排得靠前的结果，导致点击数据本身带偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Position bias means users click higher-ranked results more often regardless of true relevance, biasing click data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录用户没看到的候选和展示概率，用来纠正展示偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Counterfactual logging records unseen candidates and their display probability to correct for exposure bias.

scenario: 电商搜索团队只盯着点击率，你要说明还应该补充看哪些产品指标。
scenario_en: An ecommerce search team only watches click-through rate, and you need to explain which product metrics to add.
q: 搜索/IR 系统的产品指标通常不只看点击，还要看什么？
q_en: Besides clicks, what product metrics should search or IR systems usually track?
why: 点击会受标题党和位置偏差影响；搜索满意度还看放弃率、重查率、转化和延迟。
why_en: Search product evaluation should include success, abandonment, reformulation, conversion, and latency, not just clicks.
options: 训练 epoch 数
服务端代码行数
查询成功、放弃率、重查率、转化和延迟
模型文件名
options_en: The number of training epochs.
The number of lines of server-side code.
Query success, abandon rate, reformulation rate, conversion, and latency.
The model's file name.
optionExplanations: 错；训练 epoch 是模型训练细节，不是用户能感知的产品指标。
错；代码行数是工程量度量，和用户搜索体验无关。
对；这些信号一起补上点击容易忽略的“找到了吗、快不快、要不要重搜”。
错；文件名是部署细节，不反映任何用户体验。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — training epochs are a training detail, not a user-facing product metric.
Incorrect — lines of code measure engineering effort, unrelated to search experience.
Correct — together these capture whether users found an answer, how fast, and whether they had to retry.
Incorrect — a file name is a deployment detail with no bearing on user experience.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户重新改写查询词，通常暗示第一次没找到满意结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Query reformulation is when a user rewrites their query, often signaling the first search failed to satisfy them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户看到结果后没有任何点击或转化就离开的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Abandon rate is the share of searches where the user leaves without clicking or converting.

scenario: 电商搜索页只展示前 10 个结果，你要向面试官解释 Precision@10 和 Recall@10 分别衡量什么。
scenario_en: An ecommerce search page shows only the top 10 results, and you need to explain what Precision@10 and Recall@10 measure.
q: 搜索里的 Precision@k 和 Recall@k 区别是什么？
q_en: What is the difference between Precision@k and Recall@k in search?
why: Precision@k 关心前 k 个位置干不干净，Recall@k 关心该找到的相关结果有没有被覆盖到前 k。
why_en: Precision@k measures the relevance density of the top k, while Recall@k measures how much of the relevant set is retrieved.
tradeoff: Precision@k（前 k 位准确率）vs Recall@k（相关集合覆盖率）
options: Precision@k 测精度，Recall@k 测召回率
两者的定义完全反过来，分母被互换了
两者都只看排名第一的那一个结果
两者的数值永远都会等于 NDCG 分数
options_en: Precision@k measures accuracy, Recall@k measures retrieval rate.
The definitions are swapped: the two denominators are reversed.
Both only look at the single rank-1 result.
Both are always numerically equal to the NDCG score.
optionExplanations: 对；Precision@k 分母是 top-k，Recall@k 分母是全部相关文档。
错；这正好把两者的分母说反了，会把两个指标的结论完全颠倒。
错；只看第一名是 MRR 的做法，Precision@k/Recall@k 都看整个 top-k 窗口。
错；NDCG 还要按位置折扣和归一化，和这两个指标计算方式不同。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — Precision@k's denominator is top-k, Recall@k's denominator is the full relevant set.
Incorrect — this swaps the two denominators, which flips the conclusions both metrics support.
Incorrect — rank-1-only is how MRR works; Precision@k and Recall@k both look across the whole top-k window.
Incorrect — NDCG additionally applies rank discounting and normalization, a different calculation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 前 k 个结果里相关结果的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision at k is the fraction of the top k results that are relevant.

termDefinitions.meaning: 全部相关文档里，有多少落在前 k 个结果里。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall at k is the fraction of all relevant documents that appear in the top k results.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给靠前相关结果更高权重并归一化的排序指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG rewards relevant results near the top of a ranking and normalizes the score.

scenario: 电商搜索 query 有头部、腰部、长尾，还涉及不同地区和新鲜内容。
scenario_en: Ecommerce search queries include head, torso, and tail traffic, plus different locales and freshness needs.
q: 离线评估集应如何采样？
q_en: How should the offline evaluation set be sampled?
why: 只评头部会掩盖长尾和地区问题；分层测试集能暴露不同意图、频率和新鲜度需求下的质量差异。
why_en: Search evaluation sets should be stratified across head, torso, tail, locale, and freshness-sensitive slices.
tradeoff: 只看头部（省成本但漏长尾）vs 分层覆盖（更贵但更真实）
options: 只取最高频的 100 个 query
分层覆盖 query 频率、地区、新鲜度等切片
只取历史失败的 query
按文档 ID 连续截取样本
options_en: Take only the top 100 highest-frequency queries.
Stratify coverage across query frequency, locale, and freshness.
Take only historically failed queries.
Slice samples by contiguous document ID.
whenOtherWins: 若目标只优化单一头部导航 query，专门头部集才可能更合适。
optionExplanations: 错；只测头部会让腰部、长尾和地区问题完全测不到。
对；分层能同时暴露头部、腰部、长尾以及不同地区/新鲜度上的质量差异。
错；只看失败样本会漏掉“看似正常但其实变差”的回归。
错；文档 ID 和查询质量无关，这种切法不代表任何真实分布。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — testing only the head misses torso, tail, and locale-specific failures entirely.
Correct — stratifying exposes quality gaps across head, torso, tail, locale, and freshness.
Incorrect — only sampling past failures misses regressions that still look superficially fine.
Incorrect — document ID has nothing to do with query quality or real traffic distribution.

termDefinitions.term: query 分层 / stratified query sampling
termDefinitions.meaning: 按频率、地区、新鲜度等维度分层抽取评测 query。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stratified query sampling draws evaluation queries proportionally across dimensions like frequency, locale, and freshness.

termDefinitions.meaning: 出现频率很低但数量众多的查询词。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Long-tail queries are individually rare but collectively make up a large share of search traffic.

scenario: 搜索系统里，用户输入 `jaguar`：可能想看动物，也可能想看汽车或球队。离线标注集如果只给一个“标准答案”，就会把其它合理意图判错。
scenario_en: In search, a query like `jaguar` could mean the animal, car, or team; a single gold answer would mark other valid intents as wrong.
q: 多重意图查询最容易让相关性评估出什么问题？
q_en: What evaluation problem do multi-intent queries create for relevance labels?
why: 多意图 query 的“正确”取决于用户意图，单一标签会把另一个合理结果当错。更好的评估要做意图切片或多样性指标。
why_en: For ambiguous queries, relevance depends on intent, so evaluation needs intent-aware labels or diversity metrics.
tradeoff: 单一标准答案（简单但误判合理意图）vs 意图切片评估（更准但更贵）
options: 所有结果都自动算相关
NDCG 会因此无法计算
系统延迟一定会变高
不同用户意图下，“正确结果”并不相同
options_en: Every result is automatically considered relevant.
NDCG can no longer be computed.
System latency is guaranteed to increase.
The 'correct' result differs by user intent.
optionExplanations: 错；不是所有结果都相关，还是要看它服务的意图是否合理。
错；NDCG 仍能算，只是标签没建好会让算出的数字失真。
错；多意图主要影响标签和多样性，不必然拖慢系统响应。
对；同一个词对应多个合理需求，相关性判断必须绑定具体意图。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — not every result is relevant; it still must serve a plausible intent.
Incorrect — NDCG can still be computed, but poorly designed labels make the number misleading.
Incorrect — ambiguity mainly affects labels and diversity, not necessarily system latency.
Correct — the same query can express several valid intents, so relevance depends on which one.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给靠前相关结果更高权重并归一化的排序指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG rewards relevant results near the top of a ranking and normalizes the score.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户输入某个查询词背后真正想要的信息需求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Query intent is the underlying information need behind a search query.

scenario: 面试官问，为什么生成式系统的评估不能只靠一个自动化指标。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks why a generative system cannot be evaluated with just one automated metric.
q: 生成式 AI evaluation 为什么通常需要指标组合？
q_en: Why does generative AI evaluation usually need a portfolio of metrics?
why: 生成任务没有唯一答案，好坏维度很多；自动指标、事实检查、安全检测和人类偏好要组合使用。
why_en: Generative systems require a portfolio of metrics because quality, factuality, safety, and usefulness are distinct dimensions.
options: BLEU 一个指标就永远够用
只看延迟就足够评估质量
输出可能有多个正确形式，质量、安全、事实性各自独立
人类评价完全没有价值
options_en: A single BLEU score is always enough.
Looking only at latency is enough to judge quality.
Outputs can have multiple valid forms, and quality, safety, and factuality can fail independently.
Human evaluation has no value at all.
optionExplanations: 错；BLEU 只测词面重合，测不出事实性、安全性或语气是否合适。
错；延迟是工程约束，和输出内容对不对、安不安全无关。
对；生成没有唯一答案，质量、事实性、安全性要分开衡量才不会互相掩盖。
错；自动指标便宜但会偏离人类判断，人工评估仍是校准的关键手段。
optionExplanations_en: Incorrect — BLEU only measures word overlap, missing factuality, safety, or tone.
Incorrect — latency is an engineering constraint, unrelated to whether output is correct or safe.
Correct — generation has no single right answer, so quality, factuality, and safety must be tracked separately.
Incorrect — automated metrics are cheap but drift from human judgment; human review still calibrates them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 n-gram 重合度比较生成文本和参考答案的相似度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BLEU measures n-gram overlap between generated text and a reference to score similarity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 生成内容是否符合真实事实，不是凭空编造。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Factuality measures whether generated content is true and grounded, not fabricated.

scenario: 客服机器人目标是减少工单但不能激怒用户或胡编答案。
scenario_en: A support bot should reduce tickets without frustrating users or inventing answers.
q: 最合理的评估组合是？
q_en: What is the most reasonable evaluation metric set?
why: 业务价值是解决问题、降低人工成本，同时要控制事实错误和体验风险，单一指标覆盖不了。
why_en: A support bot should be evaluated by resolution, satisfaction, handoff cost, hallucination rate, and safety incidents.
tradeoff: 单一自动指标（便宜但片面）vs 多维业务+安全指标组合（贵但完整）
options: 解决率、满意度、接管时长、幻觉率、安全事件
只看回复文字的长短
只看 BLEU 这一个重合度分数
只看模型的参数规模大小
options_en: Resolution rate, satisfaction, handoff time, hallucination rate, and safety incidents.
Only reply length.
Only a single BLEU overlap score.
Only the model's parameter count.
whenOtherWins: 若是固定参考答案的翻译任务，BLEU/COMET 等文本指标权重会更高。
optionExplanations: 对；这组指标同时覆盖业务价值（解决率/满意度/成本）和风险（幻觉/安全）。
错；回复长短和是否真正解决问题、是否安全没有必然关系。
错；BLEU 只测词面重合，客服场景没有固定参考答案可比对。
错；参数规模是模型大小，不反映它是否真的帮用户解决了问题。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — this set covers both business value (resolution, satisfaction, cost) and risk (hallucination, safety).
Incorrect — reply length has no necessary link to whether the issue was actually resolved or safe.
Incorrect — BLEU measures word overlap, but support replies have no fixed reference answer to compare against.
Incorrect — parameter count is model size, not whether it actually helped the user.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型自信地生成不真实或无依据的内容。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hallucination is when a model confidently generates content that is false or unsupported.

termDefinitions.meaning: 机器人无法解决时转交给人工客服处理。
